recipes.description: Romania's ricotta-style cheese, Urdă has been made by Carpathian shepherds for millennia. Made from the whey left after making brânză or cașcaval, it's traditionally eaten fresh with mămăligă (polenta).

recipes.title: Traditional Vacherin Fribourgeois (Swiss Fondue Cheese)
recipes.description: Swiss semi-hard cheese with a sticky washed rind, creamy texture, and nutty flavor, essential for authentic fondue.

recipes.title: Traditional Vacherin Mont d'Or (Spruce-Wrapped Winter Cheese)
recipes.description: A magical winter cheese made only from September to March when cows return from alpine pastures. Wrapped in spruce bark and aged in spruce boxes, it becomes so creamy it's eaten with a spoon - a centuries-old tradition in the Jura mountains.

recipes.title: Traditional Valençay (French Pyramid Goat Cheese)
recipes.description: Truncated pyramid-shaped French goat cheese coated in vegetable ash, with a creamy interior and distinctive tangy flavor.

recipes.title: Traditional Vastedda della Valle del Belìce (Sicilian Stretched Sheep Cheese)
recipes.description: A rare and ancient stretched-curd (pasta filata) cheese made from sheep's milk in Sicily's Belìce Valley. Unlike most stretched cheeses which use cow's milk, Vastedda represents an older tradition where sheep's milk was the norm.

recipes.title: Traditional Västerbotten (Swedish King of Cheese)
recipes.description: Sweden's most prestigious cheese was created by accident in 1872 when a dairy maid was distracted during cheesemaking. The resulting granular, intensely flavored cheese became a Swedish national treasure - the 'King of Cheese.'

recipes.title: Traditional Vieux-Boulogne (French Washed-Rind)
recipes.description: Legendarily pungent French cheese washed with beer - scientifically proven to be one of the world's smelliest cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Vieux Boulogne (World's Smelliest Cheese)
recipes.description: Scientifically proven to be the world's smelliest cheese in a Cranfield University study, Vieux Boulogne is washed with beer. Despite its powerful aroma, the interior is mild and creamy - a classic washed-rind paradox.

recipes.title: Traditional Wagashi (West African Fresh Cheese)
recipes.description: West African fresh cheese made by Fulani herders using traditional plant rennet, with a mild fresh flavor often fried or grilled.

recipes.title: Traditional Wensleydale (Yorkshire Monastery Cheese)
recipes.description: Brought to Yorkshire by Cistercian monks from France in 1150, Wensleydale was originally made from sheep's milk. The monks' blue-veined cheese evolved over centuries into today's crumbly white cheese. Now famous paired with Christmas cake and made even more popular by Wallace and Gromit.

recipes.title: Traditional Wensleydale (English Crumbly Cheese)
recipes.description: English crumbly white cheese from Yorkshire with a mild, slightly sweet flavor and moist, crumbly texture.

recipes.title: Traditional Cornish Yarg (Nettle-Wrapped Cheese)
recipes.description: Cornish semi-hard cheese wrapped in stinging nettle leaves, creating a beautiful edible green coating and slightly earthy flavor.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese No. 1
recipes.description: Traditional cheese-making recipe from The Complete Book of Cheese.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese No. 2
recipes.description: Traditional cheese-making recipe from The Complete Book of Cheese.

recipes.title: Creamy Kefir Cheese (Labneh)
recipes.description: A simple, tangy cream cheese made by straining milk kefir through cheesecloth. The whey separates to create a thick, spreadable cheese.

recipes.title: Bhel Puri
recipes.description: Look for puffed rice and sev at Indian markets; you can substitute chow mein noodles for sev. Find chutneys on the supermarket's international aisle.

recipes.title: Pepper Pancakes with Fresh Cilantro Chutney
recipes.description: Indian street food—a variety of small snack plates—often defined by a balance of spicy and acidic, salty and sweet, and soft salt and crunchy components. The idea of small plates featuring the vibrant tastes of northern and western India is starting to take hold in this country.
recipes.servings_yield: 6 servings (serving size: 1 pancake, about 2 teaspoons chutney, and 1 tablespoon yogurt)

recipes.title: Lemony Hummus with Spicy Whole-Wheat Pita Chips
recipes.description: This dish makes a wholesome accompaniment for sandwiches and salads. Keep extra pita chips stored in an airtight container for up to three days.
recipes.servings_yield: 8 servings (serving size: 3 1/2 tablespoons hummus and 6 chips)

recipes.title: Greek Layered Dip with Pita Chips
Pepperoni Roll-Ups
recipes.description: Easy pizza-style appetizers with crescent rolls, pepperoni, and cheese.

recipes.title: Asian Meatballs
recipes.description: Baked meatballs with hoisin glaze and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Labneh (Lebanese Cream Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional Lebanese strained yogurt cheese, simple to make with just yogurt, salt, and olive oil.

recipes.title: Muhammara
recipes.description: A Lebanese walnut and pomegranate dip with warm spices - perfect with pita.

recipes.title: Avocado Salsa
recipes.description: This avocado salsa is smooth, cool and downright refreshing. Scoop it with chips, spoon it over chicken or steak

recipes.title: California Roll
recipes.description: Making your own California sushi roll is surprisingly easy. You'll need a bamboo mat, sushi rice and nori sheets to get started, and with a bit of practice, you'll be a pro in no time.

recipes.title: Cashew Cheese
recipes.description: There are few food situations this vegan cashew cheese can't elevate. It's easy to make and ready to be spread on crackers or transformed into mac and cheese.

recipes.title: Garlic Bean Dip
recipes.description: There isn't a bean that my family does not like. In fact, I serve one kind or another almost every day. This dip is one of our favorite ways to eat them.

recipes.title: Orange Shrimp Mojo
recipes.description: With jalapeno, orange and avocado, this enticing entree is spicy, tangy and fresh with every bite. The sauce beautifully glazes the shrimp.

recipes.title: Sweet Pea Pesto
recipes.description: I made a healthier spin on pea pesto by subbing in vegetable broth for some of the oil and going easy on the cheese. For use on pasta, add more broth for a saucelike consistency.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Eggplant
recipes.description: Air-fryer eggplant fries coated in savory breading and Parmesan cheese totally make us forget about classic potato fries. They work well as a side dish or an anytime snack.

recipes.title: Apple-Nut Blue Cheese Tartlets
recipes.description: These tasty appetizers look and taste gourmet, but they're easy to make and have loads of blue cheese flavor. The phyllo shells and filling can be made in advance

recipes.title: Avocado Endive Cups with Salsa
recipes.description: I jazz up guacamole by serving it atop endive leaves. Add a brilliant red pepper salsa, and you’ve got a standout appetizer.

recipes.title: Baked Pot Stickers with Dipping Sauce
recipes.description: Twisting these wonton wrappers like little candies makes them fuss-free, and the dipping sauce is packed with sweet heat.

recipes.title: Baked Veggie Cups
recipes.description: These colorful veggie cups are not only tasty, but they also pack in a surprising amount of nutrition! The addition of mozzarella and Parmesan is the perfect Italian touch.

recipes.title: Balsamic-Goat Cheese Grilled Plums
recipes.description: Make a bold statement with this simple yet elegant treat. Ripe plums are grilled and then dressed with a balsamic reduction and tangy goat cheese.

recipes.title: White Bean Hummus
recipes.description: All it takes is a handful of ingredients and a few minutes to pull together this creamy white bean hummus recipe.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewers
recipes.description: Light, satisfying and healthful in one impossibly easy-to-make dish? Yes, please! Enjoy these Caprese skewers as an app, side dish

recipes.title: Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crispy chickpeas will become a favorite when you need something crunchy on your salads and bowls. An added bonus? They're vegan!

recipes.title: Cilantro & Lime Chicken with Scoops
recipes.description: I came up with this recipe when I was preparing for a large party and wanted a healthy Tex-Mex chicken to serve in tortilla chip cups. You can make this party dish ahead of time to free yourself for time-sensitive dishes. Serve it in tortilla cups or any other savory, crispy cup you like. Enjoy the leftovers over salad greens or wrapped up in tender tortillas for burritos.

recipes.title: Texas Caviar
recipes.description: This top-rated recipe for Texas caviar is a guaranteed favorite at any tailgate or potluck. The fresh dip is made from black-eyed peas, corn, tomatoes and avocado, all tossed in a zippy vinaigrette and served with crispy tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Corn Salsa
recipes.description: This simple corn salsa is a celebration of summer produce.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken Meatball Wraps
recipes.description: My strategy to get picky kids to eat healthy: Letting everyone assemble their dinner at the table. We love these easy meatball wraps, topped with crunchy veggies and peanuts, sweet raisins, and a creamy dollop of yogurt.

recipes.title: Four-Tomato Salsa
recipes.description: The variety of tomatoes, onions and peppers makes this chunky salsa so good. Whenever I try to take a batch to a get-together, it's hard to keep my family from finishing it off first! It's a super snack with tortilla chips or as a relish with meat.

recipes.title: Fresh from the Garden Wraps
recipes.description: We moved into a house with a garden that needed tending. Using the herbs we found, we made these fresh-tastic wraps for our first dinner there.

recipes.title: Makeover Creamy Artichoke Dip
recipes.description: Folks are sure to gather around this ooey-gooey, lightened-up dip whenever it's placed on any buffet table. With cheese, jalapenos and a hint of lemon, it's a treasured favorite.

recipes.title: Peachy Jalapeno Guacamole
recipes.description: Fresh jalapenos and summer-ripe peaches give this creamy guacamole so much flavor. It's got a little kick, but I love that it's not so spicy it burns off my taste buds!

recipes.title: Pork Satay
recipes.description: This easy pork satay recipe combines savory, sweet and spiced flavors with a rich peanut sauce. Whether you’re hosting or craving something special, this dish is sure to impress.

recipes.title: Beet Hummus
recipes.description: Break out of the plain hummus rut with this beet hummus recipe. Earthy, sweet beets are a vibrant, wholesome addition to the classic dip.

recipes.title: Red Pepper Tapenade
recipes.description: This roasted red pepper tapenade combines sweet red peppers, almonds and basil into a delicious spread that's perfect for entertaining or everyday snacking. Serve it with toasted baguette slices or water crackers.

recipes.title: Skinny Quinoa Veggie Dip
recipes.description: Don’t let the name fool you. This good-for-you recipe may appeal to an athlete in training, but it has plenty of flavor to satisfy everyone. We use crunchy cucumber slices for dippers.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon New Potatoes
recipes.description: Give twice-baked potatoes a rest this year and try these stuffed spuds. Smoked salmon and cream cheese blended with lemon juice and dill are simply piped into small red potatoes. Leftovers are even good with eggs for breakfast.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Salsa
recipes.description: Radishes add a wonderful crunch to this colorful salsa that is also superb over grilled fish. There's just enough jalapeno to give flavor without much of the heat.

recipes.title: Tangy Texas Salsa
recipes.description: I'm a "transplant" from Wisconsin currently living in Texas. Even after 20 years, I can't get enough of our wonderful local citrus. This is one way to work it into a main dish. The combination of tangy fruit, spicy jalapeno and distinctive cilantro is perfect over any meat, poultry or fish. We also dip into it with chips.

recipes.title: Tomato Focaccia
recipes.description: Tomato focaccia bread is a fantastic side for all sorts of dishes, such as roasted chicken, pork chops, sea bass, and more. It's also fantastic on its own or topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Vegetable Samosas
recipes.description: My family enjoys the wonderful Indian flavors in a traditional samosa. Baked instead of fried, this version has fewer calories but keeps all the classic tastes and textures we love.

recipes.title: Zippy Shrimp Skewers
recipes.description: These flavorful skewers deliver a mouthwatering kick with minimal effort. Fix them for your next party and watch them disappear.

recipes.title: Cheesy Bruschetta Dip
recipes.description: This creamy, flavorful dip comes together quickly and is a real crowd-pleaser. It is a delicious complement to a meal or a fun appetizer to serve at a party.

recipes.title: Dirty Martini Dip
recipes.description: You'll find all the iconic ingredients of the namesake cocktail in this dirty martini dip, right down to the vodka, vermouth and olive brine.

recipes.title: Salsa Criolla
recipes.description: If salsa criolla sounds exotic, your ears are not deceiving you. It’s an essential Peruvian salsa that brings acidity and sweetness to sandwiches, meat dishes, potatoes and even eggs. But it’s not for Peruvian cuisine only. Try it on your regular weeknight meals for a little variety.

recipes.title: Smashed Zucchini Dip
recipes.description: Smashed zucchini dip is a take on the eggplant spread called baba ganoush, but with a different main ingredient. It's the healthy and flavorful party spread you never knew you needed!

recipes.title: Granny's 7 Layer Dip
recipes.description: Such a special recipe today from Granny! This dip is no-cook, easy to throw together, and so DELICIOUS with chips!

recipes.title: Avocado Shrimp Salsa
recipes.description: A quick to prepare salsa that's a go-to for entertaining, snacking, and lite meals...perfect for hot days when you don't want to cook!

recipes.title: One Skillet Cheesy Salsa Chicken Rice Bake
recipes.description: A wonderful dinner that's easily made in one skillet and under an hour...perfect for game night!

recipes.title: Mexican Street Corn Dip
recipes.description: All the flavors of street corn mixed into the creamiest corn-filled dip. Quick, easy, and so delicious with tortilla chips on the side!

recipes.title: Ceviche
recipes.description: Ceviche made from raw fish or shrimp "cooked" in tangy citrus and mixed with cucumber, red onion, cilantro, jalapeño, avocado, and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Shrimp Ceviche
recipes.description: I've always loved the freshness of a good shrimp ceviche, and this one doesn't disappoint. The pumpkin replaces the jicama, and it’s just barely cooked to offer a crunchy delight of fall flavor. It will taste best if you allow it to marinate overnight. —Robert Rossi, Independence, Louisiana

recipes.description: Vintage recipe

recipes.title: Lemon Appetizer
recipes.description: Vintage recipe from Scotts North American Seasonal Cook Book Spring Summer Autumn And Winter Guide To Economy And Ease In Good Food 1921

recipes.title: Labrete Canape
recipes.description: Vintage recipe from Wilsons Cook Book Numerous New Recipes On Present Economic Conditions 1920

recipes.title: Conch Fritters: Bahamian Style
recipes.description: A traditional Bahamian recipe made with conch, the wonderful shellfish. These fritters are great as appetizers, finger foods or very tasty hors d'oeuvres. Conch can be replaced with calamari, shrimp, imitation crab meat and lobster. BEWARE - these are HOT!

recipes.title: Picante Dip
recipes.description: Creamy tomato and onion dip with cream cheese, served with tostadas.

recipes.title: Green Chile Dip
recipes.description: Simple sour cream dip with green chiles and garlic, served with tortilla or potato chips.

recipes.title: Avocado Dip
recipes.description: Guacamole-style dip with Colby cheese, green chiles, and green onions.

recipes.title: Chile-izzas
recipes.description: Mini pizza bites with ground beef, biscuits, tomato sauce, cheese, and green chiles.

recipes.title: Perritos Verdes (Green Chile Puppies)
recipes.description: Hot dogs wrapped with green chile strips and tortillas, deep fried until crispy.

recipes.title: Chile-Cheese Squares
recipes.description: A cheesy appetizer with layers of cheddar and green chiles topped with eggs.

recipes.title: Chil-E-Ums
recipes.description: Bite-sized rolls filled with bacon, onion, and green chiles.

recipes.title: Chile-Izzos
recipes.description: Biscuit rounds topped with beef and cheese, baked until done.

recipes.title: Perritos Verdes (Green Chile Puppies)
recipes.description: Hot dogs wrapped in green chile strips and tortillas, then deep-fried.

recipes.title: Chile-Mushroom Fritters
recipes.description: Crispy fried fritters with mushrooms and green chiles.

recipes.title: Pecorino with Honey and Walnuts
recipes.description: A simple Italian appetizer pairing sharp Pecorino with sweet honey and crunchy walnuts.

recipes.title: Manchego with Membrillo (Quince Paste)
recipes.description: The classic Spanish pairing of nutty Manchego cheese with sweet quince paste. Simple perfection.

recipes.title: Manchego Croquetas
recipes.description: Crispy fried croquettes filled with creamy béchamel and Manchego cheese. A beloved Spanish bar snack.

recipes.title: Endive Boats with Roquefort and Pear
recipes.description: Crisp endive leaves filled with Roquefort, pear, and walnuts. An elegant appetizer.

recipes.title: Classic Swiss Cheese Fondue
recipes.description: Traditional Swiss fondue with Gruyère and Emmental, white wine, and kirsch. Perfect for sharing.

recipes.title: Baked Brie with Honey and Nuts
recipes.description: Warm, gooey brie topped with honey, walnuts, and fresh rosemary. An irresistible appetizer.

recipes.title: Brie en Croûte
recipes.description: Brie wrapped in golden puff pastry with a layer of jam. Impressive yet easy.

recipes.title: Labneh Dip with Za'atar and Olive Oil
recipes.description: Creamy strained yogurt cheese drizzled with olive oil and za'atar. Essential Middle Eastern mezze.

recipes.title: Classic Provoleta Argentina
recipes.description: Grilled provolone cheese with oregano and red pepper flakes, the essential opening act of an Argentine asado.

recipes.title: Provoleta with Chimichurri
recipes.description: Grilled provolone topped with fresh, herbaceous chimichurri sauce for a burst of Argentine flavor.

recipes.title: Provoleta with Salsa Criolla
recipes.description: Grilled provolone served with salsa criolla, a zesty relish of fresh tomatoes, peppers, and onions.

recipes.title: Sardo Cheese Crostini with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
recipes.description: Crispy crostini topped with sharp Sardo cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Picada Argentina with Magnasco Edam
recipes.description: A traditional Argentine snack platter featuring Magnasco Edam alongside cured meats, olives, and accompaniments.

recipes.title: Magnasco Edam with Wine and Crackers
recipes.description: Argentine Magnasco Edam served simply with crackers and paired with robust red wine.

recipes.title: Divine Baked Feta
recipes.description: Simple baked feta with olive oil, crushed red pepper, and oregano. Surprisingly mild despite the heat.

recipes.title: Israeli-Style Hummus
recipes.description: Authentic smooth hummus made from scratch with dried chickpeas. Served warm with olive oil.

recipes.title: Maltese Pastizzi (Cheese Pies)
recipes.description: Traditional Maltese savory pastries filled with ricotta-style cheese and herbs in flaky puff pastry.

recipes.title: Feta and Pumpkin Pastries
recipes.description: Flaky filo triangles filled with roasted butternut pumpkin and tangy feta cheese.

recipes.title: Hillbilly Fondue
recipes.description: A simple Swiss and Gruyere cheese fondue made in a double boiler. Perfect for dipping French bread.

recipes.title: Harvest Chicken Liver Pâté
recipes.description: A rich and flavorful chicken liver pâté with apple, bourbon, and warm spices. Perfect for entertaining.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Cheese Curds
recipes.description: Classic Wisconsin-style fried cheese curds with a light, crispy batter. A state fair favorite.

recipes.title: Tyropites (Greek Cheese Pies)
recipes.description: Flaky phyllo triangles filled with a mixture of feta and ricotta cheese. A beloved Greek appetizer or snack.

recipes.title: Baked Ricotta
recipes.description: A simple, elegant appetizer of creamy baked ricotta served with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Lemony Baked Ricotta with Herbs
recipes.description: A delicious appetizer of warm ricotta baked with lemon zest and herbs until bubbly and slightly browned. Perfect served with toasted baguette slices.

recipes.title: Greek Layer Dip
recipes.description: A Mediterranean-inspired layered dip with hummus, pesto, artichokes, fresh vegetables, olives, and crumbled feta. Perfect for parties.

recipes.title: Peppered Whipped Goat Cheese
recipes.description: Light, creamy whipped goat cheese seasoned with black pepper.

recipes.title: Garlic Crostini
recipes.description: Simple garlic-rubbed toasted bread for serving with soups and stews.

recipes.title: Beef Carpaccio with Pickled Radish, Fennel and Carrots, and Yuzu Vinaigrette
recipes.description: Paper-thin raw beef tenderloin served with tangy pickled vegetables and a Japanese-inspired yuzu vinaigrette. This dish appears as the first course in the Meat Lover's menu.

recipes.title: Goat Cheese Croquette
recipes.description: Crispy breaded goat cheese disks with fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Crab Shrimp Lettuce Cups with Black Bean Mango Salsa and Chili Vinaigrette
recipes.description: Light summer appetizer with marinated shrimp and crab served in butter lettuce cups with tropical salsa and spicy vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Seared Foie Gras on Brioche French Toast with Caramelized Apples and Figs
recipes.description: The ultimate in opulence - incredibly rich foie gras served atop the best French toast with caramelized apples and figs. Holli Ugalde served this as starter to her Season 7 competition-winning dinner.

recipes.title: Shallot and Caramelized Onion Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: An upside-down tart made with caramelized onions and shallots. Using store-bought puff pastry makes this recipe a cinch.

recipes.title: A Trio of Oysters: Tempura-Fried Oysters with Citrus Aioli, Freshly Shucked Oysters with Bloody Mary Granita, Baked Oysters Rockefeller
recipes.description: Raw, baked, and fried - this threesome of oysters is a decidedly upscale start to a meal. Blue Point oysters prepared three ways.

recipes.title: Bloody Mary Granita
recipes.description: Frozen Bloody Mary mixture to top fresh oysters.

recipes.title: Oysters Rockefeller
recipes.description: Classic baked oysters with spinach, bacon, Parmesan, and a drizzle of Pernod.

recipes.title: Seared Foie Gras on Brioche French Toast with Caramelized Apples and Figs
recipes.description: Foie gras, made from duck or goose liver, is a French delicacy and the ultimate in opulence. The name translates to 'fat liver,' and it is incredibly rich. It's often made into pate, but here we serve it in slices set atop the best French toast you'll ever eat, with caramelized apples and figs to further gild the lily. Holli Ugalde served a version of this dish as starter to her Season 7 competition-winning dinner.

recipes.title: Shallot and Caramelized Onion Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: Tarte Tatin, an upside-down tart that's inverted when served, is most famously made with apples. It also takes to savory preparations, like this version made with caramelized onions and shallots. Using store-bought puff pastry makes this recipe a cinch, easier than rolling out pastry for a standard right-side-up tart. Choose a puff pastry made with butter rather than vegetable oil for the most flavorful and flaky tarte Tatin.

recipes.title: Fig Brulee
recipes.description: Addictive whipped fig brie stuffed into halved figs and torched with a caramelized sugar top. Great for a party — stuff ahead and torch right before serving.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Olive Dip (Dirty Martini Dip)
recipes.description: A creamy, savory, make-ahead party appetizer that tastes like a dirty martini in every bite. Blue cheese and briny olives with a splash of vodka.

recipes.title: Bacon Jalapeño Popper Dip
recipes.description: Loaded jalapeño popper dip with crispy bacon, extra cheese, and the perfect amount of spice. Ultimate party appetizer.

recipes.title: Bacon Wrapped Jalapeño Poppers
recipes.description: Spicy jalapeño poppers filled with seasoned cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in smoky bacon and baked to crispy perfection.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.description: Rich, cheesy, and spicy dip made with three cheeses, tender chicken, and Buffalo sauce. Includes slow cooker and oven directions.

recipes.title: Candied Bacon Jalapeño Poppers
recipes.description: Jalapeños stuffed with honey-sweetened ghost pepper cream cheese, wrapped in candied bacon. Sweet and spicy perfection.

recipes.title: Classic Jalapeño Poppers
recipes.description: The original crispy fried jalapeño poppers stuffed with cream cheese and coated in seasoned breading.

recipes.title: Crispy Buffalo Wings
recipes.description: Classic crispy buffalo wings tossed in buttery, tangy, spicy sauce. Perfect for game day or any gathering.

recipes.title: Ghost Pepper Wings with Buffalo-Blue Cheese Sauce
recipes.description: Crispy baked wings rubbed with ghost pepper spice, served with a creamy buffalo-blue cheese sauce. Extremely spicy!

recipes.title: Hot Honey Wings
recipes.description: Crispy chicken wings glazed with spicy hot honey - the perfect balance of sweet, heat, and savory.

recipes.title: Jalapeño Popper Dip
recipes.description: All the flavors of jalapeño poppers in an easy, creamy, baked dip with a crunchy topping.

recipes.title: Queso Dip
recipes.description: Perfect gooey cheese dip with jalapeños, tomatoes, and spices. Easy to make and always a crowd pleaser.

recipes.title: Spicy Deviled Eggs with Bacon and Jalapeño
recipes.description: Deviled eggs spiked with jalapeño, crispy bacon, and sriracha. The best deviled eggs a spicy food lover could ask for!

recipes.title: Texas Nachos
recipes.description: The ultimate appetizer with crispy corn tortillas topped with refried beans, melty cheese and pickled jalapeño peppers. Perfect for parties or game day!

recipes.title: Beef Burnt Ends
recipes.description: A barbecue appetizer featuring sticky, sweet, savory, and sumptuous bite-sized pieces of smoked brisket with bark and sauce.

recipes.title: Chicharron Burnt Ends
recipes.description: This dish combines Spanish chicharrone (pork crackling) with traditional barbecue burnt ends methodology, creating a sticky, scrumptious treat you can put out for guests.
recipes.cook_time: 3 hours (smoking) plus additional time for crisping

recipes.title: Spicy Bacon Burnt Ends
recipes.description: A smoky, spiced dish with a satisfying crunch combined with a delectable interior, featuring bacon cubes with a sweet and savory glaze.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Crispy baked chicken wings with hot sauce glaze

recipes.title: Chilli Beef Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Spicy beef and pork mince in crisp lettuce cups

recipes.title: Pork Dumplings
recipes.description: Pork and chive dumplings with black vinegar dipping sauce

recipes.title: Crockpot Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Bowl
recipes.description: Slow-cooked chicken mixed in red salsa, salsa verde, and hot sauce, then served over rice bowls - DELISH!

recipes.title: Spicy Chili Garlic Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Deviled eggs with a spicy chili garlic topping featuring chili crisp, toasted sesame seeds, and soy sauce. A crowd-pleasing party appetizer.

recipes.title: Deviled Duck Eggs
recipes.description: Duck eggs are bigger and far richer-tasting than chicken eggs. If they're not available, simply substitute 1 jumbo chicken egg for each duck egg in any given dish. This makes a terrific starter course or a nice, light lunch.

recipes.title: Smoked Whitefish and White Bean Spread
recipes.description: This creamy spread is great with our Amaranth Crackers, page 60, or piled high on Corn Cakes, page 51, or Wild Rice Cakes, page 63. This is the filling for Stuffed Squash Blossoms, page 28.

recipes.title: Duck Pâté with Dried Apple
recipes.description: Delicious served by itself, and on Corn Cakes, page 51, or with Amaranth Crackers, page 60.

recipes.title: Bison Tartare
recipes.description: Bison is the cleanest-tasting red meat, milder and a little sweeter than beef. Tartare showcases this clean taste. Here it's seasoned with juniper and mint and gets a tangy kick from sumac.

recipes.title: Stuffed Squash Blossoms
recipes.description: Beautiful squash blossoms stuffed with smoked whitefish and white bean spread, dipped in egg batter and fried until golden.

recipes.title: Chile-Cheese Squares
recipes.description: Cheesy baked squares with green chiles and jalapeños that freeze well.

recipes.title: Cocktail Party Bean Dip
recipes.description: A rich, cheesy bean dip with jalapeños, perfect for parties.

recipes.title: Cheddar Bay Sausage Balls
recipes.description: Biscuit mix meets sausage magic in these addictive bites made with Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuit mix, cream cheese, cheddar, and sausage.

recipes.title: Tuna Spread with Kefir
recipes.description: A light tuna spread made with milk kefir instead of mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Kefir Cheese Balls with Herbs
recipes.description: Herbed cheese balls made from kefir labneh, stored in olive oil.

recipes.title: Coconut Cupcakes with Chocolate and Almonds
Deep Dark Chocolate Biscotti
recipes.description: Whole-wheat flour, flaxseed, and almonds add fiber and antioxidants.

recipes.title: Mango-Agave Sorbet
recipes.description: The Mexican pedigree of this dessert makes it a fitting way to end a dinner of Hidden Rainbow Albondigas (page 162). Because tequila also comes from the agave plant, it fits naturally here; we use silver, or clear, tequila to keep the mango color vibrant. Dress up scoops with lime rind curls, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crepes Sweetened with Truvia Natural Sweetener
Apple Berry Galette with Truvia Natural Sweetener
Chocolate Bark
recipes.description: A customizable chocolate treat with your choice of toppings - choose from crunchy toppings (nuts, toffee, peppermints), chewy toppings (dried fruits, marshmallows), and spices (sea salt, cardamom, pink peppercorns).

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cupcakes with Caramelized Mango Buttercream
German Chocolate Cake with Coconut-Pecan Cajeta Frosting
Toasted Coconut Cake with Coconut Filling and Buttercream
La Dolce Vida Candy Cane Truffles
recipes.description: Easy chocolate truffles dusted in cocoa and candy cane bits.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cherry Treats
recipes.description: Chocolate and cherries, flavors of the famous Black Forest Torte, come together in these no-bake bars.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Nutty Butterscotch Squares
recipes.description: Golden raisins, dried apricots, butterscotch morsels and peanut butter combine in these tasty bars.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cheesecake
recipes.description: Creamy cheesecake topped with fresh blueberry sauce.

recipes.title: Lemon Tart
recipes.description: Classic French lemon tart with buttery pastry shell and tangy lemon curd filling.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Classic chocolate chip cookies with dark chocolate chunks.

recipes.title: Layali Libnan
recipes.description: Lebanese Nights - a semolina pudding with rose water, topped with whipped cream, pistachios, and caramel syrup.

recipes.title: Lebanese Style Cookies
recipes.description: Traditional Lebanese cookies with semolina, warm spices, rose water, and orange flower water, shaped into wreaths.

recipes.title: Mahallebi
recipes.description: A creamy Lebanese milk pudding topped with pistachios and cinnamon syrup.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Ice Pops
recipes.description: These cool, creamy pops are a deliciously different way to use up the bounty from your rhubarb patch.

recipes.title: Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: These warm, gooey, indulgent banana chocolate chip cookies can be made in just 35 minutes. Bake a batch of three dozen to nosh on all week long.

recipes.title: Carrot Cookies
recipes.description: Carrot cookies are sweet and colorful, a harmony between the garden and the dessert table. This recipe will add a bit of old-fashioned simplicity to your cookie lineup.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
recipes.description: These crunchy, golden and chewy coconut macaroons are ideal for their simplicity and texture, and you can have this treat on the table in 30 minutes or less.

recipes.title: Chipotle Crackle Cookies
recipes.description: I usually bake these special cookies for the holidays, but my family loves them so I bake them for their birthdays. The addition of ground chipotle chile pepper gives these cookies a little zing.  The dough may be sticky, so I dip my hands in confectioners' sugar for easier handling.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
recipes.description: These rich and fudgy chocolate crinkle cookies are perfect for sharing at holiday get-togethers.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberry Meringue Roses
recipes.description: Eat these pretty treats as is or crush them into a bowl of strawberries and whipped cream. Readers of my blog, utry.it, went nuts when I posted that idea.

recipes.title: Coconut Kisses
recipes.description: Chewy on the inside and crisp on the outside, these meringue cookies are delicious. They add a light touch to the cookie platter, not only during the holidays but all year round.

recipes.title: First-Place Coconut Macaroons
recipes.description: These coconut macaroon cookies earned me a first-place ribbon at the county fair. They remain my husband's favorites

recipes.title: Soft Gingersnap Cookies
recipes.description: You’ll want to bake endless trays of these soft gingersnap cookies. The dough packs warm spices such as ginger, cinnamon and cloves.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Cookies
recipes.description: This just-sweet-enough fluffy lemon meringue cookie is easier to make than its impressive looks imply. The creamy lemon curd against a crisp and light meringue is simply outstanding.

recipes.title: Lime Coconut Biscotti
recipes.description: My family loves this recipe! It’s great with that morning cup of coffee, delicious as an afternoon snack or after-dinner dessert. Citrusy and crunchy, not too sweet, it always hits the spot.

recipes.title: Mocha Meringue Sandwich Cookies
recipes.description: These crisp, chewy cookies can be made any size you choose. They're also great with a variety of fillings

recipes.title: Molasses Crinkle Cookies
recipes.description: If you love desserts with warm and comforting spices, try these molasses crinkle cookies. They're crispy on the outside, chewy in the center and packed with irresistible flavors.

recipes.title: No-Bake Apple Pie
recipes.description: Forget the oven. This chilled, no-bake apple pie is served in a no-bake crust for the ultimate cool, sweet treat.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pudding Cake
recipes.description: Take a trip to the tropics with this creamy and refreshing pineapple pudding cake. Shortcuts like a boxed cake mix, instant pudding and whipped topping ensure this easy cake recipe comes together in no time at all.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Seed Cranberry Biscotti
recipes.description: Hints of pumpkin seed and almond give this biscotti recipe a wonderful flavor that's just right for fall. Try one with a cup of coffee or hot cocoa!

recipes.title: Soft Honey Cookies
recipes.description: These pillowy honey cookies pair perfectly with an afternoon cup of coffee or tea.

recipes.title: Meringue Cookies
recipes.description: These sweet little swirls are light as can be. They're all you need after a big, special dinner.

recipes.title: Hanukkah Cookies
recipes.description: Enriched with cream cheese, these Hanukkah cookies are soft, rich and ultra-tender. They look especially festive when they're decorated with colorful royal icing.

recipes.title: Magic Cake
recipes.description: This popular magic cake has three distinct layers and requires only six ingredients to make. It disappears fast, too, just like magic!

recipes.title: Matzo Meal Pancakes
recipes.description: These matzo meal pancakes are a wonderful dish for breakfast or brunch. They can be served with applesauce, jam or sour cream. When beating the egg whites, start on a low speed and gradually increase to reach a good consistency.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodle Cake
recipes.description: With its layers of cinnamon-swirl vanilla cake and tangy cinnamon cream cheese frosting, this snickerdoodle cake tastes just like the classic cookie.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Fritter Cake
recipes.description: Each bite is filled with a swirl of lemony goodness and topped with a quick lavender-vanilla glaze - so delicious!

recipes.title: Aztec chocolate sorbet
recipes.description: Chocolate sorbet is a refreshing alternative to chocolate ice cream. Our easy Aztec chocolate sorbet is inspired by xocolatl (hot chocolate’s Aztec predecessor), with notes of chilli and cinnamon. Why it’s so good: “Chocolate sorbets are less common than their ice cream counterparts, but a water-based ice lets the flavour of the chocolate come through in its purest form,” says head of food Tom Shingler. “It’s surprisingly refreshing for something sweet and chocolatey, lik

recipes.title: Thomasina Miers' molten mole chocolate cake
recipes.description: This molten chocolate cake by Mexican food aficionado Thomasina Miers has a welcome chilli warmth, inspired by Mexican mole. Chocolate cake with a twist: “An astonishingly good cake that manages to be both thrilling and comforting with its smoky, salty, deeply chocolatey taste and unexpected layers of flavour from the chilli and sesame,” says Thomasina. “It has a richness, but there is also a raffish feeling to it, perhaps due to the surprising background warmth of the ancho.”

recipes.description: Chocolate fans will surely applaud this to-die-for fudge cake.

recipes.title: Boston Cream Pie
recipes.description: Despite the name, this chocolate-glazed American classic is actually a cake.

recipes.title: Toffee-Topped Bars
recipes.description: Serve these luscious after-school treats with a tall, cold glass of milk.

recipes.title: Apple-Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.description: These soft, chewy cookies are perfect for filling the cookie jar.

recipes.title: Almond Streusel Cake
recipes.description: Transform a plain cake into an irresistible delight with a crumbly almond streusel.

recipes.title: Orange-Glazed Coffee Cake
recipes.description: Light and refreshing, this cake doubles the flavor and fragrance of fresh orange.

recipes.title: Fresh Berry Crumb Pie
recipes.description: A hazelnut mixture does double duty as a crust and topping in this berry-filled pie.

recipes.title: Peach-Apricot Cobbler
recipes.description: These two fruits combine beautifully to make a homey, warm-from-the-oven dessert.

recipes.title: Crumbly Apple Pie
recipes.description: A buttery brown sugar topping is a fabulous variation on this classic American apple pie.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
recipes.description: Sweet meringue offsets the tart citrus flavor in this classic lemon-filled pie.

recipes.title: Miniature Chocolate Eclairs
recipes.description: No store-bought eclairs can compare to these bite-size pastries with their rich chocolate center.

recipes.title: Cherry Strudel
recipes.description: This old-world favorite gets a quick and easy update from ready-made phyllo pastry.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheesecake
recipes.description: Impressive to look at, this dessert will surely please cheesecake and chocolate lovers alike!

recipes.title: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Icing
recipes.description: A nut-sprinkled cream cheese icing is the perfect foil for this moist, not-too-sweet carrot cake.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: These are about as good as cookies get, so make several batches and watch them disappear fast.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Pecan Brownies
recipes.description: Ready in less than an hour, these fudgy treats are delightfully sweet and rich.

recipes.title: Low-Carb Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
recipes.description: Low-carb cheesecake bars with few ingredients. They taste like the inside of a pumpkin pie!

recipes.title: Apple Pie
recipes.description: A simple colonial-era apple pie with lemon, cinnamon, mace, and rose-water.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
recipes.description: A rich colonial rice pudding with eggs, butter, and rose-water, baked in puff paste.

recipes.title: A Nice Indian Pudding
recipes.description: Traditional New England Indian pudding made with cornmeal (Indian meal), milk, eggs, and raisins.

recipes.title: A Bread Pudding
recipes.description: A rich colonial bread pudding with raisins, butter, and rose-water.

recipes.title: Pompkin (Pumpkin) Pie
recipes.description: One of the earliest American pumpkin pie recipes, with cream, eggs, mace, nutmeg, and ginger.

recipes.title: Carrot Pudding
recipes.description: A sweet colonial carrot pudding baked without paste.

recipes.title: A Crookneck, or Winter Squash Pudding
recipes.description: A colonial squash and apple pudding with wine, rose-water, and spices.

recipes.title: A Lemon Pudding
recipes.description: A rich colonial lemon pudding with wheat bread soaked in wine and butter.

recipes.title: Orange Pudding
recipes.description: A rich colonial orange pudding with Seville oranges, wine, and cream.

recipes.title: Custard
recipes.description: A colonial custard with milk, nutmeg, wine, brandy, and rose-water.

recipes.title: Apple Tarts
recipes.description: Colonial apple tarts with cinnamon, rose-water, wine, and orange juice.

recipes.title: Cranberries Tart
recipes.description: Simple colonial cranberry tart - stewed, strained, sweetened and baked in paste.

recipes.title: Puff Paste for Tarts (No. 1)
recipes.description: A basic colonial puff paste recipe for tarts.

recipes.title: Royal Paste
recipes.description: A rich royal paste excellent for tarts and apple cakes.

recipes.title: A Fine Syllabub from the Cow
recipes.description: A traditional colonial syllabub made by milking a cow directly into sweetened cider.

recipes.title: A Whipt Syllabub
recipes.description: A light whipped colonial syllabub with cream, wine, lemon, and egg whites.

recipes.title: Plumb Cake
recipes.description: A rich colonial fruit cake with currants, citron, candied orange peel, almonds, and wine.

recipes.title: Plain Cake
recipes.description: A simple colonial cake with butter, eggs, rose-water, and wine.

recipes.title: A Trifle
recipes.description: A colonial trifle with broken biscuit, rusk, spiced cake, wine, custard, and syllabub.

recipes.title: Cookies
recipes.description: One of the earliest recorded cookie recipes in America, flavored with pearl ash (early leavening) and coriander.

recipes.title: Another Christmas Cookey
recipes.description: An early American Christmas cookie recipe with coriander, ginger, and rose-water.

recipes.title: Molasses Gingerbread
recipes.description: Traditional colonial molasses gingerbread, beaten until light and white.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cakes
recipes.description: Colonial gingerbread cakes with nutmeg, ginger, and pearl ash.

recipes.title: Queens Cake
recipes.description: An elegant colonial cake whipped to a cream, baked quickly in pans.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
recipes.description: The classic pound cake - one pound each of sugar, butter, flour, and eggs.

recipes.title: Shrewsbury Cake
recipes.description: A colonial adaptation of the English Shrewsbury cake, rolled into small cakes.

recipes.title: A Butter Drop
recipes.description: Colonial butter drop cookies baked in tin pans.

recipes.title: A Date With Melons
recipes.description: Cantaloupe rings filled with dates, raisins, and pistachios, topped with yogurt and honey.

recipes.title: Biblical Medley
recipes.description: A simple fruit salad with biblical fruits, honey, and nuts.

recipes.title: Baked Figs in Wine
recipes.description: Fresh figs baked with orange, wine, and honey.

recipes.title: Apricot Sauce
recipes.description: A sweet apricot sauce made with dried apricots, honey, and berries for topping cakes.

recipes.title: Classic Tiramisu
recipes.description: The beloved Italian dessert with layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream.

recipes.title: Murder Cookies (Scotch Cookies)
recipes.description: A soft, chewy molasses cookie with warm spices including the distinctive flavor of mace. Originally called 'Secret Scotch Cookies' from Cushman's Bakery, renamed by the Reddit community.

recipes.title: Nana's Devil's Food Cake
recipes.description: A moist, rich chocolate cake made with oil (stays moist for days!) and coffee that intensifies the chocolate flavor without imparting coffee taste. Called 'the best chocolate cake ever, guaranteed' by the family.

recipes.title: Grandma's Lemon Bars
recipes.description: The most popular recipe on r/Old_Recipes - easy to make lemon bars packed with intense lemon flavor. A buttery shortbread crust topped with a sweet-yet-tart lemon filling.

recipes.title: Whipping Cream Cake
recipes.description: A dense, buttery bundt cake with just six ingredients and one brilliant technique: starting in a COLD oven. The slow warming creates a perfectly gooey bottom layer.

recipes.title: Alice Cookies (Whipped Shortbread)
recipes.description: A light, airy whipped shortbread that melts in your mouth. The defining characteristic is the long 10-minute whipping period that creates an incredibly delicate, crumbly texture.

recipes.title: Grandma's Apple Cream Pie
recipes.description: An unusual pie made with GRATED apples and a cream mixture poured on top. The shredded apples combine with the filling for even flavor distribution - 'better than a normal apple pie.'

recipes.title: Big Mama's Cinnamon Roll Cake
recipes.description: A moist poke cake with swirls of cinnamon sugar throughout and a sweet vanilla glaze. From a Depression-era farm grandmother who 'could make delicious meals from seemingly nothing.'

recipes.title: Elevator Lady Spice Cookies
recipes.description: Simple, warmly spiced molasses cookies that are easy enough for anyone who hates to cook. Soft and chewy with notes of cinnamon, cloves, and ginger.

recipes.title: 150-Year-Old 3-Ingredient Cookies
recipes.description: An incredibly simple 3-ingredient cookie with rich butterscotch flavor despite no butterscotch. Thin, crisp edges with chewy centers. So easy the recipe is impossible to mess up.

recipes.title: Damn Good Cookies
recipes.description: A classic oatmeal chocolate chip cookie with walnuts that earned its name. Gooey in the center fresh from the oven, with the perfect balance of chocolate, oats, and salty walnuts.

recipes.title: World's Best Gingerbread (1917)
recipes.description: A large, moist, dark, rich gingerbread cake that's not too sweet and wonderfully spicy. Over 100 years old and still the best recipe for holiday baking.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup Cake (Mystery Cake)
recipes.description: A delightfully spicy cake made with tomato soup - the secret ingredient that makes it impossible to guess what's in it. Egg-free and dairy-free, a perfect Depression-era recipe.

recipes.title: Mamaw's No-Bake Cookies
recipes.description: Classic chocolate peanut butter oatmeal no-bake cookies. Ready in minutes with no oven required. A staple in grandmothers' kitchens for generations.

recipes.title: Armenian Perok Cake
recipes.description: A buttery cake topped with apricot jam and a lattice crust. Like a cross between a cake and a pie. Originally posted during COVID-19 quarantine and quickly went viral.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake (Depression Cake)
recipes.description: A rich, moist chocolate cake made without eggs, milk, or butter. The vinegar and baking soda create leavening through a chemical reaction. Born from wartime rationing necessity.

recipes.title: Hot Milk Cake
recipes.description: A simple vanilla cake with a tender, fine crumb - like a cross between pound cake and angel food cake. Not too heavy, not too light, but just right. Uses hot milk for extra tenderness.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Chess Pie
recipes.description: A simple Southern custard pie with a gooey center and crackly sugar crust. The cornmeal rises to the surface during baking, creating that trademark golden top.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pie
recipes.description: A tangy, creamy Southern custard pie. Similar to chess pie but with buttermilk for tartness and flour for a smoother texture. Simple ingredients, extraordinary flavor.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Vinegar Pie
recipes.description: A chess-style custard pie using vinegar for tartness when lemons weren't available. Don't let the name fool you - it tastes like a silky lemon pie without any lemon.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Divinity Candy
recipes.description: A light, fluffy meringue candy that's somewhere between fudge, nougat, and marshmallow. A Southern Christmas tradition since the early 1900s. Truly divine when done right.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad (Pistachio Fluff)
recipes.description: A fluffy green dessert salad made with pistachio pudding, crushed pineapple, and Cool Whip. Also called 'the green stuff,' pistachio fluff, or 'Shut-the-Gate-Up Salad.'

recipes.title: 7UP Pound Cake
recipes.description: A moist, tender pound cake with subtle lemon-lime flavor from 7UP soda. The carbonation acts as leavening and adds incredible moisture. A Southern tradition for decades.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
recipes.description: A moist chocolate sheet cake made with Coca-Cola, topped with a warm fudgy frosting loaded with miniature marshmallows and pecans. The cola adds moisture and subtle caramel notes.

recipes.title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
recipes.description: A dense, moist oatmeal cake topped with a gooey broiled coconut and pecan frosting. The frosting caramelizes under the broiler, creating an irresistible topping.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Salad
recipes.description: A fluffy fruit salad with mandarin oranges, pineapple, coconut, marshmallows, and sour cream. A Southern holiday tradition since the 1800s when fresh oranges were a Christmas luxury.

recipes.title: Classic Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
recipes.description: A buttery yellow cake with a caramelized pineapple and cherry topping. When inverted, the glistening fruit becomes the crowning glory of this American classic.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
recipes.description: A thin, moist chocolate sheet cake with a warm pourable chocolate-pecan frosting. Everything's bigger in Texas, including this crowd-pleasing cake.

recipes.title: Cherry Pineapple Dump Cake
recipes.description: The original dump cake - cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple topped with dry cake mix and butter. No mixing required, just dump everything in and bake. A busy mom's dream since the 1960s.

recipes.title: Mamie Eisenhower's Million Dollar Fudge
recipes.description: The famous White House fudge recipe from First Lady Mamie Eisenhower. Ultra-creamy chocolate fudge made with marshmallow creme and two kinds of chocolate. President Ike's favorite sweet treat.

recipes.title: Impossible Coconut Pie
recipes.description: A self-crusting miracle pie that creates three layers as it bakes: a crust on the bottom, custard in the middle, and toasted coconut on top. One of Bisquick's most legendary recipes.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Brittle
recipes.description: Crispy, buttery, sweet-and-salty peanut brittle made the old-fashioned way on the stovetop. The baking soda creates that signature light, airy texture. A Christmas candy classic.

recipes.title: New Orleans Pecan Pralines
recipes.description: Authentic New Orleans pralines - buttery, creamy pecan candies that melt in your mouth. Made with brown sugar, butter, and toasted pecans the way they've been made in Louisiana since the 1700s. Pronounced 'PRAH-leens' in Louisiana.

recipes.title: Apple Dump Cake
recipes.description: A warm, comforting apple dessert that tastes like apple pie without any of the work. Layers of applesauce and apple pie filling topped with spice cake mix and butter. Pure apple comfort.

recipes.title: Grandma's Sea Foam Candy
recipes.description: A light, melt-in-your-mouth candy similar to divinity but made with brown sugar for a caramel-like flavor. No corn syrup needed. An old-fashioned treat that's naturally dairy-free.

recipes.title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake (1970s)
recipes.description: A rich, moist bundt cake with a hidden ribbon of cinnamon, brown sugar, and pecans running through the middle. A clever fusion of pound cake and coffee cake that took the 1970s by storm.

recipes.title: Waldorf-Astoria Red Velvet Cake
recipes.description: The legendary red velvet cake from the famous urban legend. A woman supposedly paid $100 for this recipe and shared it with the world in revenge. Whether or not the story is true, the cake is undeniably delicious.

recipes.title: Neiman Marcus $250 Cookies
recipes.description: The legendary '$250 cookie' from the famous urban legend. The secret ingredient is oats blended into a powder, giving these chocolate chip cookies a nutty flavor with perfect texture. Now available for free, as Neiman Marcus intended.

recipes.title: Magic Cookie Bars (Hello Dolly Bars)
recipes.description: The original layered cookie bar - just press, layer, and pour. Graham cracker crust topped with chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, and pecans, all bound together with sweetened condensed milk. Pure magic.

recipes.title: Millionaire's Shortbread
recipes.description: Three layers of pure indulgence: a crumbly buttery shortbread base, a thick layer of soft golden caramel, and a glossy chocolate topping. Called 'millionaire's' because regular shortbread would be jealous of these riches.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Brownies (Blondies)
recipes.description: The brownie's golden cousin - chewy, buttery bars with deep butterscotch flavor from brown sugar and vanilla. Some say these came before chocolate brownies. A true 1950s classic.

recipes.title: Grasshopper Pie
recipes.description: A frozen no-bake pie with a chocolate cookie crust and a light, fluffy mint filling made with creme de menthe, creme de cacao, and marshmallows. The elegant green dessert that defined 1970s dinner parties.

recipes.title: Watergate Pistachio Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, chewy pistachio cookies in that signature pale green color. Made easy with cake mix and pistachio pudding - the 1970s way. All the flavors of Watergate Salad in cookie form.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
recipes.description: A German chocolate cake baked upside-down with coconut and pecans on the bottom, and cream cheese swirled through the top that creates dramatic 'earthquake' cracks as it bakes. Gooey, chocolatey, and utterly addictive.

recipes.title: Matrimonial Cake (Date Squares)
recipes.description: A creamy date filling sandwiched between layers of buttery oat crumble. A Canadian classic since the 1920s, especially beloved in the prairie provinces where it's called Matrimonial Cake - perhaps because two layers come together, just like marriage.

recipes.title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
recipes.description: A moist, boozy bundt cake flavored with orange juice, vodka, and Galliano liqueur - the same ingredients as the famous 1970s cocktail. Topped with a citrus-spiked glaze. The ultimate 70s party cake.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
recipes.description: The most requested recipe in Southern Living history - a moist, tropical layer cake loaded with bananas, crushed pineapple, and pecans, topped with cream cheese frosting. Originally from Jamaica, it became a Southern icon.

recipes.title: Pig Pickin' Cake
recipes.description: A moist mandarin orange cake topped with a dreamy pineapple-pudding-whipped topping frosting. A Southern potluck staple named after the traditional pig roasts where it's often served. Also called Mandarin Orange Cake or Sunshine Cake.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
recipes.description: A tender buttermilk cake studded with coconut and pecans, topped with cream cheese frosting. Despite its name, this cake is thoroughly Southern - perhaps named 'Italian' to sound elegant. A celebration and potluck favorite since the 1950s.

recipes.title: Alabama Lane Cake
recipes.description: A four-layer white cake with a boozy filling of egg yolks, sugar, butter, raisins, pecans, coconut, and bourbon. Named 'Prize Cake' when it won first place at a Georgia fair in 1898. Featured in 'To Kill a Mockingbird' - Miss Maudie's was 'so loaded with shinny it made me tight.'

recipes.title: Lemon Lush
recipes.description: Four layers of deliciousness: a buttery pecan shortbread crust, a fluffy cream cheese layer, smooth lemon pudding, and billowy Cool Whip on top. A no-bake potluck classic that's perfect for summer gatherings.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
recipes.description: A chocolate poke cake soaked with sweetened condensed milk and caramel sauce, topped with Cool Whip and crushed toffee bars. Sinfully rich, gooey, and absolutely addictive. The name says it all.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
recipes.description: Three layers of deliciousness: a salty-sweet pretzel crust, a fluffy cream cheese layer, and jiggly strawberry Jell-O studded with fresh berries. Called a 'salad' but it's absolutely dessert. A Midwestern and Southern holiday staple.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler Dump Cake
recipes.description: Canned peaches topped with dry cake mix and butter - that's it! The peaches bubble up and the butter melts down to create a golden, cobbler-like dessert. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Classic Pumpkin Roll
recipes.description: A lightly spiced pumpkin cake rolled around a sweet, fluffy cream cheese filling. The trick is rolling it while warm, then again after filling. A beautiful and impressive Thanksgiving dessert that can be made ahead and frozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
recipes.description: Layers of graham crackers and vanilla pudding that transform into a soft, cake-like dessert after chilling overnight. Topped with chocolate frosting. Tastes remarkably like a chocolate eclair with almost no effort.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
recipes.description: Four layers of pure indulgence: a buttery pecan shortbread crust, fluffy cream cheese layer, rich chocolate pudding, and billowy Cool Whip topping. Also known as Robert Redford Dessert because it's almost too good to be true.

recipes.title: Pistachio Fluff Salad
recipes.description: A fluffy pale green 'salad' made with pistachio pudding, crushed pineapple, marshmallows, and Cool Whip. Sweet, fluffy, and impossibly easy. Also called Watergate Salad or simply 'the green stuff' at family gatherings.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Butterscotch Pie
recipes.description: A rich, creamy brown sugar custard pie topped with billowy meringue. Butterscotch is made with brown sugar (not white like caramel), giving it a deep, complex sweetness. A 'desperation pie' from the days before refrigeration.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
recipes.description: A moist, old-fashioned cake made with a can of fruit cocktail - fruit AND syrup included. Topped with brown sugar and coconut that bakes into a crunchy, caramelized layer. No butter or oil needed - the fruit provides all the moisture.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Applesauce Cake
recipes.description: A moist, heavily spiced cake that uses applesauce in place of most of the fat. Loaded with warm spices, raisins, and walnuts. Popular during WWII rationing and still beloved today. The applesauce keeps it moist for days.

recipes.title: Poor Man's Cake (Depression Cake)
recipes.description: A moist spice cake made without eggs, milk, or butter - born from necessity during the Depression and WWII rationing. The secret is boiling the raisins with sugar, water, and shortening to create a rich, flavorful base. Proves you don't need fancy ingredients for delicious cake.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
recipes.description: A dense, fudgy chocolate cake topped with a layer of gooey melted marshmallows and rich chocolate frosting studded with pecans. Named for its resemblance to Mississippi River mud. Part brownie, part cake, all delicious.

recipes.title: Vintage Prune Cake with Buttermilk Glaze
recipes.description: A deeply moist, richly spiced cake that uses chopped prunes for natural sweetness and incredible moisture. Even people who think they don't like prunes love this cake - the spices create a warm, complex flavor. Topped with a warm buttermilk glaze.

recipes.title: Classic Snickerdoodle Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, pillowy cookies coated in cinnamon sugar with a signature tangy flavor from cream of tartar. Not just a sugar cookie with cinnamon - the cream of tartar makes them uniquely chewy with a crackly top. A beloved American classic.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake with Broiled Coconut Frosting
recipes.description: A moist, hearty oatmeal cake with warm spices, topped with a magical broiled frosting of butter, brown sugar, coconut, and pecans that caramelizes into a crunchy, gooey layer. The oats are soaked in boiling water for maximum tenderness.

recipes.title: Bacardi Rum Cake (1970s Original)
recipes.description: The legendary 1970s rum cake that launched a thousand holiday parties. A moist yellow cake studded with walnuts and soaked in a buttery rum glaze. Better the next day when the rum really sinks in.

recipes.title: Orange Fluff Salad (Orange Stuff)
recipes.description: A fluffy, creamy 'salad' with orange Jell-O, mandarin oranges, crushed pineapple, cottage cheese, and Cool Whip. Called a salad but definitely a dessert. A Midwest potluck staple since the 1970s.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
recipes.description: Hearty, chewy cookies packed with oats, coconut, and crispy cereal. Named for Texas Rangers or cowboys who needed filling trail snacks. Every bite has a different texture - chewy oats, crispy cereal, sweet coconut.

recipes.title: Pecan Sandies
recipes.description: Buttery, melt-in-your-mouth shortbread cookies studded with chopped pecans. The signature sandy, crumbly texture comes from the high butter-to-flour ratio and minimal mixing. Way better than store-bought.

recipes.title: Rice Krispie Treats (Original)
recipes.description: The classic no-bake treat that's been on the Rice Krispies box since 1939. Crispy cereal held together by gooey melted marshmallows and butter. The secret to perfect treats: fresh marshmallows and don't overheat.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Salad (Snickers Salad)
recipes.description: All the flavors of a caramel apple in salad form - crisp apples, chopped Snickers bars, and a creamy pudding-Cool Whip base. A potluck favorite that walks the line between salad and dessert. Kids and adults love it.

recipes.title: Jell-O Poke Cake
recipes.description: The original poke cake - a white cake with holes poked throughout, filled with liquid Jell-O that creates colorful stripes in every slice. Topped with Cool Whip for a light, fruity dessert. The 1970s recipe that started the poke cake craze.

recipes.title: Pink Stuff (Strawberry Fluff Salad)
recipes.description: The famous 'Pink Stuff' from every Midwest potluck - strawberry Jell-O, cottage cheese, crushed pineapple, and Cool Whip mixed into a fluffy pink cloud. Sweet, creamy, and impossibly easy. Everyone's grandma made this.

recipes.title: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
recipes.description: The famous crustless cheesecake from San Sebastián with a caramelized, almost-burnt top and creamy center.

recipes.title: Frangelico Tiramisu with Raspberries
recipes.description: Luxurious tiramisu with hazelnut liqueur, fresh raspberries, and mascarpone. Best made a day ahead.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Curd Tart
recipes.description: Traditional English dessert with creamy cheese curd filling, currants, and warm spices in a buttery pastry shell.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chèvre Truffles
recipes.description: Elegant truffles combining tangy goat cheese with bittersweet chocolate and sea salt.

recipes.title: Marble Chocolate Baked Cheesecake
recipes.description: Rich baked cheesecake with a chocolate biscuit base and beautiful marble swirl pattern.

recipes.title: Strawberry Goat Cheese Sorbet with Balsamic Reduction
recipes.description: A unique frozen dessert combining fresh strawberries with tangy goat cheese, drizzled with balsamic reduction.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Raspberry Pound Cake
recipes.description: A tender pound cake made with whole wheat pastry flour, sour cream, and dried raspberries with lime zest.

recipes.title: Blue Ribbon Apple Pie
recipes.description: A prize-winning apple pie with a crumb topping, baked inside a paper bag for perfect results every time.

recipes.title: Peach and Blackberry Clafouti
recipes.description: A rustic French custard dessert studded with fresh peaches and blackberries. Easy to make and impressive to serve.

recipes.title: Ostkaka (Swedish Cheese Cake)
recipes.description: Traditional Swedish baked custard made with fresh curds, almonds, and cream.

recipes.title: Mascarpone Mixed Berry Cake
recipes.description: A tender, moist cake featuring mascarpone cheese studded with fresh blueberries and raspberries, baked in a cast iron skillet.

recipes.title: Lemon Mascarpone Pound Cake
recipes.description: A decadent, creamy pound cake featuring mascarpone cheese with bright lemon flavor, finished with a lemon glaze.
recipes.servings_yield: One 12-cup Bundt cake or 9-11 inch sheet cake

recipes.title: Briar Gate Farm Goat Milk Caramels
recipes.description: Rich, creamy caramels made with goat milk, with a distinctive tangy sweetness. Can be flavored with vanilla, Kahlua, or bourbon.

recipes.title: Chocolate Ricotta Mousse
recipes.description: A quick, elegant dessert of smooth ricotta blended with melted chocolate. Rich and creamy with minimal effort.

recipes.title: Drunken Apple Pie
recipes.description: Old-fashioned apple pie spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice, brightened with a swig of bourbon. A dessert designed for adults.

recipes.title: Pastry Dough (for Pie)
recipes.description: Flaky butter pie crust.

recipes.title: Chocolate Molten Cake with Malted Milk Ice Cream and Marcona Almond Brittle
recipes.description: Chocolate molten cake, served piping hot and oozing with rich melted chocolate, is an ever-popular celebration food, a perennial choice for birthdays, anniversaries, and other milestones. Marcona almonds, native to Spain, are a rounded, more delicate, and upscale version of the nut and elevate the simple brittle that crowns the cakes.

recipes.title: Malted Milk Ice Cream
recipes.description: Rich malted milk ice cream made with malt powder, perfect for serving with chocolate desserts.

recipes.title: Marcona Almond Brittle
recipes.description: Simple nut brittle made with Marcona almonds. Marcona almonds, native to Spain, are rounded, more delicate, and an upscale version of the nut that elevates this simple brittle.

recipes.title: Caramel-Filled Chocolate Molten Cakes
recipes.description: Hot-from-the-oven molten chocolate cake envelops a core of melty caramel, bringing an already luxurious treat to a new level of decadence. A second and third shot of caramel - caramel ice cream, followed by a drizzle of additional caramel - finishes the dish. This flavorful caramel is based on real butter, cream, and sugar; the addition of corn syrup keeps the caramel soft. The caramel is formed into balls and frozen before adding to the batter so it melts slowly as it bakes into the cakes, revealing a sticky-sweet treat when you dig in.

recipes.title: Caramel Filling
recipes.description: Soft caramel filling for chocolate molten cakes. Based on real butter, cream, and sugar, with corn syrup to keep the caramel soft. Formed into balls and frozen before inserting into cake batter.

recipes.title: Raspberry Crémeux Tart with Sablé Breton Crust and Raspberry Sorbet
recipes.description: Crémeux (French for 'creamy') is a rich pudding made from chocolate or fruit. This raspberry version is enriched with egg yolks and butter, poured into a sablé Breton crust from Brittany, France.

recipes.title: Mixed Berry Parfait with Pastry Cream and Shortbread Cookies
recipes.description: This dessert highlights four types of berries set against simple pastry cream and fancied up with champagne syrup. A great use for champagne that's lost its fizz.

recipes.title: Pastry Cream
recipes.description: Classic crème pâtissière - a thick custard made with milk, sugar, and egg yolks.

recipes.title: Raspberry Fritters
recipes.description: Light, crispy fritters filled with fresh raspberries and rolled in sugar. Simple and delicious.

recipes.title: Coconut White Chocolate Panna Cotta with Champagne Syrup and Tropical Fruit
recipes.description: Silky coconut and white chocolate panna cotta served with ginger-champagne syrup and fresh tropical fruit.

recipes.title: Vanilla Bean Cheesecake
recipes.description: Classic New York-style cheesecake based in cream cheese, flavored only with vanilla and set into a simple crisp graham cracker crust. Baked in a water bath (bain-marie) until just set with a bit of wiggle.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Ice Cream, Caramelized Apples, and Walnut Sablé
recipes.description: Cinnamon, apples, and walnuts are natural partners. This dessert offers a play on the apple crumble effect: apples are caramelized, topped with cinnamon-infused ice cream, and finished with a buttery, crumbly walnut sablé.

recipes.title: Walnut Sablé Cookies
recipes.description: French shortbread-style cookies with toasted walnuts.

recipes.title: Passion Fruit Tart with Buttermilk Sherbet
recipes.description: Most of us are familiar with lemon curd; passion fruit curd, the base of this tart, is something a little different but shares lemon's sweet-tart taste profile. Passion fruit is a tropical fruit that's colored yellow to dark purple depending on its stage of ripeness; its unassuming exterior reveals impressive sacs of edible dark-colored seeds encased in a yellow-orange pulpy juice. The curd from the fruit is set into a sweet pastry base and the tart is topped with a scoop of tangy-sweet and refreshing buttermilk sherbet.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Sherbet
recipes.description: Tangy-sweet and refreshing buttermilk sherbet, perfect for serving with fruit tarts.

recipes.title: Passion Fruit Curd
recipes.description: Silky passion fruit curd for tarts and desserts. Similar to lemon curd but with the distinctive sweet-tart tropical flavor of passion fruit.

recipes.title: Sweet Tart Dough
recipes.description: Sweet tart dough enriched with sugar for dessert tarts. Makes one 9-inch tart or five 4 1/2-inch mini-tarts.

recipes.title: Chocolate Caramel Tart with Caramelized Banana Ice Cream
recipes.description: Chocolate, caramel, and banana are a divinely sweet match. The crust is no more than graham cracker crumbs bound together with butter, the caramel and chocolate aren't difficult to master. Store-bought banana ice cream works too.

recipes.title: Pineapple Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: The classic French upside-down tart made with caramelized pineapple instead of apples. Serve immediately while warm.

recipes.title: Lemon Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: Classic crème brûlée with a bright lemon twist. The same setup as for cheesecake - baked in a water bath (bain-marie) until just set with a wobble.

recipes.title: White Pepper Ice Cream
recipes.description: Unexpectedly delicious ice cream with a subtle kick of white pepper.

recipes.title: Bananas Foster
recipes.description: A classic restaurant dessert with bananas cooked in cinnamon-spiced, brown-sugar-sweetened cream, then flambeed with rum for drama and depth of flavor.

recipes.title: Coconut Layer Cake
recipes.description: A classic Southern coconut cake with fantastically moist layers sandwiched with snow-white frosting and anointed with sweetened flaked coconut.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake with Mascarpone Frosting
recipes.description: A Southern-style red velvet cake with chocolate flavor, topped with fresh Italian mascarpone frosting and fresh berries for a fruity finish.

recipes.title: Fig Bread Pudding with White Pepper Ice Cream
recipes.description: A classic bread pudding with a figgy twist, served with white pepper ice cream that inserts a note of heat to a sweet ice cream custard base.

recipes.title: Berry Pudding Panna Cotta
recipes.description: An innovative take on the classic cooked-cream dessert, this panna cotta is enriched with creme fraiche and poured over cubes of cake and berry compote to set into three distinct layers. The raspberry granita makes for a cooling, sweet, and tangy finish.

recipes.title: Chocolate Empanadas with Macerated Strawberries
recipes.description: The Latin American pastry pocket known as the empanada gets a sweet twist. These empanadas are filled with Kahlua-spiked chocolate ganache and topped with strawberries made tipsy with tequila, for a unique dessert that brings chocolate and berries together.

recipes.title: Chocolate Molten Cake with Malted Milk Ice Cream and Marcona Almond Brittle
recipes.description: Chocolate molten cake, served piping hot and oozing with rich melted chocolate, is an ever-popular celebration food - a perennial choice for birthdays, anniversaries, and other milestones. Marcona almonds, native to Spain, are a rounded, more delicate, and upscale version of the nut and elevate the simple brittle that crowns the cakes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Tart with White Chocolate Ganache
recipes.description: A beautiful blueberry tart consisting of a sweet-tart crust topped with a lightly spiced pastry cream, all covered with sweet white chocolate ganache that sets a layer of fresh blueberries in place on top.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Tart
recipes.description: Based on lemon curd, an intensely lemony English dessert topping that uses both the juice and zest of the fruit, this classic tart is a rich yet light palate cleanser, perfect after a heavy meal. The curd is set into a base of sweet pastry and topped with a delicate, fluffy meringue topping. For a final hit of lemon, the tart is topped with a scoop of lemon sorbet. If Meyer lemons are available, you might want to try them out in your curd; this cross between a lemon and mandarin is sweeter and less acidic than a standard lemon, and its delicate floral aroma makes it a fruit worth seeking out when in season.

recipes.title: No-Bake Easter Basket Cake
recipes.description: A totally edible Easter basket cake made with frozen poundcakes, decorated with store-bought cookies and candy.

recipes.title: Frosty Orange Delight
recipes.description: A frozen orange cream cheese dessert on a basic crust, inspired from a winner in Pillsbury's 21st Bake-Off.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Rich, fudgy, chocolatey brownies that come together in under an hour. A great base to add nuts, caramel, or serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Sunflower Cookies
recipes.description: These cookies are a hit at our Indigenous Food Lab events. They're great for the lunchbox or the hiking trail.

recipes.title: Autumn Harvest Cookies
recipes.description: These cookies are among the most requested at our events. They're rustic yet tender, not too sweet, and loaded with good things. They are perfect after school or before a hike.

recipes.title: Corn Cookies
recipes.description: These make terrific sandwich cookies filled with berry jams, sunflower butter, or our sorbet.

recipes.title: Amaranth Bites
recipes.description: Amaranth bites are simple to make, and they satisfy a sweet craving. They are loosely based on alegría, a popular Mexican confection of popped amaranth bound with honey.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Bites
recipes.description: Cacao originated with the Olmec people of ancient Mexico, more than three thousand years ago. The Maya cultivated cacao in the Yucatán and used the seeds to make a drink they called chocolatl. It was made by grinding toasted cacao seeds with water and seasonings. Drinking chocolate was reserved for the warrior class and the nobility—this was the beverage that Hernando Cortés was served when he visited the court of Montezuma. Here we've combined pecans with dark chocolate for a sweet and crunchy dessert. Don't tell anyone how easy they are to make.

recipes.title: Acorn and Wild Rice Cakes
recipes.description: These little cakes are great served with fresh berries and whipped cream or a drizzle of Wojape, page 173, or Raspberry-Rose-Hip Sauce, page 142.

recipes.title: Popped Amaranth Cakes (Alegría)
recipes.description: Alegría, Spanish for 'joy,' describes these popped amaranth confections perfectly. They're a popular street food in Mexico City, where vendors sell them in all shapes and sizes. This is a fun project for kids—a healthy version of the familiar crispy treat.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Pudding
recipes.description: This pudding is especially good topped with our berry sauces, page 142, and a dollop of fresh whipped cream.

recipes.title: Sunflower Milk Sorbet
recipes.description: This sorbet is creamy, nutty, and delicious. It's wonderful on its own or topped with fresh berries. Sunflower seeds are rich in healthy fats and give this sorbet a lovely, light texture.

recipes.title: Sweet Corn Sorbet
recipes.description: This sorbet captures the essence of summer. It's best made at the height of corn season when the corn is at its sweetest.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Maple Sorbet
recipes.description: This sorbet has a rich, nutty flavor that pairs beautifully with chocolate or fresh berries.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Sorbet
recipes.description: This unique sorbet has a subtle, earthy flavor that's quite special. It's wonderful served with fresh berries or a drizzle of Wojape.

recipes.title: Maple Squash Sorbet with Cranberry Sauce
recipes.description: This sorbet celebrates the flavors of autumn. The sweet squash and tangy cranberry sauce make a perfect pair.

recipes.title: Maple Brûléed Squash with Blueberries
recipes.description: This elegant dessert features roasted squash topped with maple sugar and torched until caramelized, then finished with fresh blueberries.

recipes.title: J.D. Kinlacheeny's Chilchin (Sumac) Pudding
recipes.description: This traditional Navajo pudding uses sumac berries to create a tangy, lemony dessert. The recipe comes from J.D. Kinlacheeny, shared by Chef Brian Tatsukawa.
