recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: This easy recipe for slow-cooker honey garlic chicken features boneless, skinless chicken thighs simmered to tender perfection in a sticky, sweet and tangy honey garlic sauce.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Marry Me Chicken
recipes.description: Spend less time at the stove and more time with your honey by making flavorful slow-cooker marry me chicken.

recipes.title: Smash Burger Tacos
recipes.description: Smash burger tacos combine the best of two favorite foods into one viral recipe. Featuring crispy-edged beef patties, a creamy pickle-spiked sauce and toasted flour tortillas, they're the tacos of our dreams.

recipes.title: Smothered Chicken Breasts
recipes.description: After trying a similar chicken dish in a restaurant, I decided to re-create it at home. Topped with bacon, caramelized onions and shredded cheese, this savory dish comes together in no time, and uses ingredients that I usually have on hand. And since it cooks in one skillet, it’s a cinch to clean up!

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Barley Chowder
recipes.description: Mashed squash helps make this chowder creamy but not heavy, and it's a favorite way to get barley on the table. My kids even ask for leftovers for lunch.

recipes.title: Soy Sauce Chicken
recipes.description: Soy sauce chicken is a speedy dinner made by simmering boneless skinless chicken thighs in soy sauce, wine, aromatics and spices.

recipes.title: Spaghetti all’Assassina (Assassin’s Spaghetti)
recipes.description: When you bite into this spaghetti, it bites back! Spaghetti all'assassina is spicy and slow-simmered in a thick chili and garlic tomato sauce.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Squash Pizzas
recipes.description: These easy spaghetti squash pizzas are a fantastic way to lighten up pizza night at your house.

recipes.title: Spicy Tomato Pork Chops
recipes.description: Simmered in tomato sauce, these pork chops are big at our house. I add garlic powder and Creole or Cajun seasoning before browning the chops to give them extra punch.

recipes.title: Chicken with Spinach and Mushrooms
recipes.description: Savor tender bites of chicken with spinach and mushrooms, a quick and easy dish that's healthy, tasty and perfect for busy weeknight dinners. Enjoy it over rice or pasta for a complete meal.

recipes.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip Soup
recipes.description: This spinach artichoke dip soup transforms creamy and cheesy spinach artichoke dip into a rich, veggie-packed, bright and brothy soup.

recipes.title: Beef Pot Pie
recipes.description: Save this beef pot pie recipe for chilly nights. The generously meaty filling will warm you right up.

recipes.title: Stuffed Ham
recipes.description: With its green vegetable-swirled filling, stuffed ham is a local favorite in St. Mary’s County, Maryland.

recipes.title: How to Cook a Ham
recipes.description: Whip up a gorgeous holiday centerpiece with this easy glazed ham recipe. Our Test Kitchen experts share their best tips and tricks for how to cook a ham for special occasions.

recipes.title: Sunshine Poached Salmon
recipes.description: You'll most likely already have all the ingredients in your cupboard to make this quick salmon recipe. My husband is a picky eater, but even he loves the sweet and slight heat flavors that come through.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: After my first child was born, I needed meals that were satisfying and fast. This easy chicken fried rice is now part of our regular dinner rotation.

recipes.title: Sushi Bake
recipes.description: Forget about buying a fancy maki kit. You can enjoy the great taste of sushi at home with this easy sushi bake recipe.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Chowder
recipes.description: Thanks to sweet potatoes, pancetta, cream and kale, this sweet potato chowder is so comforting and flavorful!

recipes.title: Tacos al Pastor
recipes.description: Our tacos al pastor recipe features juicy pork marinated in a sweet, smoky, chili-spiced adobo sauce, then grilled to perfection.

recipes.title: Tam To’s Korean Spicy Braised Chicken
recipes.description: This Korean spicy braised chicken is a healthier, flavor-packed alternative to fried chicken. It’s tender, juicy and simmered in a rich gochujang-based sauce that’s comforting and gives a bit of a kick! Made in just one pot, this protein-rich meal comes together in under 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Tangy Grilled Pineapple Chicken
recipes.description: This juicy grilled pineapple chicken recipe brings summery, tropical flavor to the table.

recipes.title: Burritos
recipes.description: Packed with beans, your choice of protein and a myriad of other potential fillings, this easy burrito recipe is your launchpad to unlimited flavor combinations.

recipes.title: Steak Diane
recipes.description: Sometimes, I add more mushrooms to this recipe when my son's eating dinner

recipes.title: Tofu and Veggie Buddha Bowl With Miso Dressing
recipes.description: This is a healthy, colorful, one-bowl meal for those looking to mix things up in the kitchen. It's loaded with cabbage, mushrooms, radishes and carrots. Serve either warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Tofu Tacos
recipes.description: Tofu tacos get a bold upgrade with a chili-spiced marinade and a high-heat roast that delivers crisp, golden edges.

recipes.title: Tomato & Garlic Butter Bean Dinner
recipes.description: On the days I get home late and just want a warm meal, I stir together tomatoes, garlic and butter beans. Ladle it over noodles if you're in the mood for pasta.

recipes.title: Tomato-Poached Halibut
recipes.description: My halibut with a burst of lemon comes together in one pan and stays super moist. Try it with polenta, angel hair pasta or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Tropical Veggie Quinoa Bowl with Citrus-Basil Dressing
recipes.description: A trip to the farmers market inspired this veggie quinoa bowl. The sweetness of the mango complements the tangy citrus dressing, while the creamy avocado adds a rich texture.

recipes.title: Turkey Gyros
recipes.description: Greek seasoning, feta cheese and dill-cucumber sauce give this gyro an authentic taste. It was my family's introduction to how really good pita bread can be. Instead of feta cheese, we'll sprinkle on cheddar or Monterey Jack if we have it.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Salad
recipes.description: I discovered this taco salad while I was on a health kick. My husband and I love it now. When I served it at a family birthday party, everyone eagerly asked for the recipe.

recipes.title: Turkish Pasta
recipes.description: This Turkish pasta is TikTok famous for a reason. The dish is a tasty combination of pasta, seasoned ground beef and tangy yogurt, all drizzled with a flavorful paprika butter sauce.

recipes.title: Tyler Smith’s Ritz Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.description: There is nothing that gives you the feels of being at home more than a nostalgic meal you grew up with. This Ritz chicken and mashed potatoes recipe is just the thing! It's a simple baked chicken dish packed with lots of savory flavor.

recipes.title: Vegan Red Beans and Rice
recipes.description: You'll never miss the meat with this vegan red beans and rice recipe. Filled with aromatics, spices and vegetable broth, it's a perfect centerpiece to a southern meal.

recipes.title: Vegan Scalloped Potatoes
recipes.description: Our vegan scalloped potatoes are cheesy, creamy and luxuriously decadent

recipes.title: Vegan Stroganoff
recipes.description: This vegan Stroganoff is a cozy, plant-based twist on the classic dish, featuring tender mushrooms in a tangy, creamy sauce. Serve it over hot noodles for a hearty meal.

recipes.title: Veggie-Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
recipes.description: I made this one night when I wanted spaghetti squash, but it was too hot to turn on the oven. Filled with peppers, tomatoes and cheese, this tasty spaghetti squash cooks perfectly in the air fryer.

recipes.title: Adana Kabob
recipes.description: Made with the essential trio of lamb, cumin and dried chile peppers, Adana kabob is succulent and perfectly spiced. Serve the grilled Turkish ground lamb kabobs with a bright sumac onion salad.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Plantains
recipes.description: These air-fryer plantains are a healthier twist on the classic, delivering all the flavor and texture you love, just with less oil and mess. Best of all, a batch is ready in just 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Alex Bala’s Crispy Potato Shrimp & Grits Minis
recipes.description: Crispy, creamy, cheesy and loaded with flavor, these shrimp and grit bites turn a southern classic into a bite-sized showstopper. Each one starts with a golden potato base and is then topped with a velvety creamy grits sauce filled with savory ham and perfectly seasoned shrimp. These bites are perfect for brunch, holidays or whenever you want an appetizer that disappears instantly.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble Kugel
recipes.description: I received an apple crumble recipe from my sister and combined it with kugel. A crumb topping enhances this brunch-style treat!

recipes.title: Arroz Verde con Pollo
recipes.description: This Peruvian-style recipe is hands-off and surprisingly family-friendly

recipes.title: Banoffee Pie
recipes.description: Need a showstopper dessert that doesn't require baking the day away? This banoffee pie recipe is the answer.

recipes.title: Hummus
recipes.description: Once you learn how to make hummus from scratch, you'll never want to go back to store-bought dip!

recipes.title: Blackberry Margarita
recipes.description: The blackberry margarita is a fun twist on a classic margarita. It gets its citrusy flavor from lime juice and triple sec, and homemade blackberry syrup adds a fruity finish and a gorgeous purple hue.

recipes.title: Braided Round Challah
recipes.description: I made this for a surprise for one of my friends on a Jewish holiday. She could not believe how amazing the bread turned out!

recipes.title: Brazilian Lemonade
recipes.description: After you try this cool and refreshing Brazilian lemonade recipe, it will become your summertime staple for sipping.

recipes.title: Brazilian Pork & Black Bean Stew
recipes.description: During high school, I spent a year in Brazil and fell in love with the culture and food. One of my favorite dishes was feijoada, a chili/stew served over white rice. I introduced this easy recipe to my family, and it has become one of our favorite comfort foods.

recipes.title: Brown Bag Apple Pie
recipes.description: This retro brown bag apple pie features a flaky double crust and a spiced apple filling. Baking it in a paper bag is the secret to a crisp, golden crust and tender, juicy apples every time.

recipes.title: Caipirinha
recipes.description: A proper caipirinha recipe needs three things: lime, sugar cubes and Brazil's national spirit, cachaça. This refreshing cocktail tastes like the perfect day at a Brazilian beach, even if you sip it in your backyard.

recipes.title: Chai Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.description: Lean into cozy fall mornings with a breakfast to match. These chai cinnamon rolls are a latte and a pastry baked into one.

recipes.title: Chaider
recipes.description: Chaider is the versatile fall drink that plays just as well at brunch as it does at happy hour. Spike it or sip it straight!

recipes.title: Chicago Hot Dogs
recipes.description: Whether you're a purist, a historian or just really hungry, our Chicago hot dogs recipe is a home run.

recipes.title: Beef Empanadas
recipes.description: Our Chilean-inspired beef empanada recipe is a great place to start when learning how to make beef empanadas. We’ll show you how to crimp and seal the dough and how to keep your empanadas from falling apart, with plenty of tips for other fillings and flavors.

recipes.title: Chilean Monkey Tail Punch
recipes.description: Stories vary surrounding the origins of this punch's unique name. Some say it was initially served in a bottle depicting a monkey with a long tail, but others suggest it was named after a funny incident with a Chilean president in the early 1900s. Whatever the origin, coffee and spirits will make this sweet chilled drink warm you right up this Christmas. It also goes by "cola de mono."

recipes.title: Chimichurri Chicken
recipes.description: Chimichurri chicken is an Argentinian-style dish bursting with herbs and garlic. Serve it as a fast main course that's out of the ordinary.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Covered Matzo
recipes.description: Chocolate-covered matzo is layered with toffee, melted chocolate and a sprinkle of sea salt for a classic Passover dessert. No Passover Seder is complete without it!

recipes.title: Chocolate Rugelach
recipes.description: This chocolate rugelach recipe gives the classic light, flaky and bite-sized pastries a twist with a chocolatey filling. This nuanced and downright delicious dessert would be a wonderful addition to any party.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice
recipes.description: Upgrade your dinner with a side of coconut rice, an easy side dish that brings a dose of tropical flavor to your plate.

recipes.title: Coffee Granita
recipes.description: When you're craving a refreshing frozen treat, a simple coffee granita hits the spot.

recipes.title: Coffee Jelly
recipes.description: Coffee jelly is an elegant three-ingredient dessert for dinner parties or date nights in. This fun Jell-O variation is perfect for coffee lovers.

recipes.title: Copycat Bounty Chocolate Bites
recipes.description: Bounty is a coconut-filled chocolate bar made by Mars. These copycat chocolate bites take that same concept and mold them into bite-sized pieces with one exception: graham crackers! They add a bit of sweetness and texture to the chewy treat.

recipes.title: Creamy Apricot Stuffed Dates
recipes.description: These delightful date bites are ridiculously easy to create. They always hit the sweet spot, whether served as an appetizer or dessert.

recipes.title: Creole Shrimp and Sausage
recipes.description: This Creole shrimp and sausage recipe is hearty, flavorful and on the table in 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crunchy Cheesy Crisps
recipes.description: I found a recipe in one of my cookbooks, which I've had for quite some time, and tweaked it to make these cracker-like crisps. They go well with any dip or spread.

recipes.title: Cuban Sandwich
recipes.description: This Cuban sandwich isn't your typical sub sandwich. With two kinds of pork, melted Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard pressed between two toasty pieces of bread, the picture-perfect Cubano will have you wanting more.

recipes.title: Cucumber Margarita
recipes.description: This four-ingredient cucumber margarita is cool, refreshing and perfectly balanced. Learn how to upgrade a classic margarita with homemade cucumber juice (no juicer necessary!).

recipes.title: Cumin-Spiced Lentil Burgers
recipes.description: I adapted my Turkish daughter-in-law’s traditional recipe for lentil logs

recipes.title: Earl Grey Tiramisu
recipes.description: Earl Grey tiramisu is a wonderfully unexpected fall dessert, with plenty of floral and citrusy flavor.

recipes.title: Elise Jesse’s Avocado Shrimp Tartlets
recipes.description: This avocado shrimp tartlet is a bold bite-sized appetizer that combines heat with a creamy twist. A smooth blend of ripe avocado, cream cheese and fresh lime juice is whipped to perfection, then piped into crisp golden phyllo shells for a light, buttery base. Each tartlet is crowned with a juicy Cajun seasoning-dusted shrimp, then finished with a spoonful of pico de gallo and a sprinkle of cilantro. It’s rich, zesty and irresistibly flavorful. These are perfect for summer soirées or an elevated appetizer spread!

recipes.title: Elise Jesse’s Philly Cheesesteak Zucchini Boats
recipes.description: If you're craving the bold, savory flavors of a classic Philly cheesesteak but want something a little lighter for summer, these Philly cheesesteak zucchini boats are the answer. I make them with tender slices of NY strip steak and sauteed bell peppers, onions and mushrooms, all tucked into roasted zucchini halves and topped with melted provolone. It's a healthy twist on the sandwich we know and love, without sacrificing flavor. This dish is hearty, satisfying and weeknight-friendly.

recipes.title: Everything Bagel Lox Brunch Pizza
recipes.description: I took my favorite brunch flavors and put them all on this pizza! An everything bagel layered with smoked salmon, briny capers, herby cheese and tangy pickled onions makes pure magic. It’s a good way to feed a crowd.

recipes.title: Falafel
recipes.description: This authentic falafel recipe uses dried beans that are simply soaked

recipes.title: Pumpkin Falafel
recipes.description: Falafel is the ultimate Middle Eastern street food. Pumpkin adds a light sweetness and keeps the patties moist while baking. Top these beauties with a sweet and savory maple tahini sauce. You can serve them sandwich-style, as an appetizer over a bed of greens, or with soup and salad.

recipes.title: Feta Bruschetta
recipes.description: Fun to say and tasty to eat, feta bruschetta is an easy, flavor-packed appetizer with herbs, spices and tangy cheese in every toasted bite.

recipes.title: Feta-Stuffed Kibbeh with Harissa
recipes.description: There are countless versions of this delicious dish throughout the Middle East. This is our adaptation. You can substitute ground beef for the lamb.

recipes.title: Godfather Cocktail
recipes.description: If you love Scotch, you need to try a classic Godfather cocktail.

recipes.title: Green Shakshuka
recipes.description: Silky sauteed greens with garlic and feta are the foundation for this green shakshuka, a reimagined version of the classic North African egg dish. A side of crusty bread is a must.

recipes.title: Grilled Eggplant with Fig, Feta and Walnuts
recipes.description: This recipe checks all the flavor boxes: sweet, savory, spicy and acidic. It can be a vegetarian Mediterranean main dish or side. Add a little prosciutto or a sprinkle of fresh parsley for even more flavor.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Hazelnut Babka Buns
recipes.description: Chocolate-hazelnut babka buns are a bit of a project, but with eight beautifully wrapped brioche buns filled with Nutella, halva and chocolate chips, I’d say they’re more than worth it.

recipes.title: Harissa
recipes.description: You've probably seen this North African ingredient in recipes for hummus, seafood, sauces and more. But if you're wondering, What is harissa? then it's time to learn all about this flavorful chile paste.

recipes.title: Herby Chicken with Apricots and Feta
recipes.description: Mix up your weeknight menu with a flavorful braised chicken dish with Middle Eastern flair. I love to serve it with couscous.

recipes.title: Hetal Vasavada’s Iced Chai
recipes.description:
I grew up watching my Ba (grandmother) brew chai every single day, adjusting the spices by instinct and never measuring a thing. This iced chai is my simpler summer version of her classic recipe, using strong CTC tea, crushed cardamom and cinnamon. CTC tea stands for Crush, Tear, Curl, a method that turns black tea leaves into tiny granules of tea. It brews quickly and delivers a strong, tannic flavor that’s the backbone of authentic Indian chai. Leave your expensive whole tea leaves for another day: If you’re making chai, you have to use CTC tea. Lipton's black tea is a good option.

To make this chai as traditional as possible, I prefer a higher ratio of milk to water. It creates a richer chai with tons of body. Unlike the weak, sugary chai you’ll find at many cafes, this one is bold, creamy and deeply spiced

recipes.title: Hetal Vasavada’s Matchai Tiramisu
recipes.description: This matcha and chai (matchai!) tiramisu blends the earthy bitterness of matcha with the warm, spiced comfort of chai. The tiramisu is layered into coupe glasses, so it’s the perfect no-bake dessert that feels fancy but comes together without a fuss.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Churros
recipes.description: Our air-fryer churro recipe is made for those wanting the sweet treat without all the oil or messy cleanup. Skip the frying!

recipes.title: Homemade Chili Crisp
recipes.description: With just a few minutes of cooking and a handful of pantry ingredients, you can make a spicy, crunchy homemade chili crisp to spoon over everything.

recipes.title: Gefilte Fish
recipes.description: This is not your bubbe's gefilte fish! Our step-by-step homemade gefilte fish recipe will make you forget that store-bought jar ever existed.

recipes.title: Homemade Gelt
recipes.description: Skip the grocery store gelt! Instead try this quick and easy homemade gelt that will wow all of your Hanukkah guests.

recipes.title: Hot Apricot Chai Cocktail
recipes.description: This lovely wintertime cocktail is a hit with my friends for its rich flavor and easy prep. I like to garnish it with a slice of orange.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Collard Greens
recipes.description: Classic Southern comfort food, made fast. Instant Pot collard greens transform the robust leaves into a silky, tender side studded with smoky bacon and sprinkled with hot sauce.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cuban Chicken
recipes.description: I just love the flavors of Cuban food. With lots of citrus, garlic, cilantro and spices, it is something I could eat every day. I found I could create the slow-cooked flavor using my pressure cooker, and my family is now eating Cuban food a lot more.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Puerto Rican Pernil
recipes.description: Imagine this: You're sitting on the beach, sun shining, waves crashing and a mojito in your hand when the most wonderful aroma wafts over to you. It's a citrusy, spicy, and mouthwatering pork roast more flavorful than anything you've ever had. Cooking and eating this should remind you of the best parts of island life. It's OK to use fresh-squeezed orange juice, lime juice, or a combination of both instead of grapefruit juice. But please, don't ever make this with bottled juice.

recipes.title: Israeli Malabi with Pomegranate Syrup
recipes.description: This is a very famous, easy-to-make sweet milk pudding from Israel. For this recipe, I learned from a friend, you can use rose syrup instead of pomegranate syrup.

recipes.title: Jamaican Cabbage and Saltfish
recipes.description: This Jamaican cabbage and saltfish recipe is a quick and healthy dish that feels like a slice of home. Perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner, this low-calorie meal is full of flavor.

recipes.title: Jamaican Oxtail
recipes.description: Jamaican oxtail is a dish that deserves all the love and adoration it gets. Enjoy a perfectly tender and flavorful oxtail experience with this recipe. It may take a few extra hours in the kitchen, but the end result is always delectable. Instead of the beef broth, you can add hot water and slowly cook the oxtails. To deglaze your pot after searing the meat you can opt to use a quarter cup of red wine.

recipes.title: Jerk Chicken
recipes.description: Transport your taste buds to the sunny Caribbean with this easy and flavorful Jamaican jerk chicken recipe.

recipes.title: Jojo Potatoes
recipes.description: Jojo potatoes are coated in a savory blend of spices, then deep-fried until crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.

recipes.title: Korean Chicken Crunch Wrap
recipes.description: Korean chicken crunch wraps are an everything-but-the-kitchen-sink recipe that takes odds and ends and turns them into something exciting.

recipes.title: Lebanese Street Sandwiches
recipes.description: Arayes are grilled Lebanese-style pitas that are stuffed with a seasoned meat mixture. They're commonly found throughout the food stalls that line the streets of Beirut. If you'd rather not use a grill, they can be baked in the oven or made in a panini press too.

recipes.title: Lucy Wang’s Easy KBBQ
recipes.description: Depending where you live, you may not have access to amazing Korean barbecue restaurants. I grew up in the suburbs of Maryland, and the good Korean spots are in Virginia

recipes.title: Lucy Wang’s Mini Omakase
recipes.description: Omakase, which means trust me, is a Japanese serving style where the customer entrusts the sushi chef to prepare an amazing multi-course menu. The menu isn't written ahead of time, so each bite is a surprise

recipes.title: Lucy Wang’s Rainbow Mochi Rice Krispies
recipes.description: Rainbow mochi Rice Krispies is an Asian-inspired twist on a classic treat. Mochi is made of rice flour, so this whole sheet is gluten-free!

recipes.title: Lucy Wang’s Zongzi
recipes.description: This traditional Chinese dish ties back to a true story of a beloved poet named Qu Yuan who was wrongfully accused of treason. People commemorate him each year on the fifth day of the fifth month on the Lunar calendar (usually toward the end of May or June), with dragon boat festivities and these bamboo leaves stuffed with sticky rice and pork belly. Cook a ton of these in advance and keep them in a zip-top bag in the freezer. Thaw them in the fridge overnight and microwave for two minutes in the leaves, or boil them for 10 to 15 minutes directly from the freezer. You can get the leaves on Amazon. Everything else can be found at a local Asian market like HMart.

recipes.title: Lucy Wang’s Hanami Dango
recipes.description: The Sakura Matsuri, also known as the Cherry Blossom Festival, celebrates the spring season! These squishy treats make adorable drink garnishes and are a great kids' activity (they're basically nontoxic play dough and a lot less messy). If you want to prep them in advance, make the balls but don’t boil them just yet! Sprinkle a little glutinous rice flour on them and freeze them in an airtight container. Boil them right before you plan to serve them.

recipes.title: Macaroni Pie
recipes.description: Barbados-style macaroni pie blends hot sauce, ketchup, mustard, fresh herbs and three types of cheese for a side dish that goes with pretty much everything.

recipes.title: Malfouf
recipes.description: Malfouf, also known as Lebanese cabbage rolls, is a delicacy in the Middle East. Not only are cabbage rolls delicious, but they dress up any table with their beautiful presentation.

recipes.title: Matzo Balls
recipes.description: This matzo ball recipe will teach you how to make this essential Passover food. We make our matzo balls from scratch with a few simple ingredients, including baking powder and seltzer, to create a light and airy texture.

recipes.title: Matzo Brei
recipes.description: Matzo brei, or eggs fried with matzo, is a less-well-known but still classic Passover dish that you'll want to have for breakfast all year long.

recipes.title: Moroccan Apricot Chicken
recipes.description: Chili sauce, apricots and Moroccan seasoning create an incredible sauce for slow-cooked chicken thighs. Traditional Moroccan apricot chicken typically includes chili pepper paste, but I use chili sauce in my version.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Chicken Sliders
recipes.description: This recipe is great for both fast and easy weeknight dinners and for entertaining! Ras el hanout is a mixture of ground spices that typically includes various peppers, cardamom, ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, turmeric and mace. It can be found in the spice section of well-stocked supermarkets. For a more peppery slider, substitute baby arugula for the leaf lettuce.

recipes.title: Mother’s Day Ham
recipes.description: After one bite, my husband informed me this slow-cooker ham was the best I've ever made. I invented it because I’m always buying international condiments and finding ways to use them. Sumac is the secret ingredient here.

recipes.title: Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.description: Golden, gooey and perfectly seasoned, these homemade mozzarella sticks are fail-proof. You'll fall in love with this recipe.

recipes.title: Feijoada
recipes.description: Feijoada is a delicious black bean stew that's Brazil's national dish. We make our feijoada recipe in the slow cooker with four kinds of meat and lots of tender black beans.

recipes.title: Nana Reba's Potato Knishes
recipes.description: I grew up eating these potato knishes every holiday. My grandmother had to show up with at least four dozen because they were devoured within minutes! I haven't changed her recipe other than to use ready-made pie crusts. You can use cooked ground beef or lamb as well.

recipes.title: Oaxacan Coffee
recipes.description: Fans of tequila, Scotch whisky or Irish coffee will smack their lips when you serve them a warm, mezcal-spiked Oaxacan coffee.

recipes.title: Orange Apricot Couscous Chicken
recipes.description: I love the bright flavors in this recipe. The orange juice, curry powder, feta and mint really jazz up the rest of the ingredients! Once the ingredients are assembled, this recipe comes together in no time. If you like, you can use large cubed peaches or nectarines instead of apricots.

recipes.title: Pacoca
recipes.description: Pacoca (Brazilian peanut candy) is an easy treat that has only five ingredients! It's a popular sweet in Brazil, and after you try it, I'm sure you'll love it, too.

recipes.title: Pan de Jamon
recipes.description: Pan de jamon isn't just for Christmas

recipes.title: Passion Fruit Margarita
recipes.description: One sip of this passion fruit margarita will transport you to a tropical island. You don't need to leave home to feel as if you're on vacation!

recipes.title: Peach Bellini
recipes.description: This peach Bellini recipe makes hosting your next brunch a breeze. The gorgeous simplicity of homemade peach syrup and your favorite prosecco create a classic cocktail that starts the party right.

recipes.title: Pickle Canoes
recipes.description: I came up with this recipe when I was looking for a snack in my grandparents' fridge and saw these ingredients. Everyone in my family wanted to try my creation and said it was amazing.

recipes.title: Pink Pina Colada
recipes.description: Break out your blender and find some tiny umbrellas! This pink pina colada recipe provides a taste of the tropics that will get any summer celebration started.

recipes.title: Pisco Sour
recipes.description: Made with South American brandy, the pisco sour has a silky texture and tart, earthy flavor.

recipes.title: Planter’s Punch
recipes.description: If you like your Planter's Punch on the sweet side, add a splash of simple syrup to the shaker. A dash or two of bitters is sometimes added to this classic tropical cocktail.

recipes.title: Pomegranate Margarita
recipes.description: In cold weather months, a pomegranate margarita is the perfect drink. It brings tropical flavors to a classic cocktail

recipes.title: Potato Quesadillas
recipes.description: I made potato-rolled tacos all the time and wanted to switch it up, so I started making quesadillas out of my original recipe. I serve the creamy, crispy potato quesadillas with salsa and sour cream. For an extra surprise, serve homemade guacamole, too.

recipes.title: Rice Kheer
recipes.description: This delicately spiced and velvety smooth kheer recipe is made with simple pantry staples, and is great warmed or chilled.

recipes.title: Rose Water Rice Pudding
recipes.description: This rice pudding is a popular Middle Eastern treat. Pomegranate seeds and chopped pistachios add a simple yet elegant touch to this floral Lebanese specialty.

recipes.title: Rum Runner
recipes.description: One sip of a rum runner drink can trick you into thinking you’re enjoying an island paradise, especially if a colorful paper umbrella is involved.

recipes.title: Sausage and Bean Skillet with Crispy Plantains
recipes.description: I love a quick weeknight dinner, especially when the whole family loves it. This dish has tasty Caribbean flavors, and the plantain chips on top are a big hit. We love this with smoked sausage, but it's also delicious with spicy chicken sausage.

recipes.title: Sephardic Charoset
recipes.description: This Sephardic charoset is perfect for your Passover table and to have on hand throughout the week.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Curry Dinner
recipes.description: This sheet-pan chicken curry is a quick way to get a meal on the table without fuss. Everyone loves it, and it's healthy to boot! Serve it with a side of jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Skinny Margarita
recipes.description: This skinny margarita has plenty of fresh flavors with fewer calories. The lighter version of this classic cocktail skips the sugar and instead focuses on natural ingredients like lime and orange juice for its sweet taste.

recipes.title: Spicy Cantaloupe Bites
recipes.description: Juicy melon, tangy sauce and assorted peppers come together to create a sweet and spicy tidbit. Combine these peppered melon balls with plain melon for a refreshing salad.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Bourekas
recipes.description: These pastries are light and soft with a bit of crunch, and are one of my favorite appetizers for holidays. They can be filled with almost anything, but spinach and feta are my go-to fillings. Topped with everything seasoning, these little triangles are out of this world.

recipes.title: Spinach Frittata
recipes.description: Think of this spinach frittata

recipes.title: Squash Focaccia
recipes.description: This squash focaccia is a seasonal twist on the classic Italian bread. Layered with fall flavors, the easy-to-make bread is ideal for holiday spreads or cozy weeknight meals.

recipes.title: Steak Alfredo
recipes.description: Steak Alfredo pairs a juicy seared steak with rich and creamy pasta, putting a decadent twist on a classic. Add a crisp salad, and dinner is ready.

recipes.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding for Two
recipes.description: Make date night at home even more special by plating up sticky toffee pudding for two with homemade toffee sauce.

recipes.title: Strawberry Mojito
recipes.description: Make a fruity strawberry mojito with only a handful of fresh ingredients (and no special tools).

recipes.title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto
recipes.description: Sun-dried tomato pesto skips the basil and leans into the sweet and umami notes of oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Curry
recipes.description: This easy vegan sweet potato curry is a soul-filling meal that won't break the bank. To make it even heartier add extra vegetables, chickpeas or even meat.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Latkes
recipes.description: I have great memories of making this recipe for family holidays. Shredded russet potatoes can be used instead of sweet for a change of pace. Serve these with sour cream, applesauce or a sprinkling of chopped chives.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Tots
recipes.description: Air-fried sweet potato tots are a colorful, healthy snack or side that's crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.

recipes.title: Rum Punch
recipes.description: Nothing says "I'm on vacation" like a refreshing rum punch recipe. Here's how to make rum punch the classic way.

recipes.title: Syrian Green Beans with Fresh Herbs
recipes.description: This how my mom always made green beans. She got the recipe from a neighbor when we lived in Turkey. Make a double batch, as they make an excellent healthy snack straight from the fridge. Add a thinly sliced onion and red bell pepper if you like. You can also make them ahead and add to a salad.

recipes.title: Tahini Brownies
recipes.description: If you’ve never baked with tahini or halva before, these tahini brownies are a great introduction.

recipes.title: Tam To’s Char Siu Potato Balls
recipes.description: These char siu potato balls combine the best of two iconic favorites: the sweet and savory flavor of Chinese char siu barbecue pork with crispy Porto’s potato balls. Inspired by the famous Southern California bakery, this fusion recipe blends a tender meat filling with a crispy outer golden texture. The potato balls can be made in the air fryer, plus they’re freezer-friendly and guaranteed to be a favorite at gatherings.

recipes.title: Tam To’s Vietnamese Coffee Jelly
recipes.description: There's no better way to enjoy a normal cup of coffee than by turning it into jelly! Vietnamese coffee is known to be strong and is typically served as a light dessert, but it can be served in any shape or form. This unique spin turns it into Vietnamese coffee jelly with a drizzle of condensed milk on top.

recipes.title: Tyler Smith’s Cheesy Italian Shells
recipes.description: I'm taking you back in time with these classic cheesy, saucy shells. This updated version is bursting with flavor, thanks to a creamy vodka sauce packed with sirloin and Italian sausage.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.description: This herby cucumber-yogurt sauce tastes great on everything. Use our tzatziki recipe as a dip for chips and vegetables, as a condiment for sandwiches and wraps, or as a cool, refreshing sauce to liven up grilled meats and vegetables.

recipes.title: Watermelon Mojito
recipes.description: The classic mojito gets a refreshing upgrade with freshly-muddled watermelon.

recipes.title: Yuca Frita con Mojo
recipes.description: Who doesn’t love something fried? That’s how I first got turned on to yuca, and now I cook it regularly. It is a starchy tuber, similar in texture to a potato, and is served with a lovely garlicky orange dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Authentic Chimichurri (Uruguay & Argentina)
recipes.description: Authentic Chimichurri from Uruguay & Argentina is the best accompaniment to any barbecued or grilled meats! Also used to serve as a dressing on salads.

recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean Sweet Potato Enchiladas
recipes.description: Crunchy, saucy, spicy and cheesy! These enchiladas come together easily and are so delicious!

recipes.title: Basil Ranch Chicken and Bacon Quesadilla with Avocado
recipes.description: The perfect cheesy quesadillas to enjoy for lunch or dinner!

recipes.title: One Skillet Street Corn Chicken Enchilada Bake
recipes.description: A delicious twist on the combo of baked enchiladas and street corn that everyone will love!

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas with Creamy Chipotle Sauce
recipes.description: Made with leftover or store-bought rotisserie chicken...simple to make and so delicious!

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chipotle Cheddar Corn Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: The perfect weeknight meal made entirely on one sheet pan in less than an hour...your own little fiesta!

recipes.title: Weeknight Cheesy Baked Chipotle Chicken Tacos with Cilantro Lime Ranch.
recipes.description: Crunchy on the outside...spicy and cheesy inside. Serve each taco with a creamy, cooling cilantro lime ranch sauce, and a mix of your favorite taco toppings.

recipes.title: Spicy Chipotle Honey Salmon Bowls
recipes.description: Colorful and fresh, these bowls may seem involved but they're actually simple to make and full of so much flavor!

recipes.title: Crispy Carnitas Tacos with Roasted Jalapeño Lime Avocado
recipes.description: These tacos come together easily. They're slightly spicy, so cheesy, and so yummy!

recipes.title: Baked Cheesy Cuban Chicken Taquitos
recipes.description: Baked on a sheet pan until crispy...a delicious twist on a Mexican favorite with a bit of Cuban flavor!

recipes.title: One Skillet Cheesy Green Chile Chicken
recipes.description: Simple One Skillet Cheesy Green Chile Chicken: delicious saucy cheesy chicken that's all made in one pan, is no fuss, and is so quick and easy!

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Crispy Chicken Tacos with Roasted Jalapeño Sesame Verde
recipes.description: Perfectly seasoned chicken with a sauce that really completes it...easy and so delicious!

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Jalapeño Pineapple Shrimp Tacos with Cilantro Garlic Sauce
recipes.description: All made on just one sheet pan and in under 30 minutes!

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Poblano Chicken Fajita Bowls
recipes.description: These colorful chicken bowls are a simple delicious dinner - and made in under 45 minutes!

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken Fajitas with Creamy Jalapeño Verde Sauce.
recipes.description: Fresh, colorful, and tastes even better...it's that sauce, different but so delicious!

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Street Style Steak Tacos
recipes.description: These come together easily and are so delicious—smoky and spicy—even better than street tacos!

recipes.title: Chipotle pork and pineapple skewers
recipes.description: Inspired by the al pastor pork dish of central Mexico (see Know-how, below), this skewered version is a fab thing to throw on the barbecue. The fresh pineapple helps to tenderise the pork, which is given a smoky heat from the chipotle in the marinade. Discover more barbecue recipes from around the world.

recipes.title: Crispy Parma Ham breakfast tacos
recipes.description: Swap out your usual breakfast for these light and flavourful tacos filled with coriander and spring onion folded eggs, crispy Parma Ham, a touch of crumbled feta and, if you like it spicy, a fiery whack of hot sauce. Easy and exciting: Swap bacon for flavour-packed Parma Ham to add some interest to your breakfast; we’ve lightly fried it for a satisfying crispy texture.  Produced exclusively in Parma from Italian pork legs, this special ingredient is made without additives and also lends it

recipes.title: Elotes (Mexican-style street corn)
recipes.description: Corn on the cob is the sweet taste of summer – and these Mexican-style snacks take things to a different level with a zingy cheesy topping. Grilled corn on the cob slathered in mayo and cheese is sold from food carts across Mexico, but it’s just as good in your back garden… The mayonnaise is spiked with lime, garlic, coriander and spring onions, and we’ve replaced hard-to-find Mexican cheese, cotija, with a punchy mixture of feta and parmesan. We’ve used the sweetcorn husks to make pretty

recipes.title: Fish schnitzel with chipotle mayonnaise, pico de gallo and candied jalapeños
recipes.description: If you love a fish taco, you’ll love this Mexican-inspired schnitzel. Serve with creamy chipotle mayo, zesty pico de gallo and sweet-spicy pops of candied jalapeños. For a delicious vegetarian alternative, check out our aubergine parmigiana schnitzel recipe.

recipes.title: Smoky pork shoulder tacos
recipes.description: Tenderised with orange and pineapple juice, and flavoured with smoky chipotle and aromatics, this pork shoulder will shred apart. Pile it onto tacos alongside pickled onions, pico de gallo and hot sauce. This type of low-and-slow barbecuing is taken very seriously in the US, and can become a deep rabbit hole of science and technique. We’ve kept the recipe simple, but it’s worth exploring further online if you like the results. Discover more brilliant barbecue recipes.

recipes.title: Cóctel de Camaron
recipes.description: Cóctel de Camarón is a Mexican shrimp cocktail that combines juicy shrimp, a tangy tomato sauce, and a mix of fresh ingredients!

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: These Easy Chicken Enchiladas make the best Mexican dinner! They're stuffed with shredded chicken and cheese, topped with red enchilada sauce and baked.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: My all-time favorite chicken enchilada recipe! See notes above for possible ingredient variations.

recipes.title: Anticuchos de Corazon, Grilled Heart Skewers
recipes.description: This is a versatile recipe that works with more than just hearts. Any meat you want to eat on a skewer will do, including shrimp and lobster.

recipes.title: Peruvian Anticuchos de carne
recipes.description: A classic Peruvian recipe.

recipes.title: Anticuchos de carne (Peruvian marinated beef skewers)
recipes.description: Anticuchos are meat skewers marinated in an easy chili-based marinade - packed with flavor!

recipes.title: Peruvian Anticuchos Recipe
recipes.description: Peruvian Anticuchos (Grilled Skewers) are incredibly popular throughout Peru and South American countries. Not meant to be the main course, these tasty skewers are served as a side dish along with other dishes such as choripanes, potatoes, sausages, or salad.

recipes.title: Honey Walnut Trout
recipes.description: Fresh trout baked on a bed of onions and walnuts with honey and white wine.

recipes.description: Vintage Italian recipe

recipes.title: How to Make Fresh Pasta
recipes.description: In Emilia-Romagna, the region in Italy where fresh pasta rules, the dough is classically made with soft wheat flour and whole fresh eggs. Purists in the province prefer pasta doughs that have been rolled out on a wooden board to those rolled out with a machine, saying that sauce clings much better to the hand-rolled variety.

recipes.title: Classic Pasta Dough
recipes.description: Italians use soft wheat flour to make fresh pasta. We tested the recipe with soft wheat flour and all-purpose flour and tasted them side by side, and we much prefer the soft wheat version—it gives the pasta a silkier texture. Order Italian-style flour from www.kingarthurflour.com, or look for Italian 00 flour at gourmet or online stores. Use this dough to make Ravioli with Herbed Ricotta Filling (page 141).

recipes.title: Spanakopita (Greek Spinach Pie)
recipes.description: Flaky phyllo pastry filled with spinach and feta cheese. A beloved Greek savory pie.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
recipes.description: A simple Roman pasta with just three ingredients: pasta, Pecorino Romano, and black pepper. Deceptively simple, requires technique.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Gricia
recipes.description: Roman pasta with guanciale and Pecorino Romano. Considered the ancestor of both carbonara and amatriciana.

recipes.title: Steak with Roquefort Sauce
recipes.description: Pan-seared steak topped with a rich, creamy Roquefort sauce. Decadent and delicious.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Vegetable Skewers
recipes.description: Colorful grilled skewers with halloumi and Mediterranean vegetables. Perfect for summer barbecues.

recipes.title: Saag Paneer (Spinach with Cheese)
recipes.description: Cubes of paneer in a creamy spinach sauce. A beloved vegetarian dish from North India.

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Grilled paneer cubes in a rich, creamy tomato sauce. The vegetarian version of the famous tikka masala.

recipes.title: Matar Paneer (Peas and Cheese Curry)
recipes.description: A comforting North Indian curry with paneer and green peas in a tomato-based sauce.

recipes.title: Ricotta Stuffed Shells
recipes.description: Jumbo pasta shells filled with seasoned ricotta and mozzarella, baked in marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
recipes.description: A light, creamy pasta with lemon and ricotta. Ready in 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta with Mascarpone and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
recipes.description: A luxuriously creamy pasta with mascarpone, sun-dried tomatoes, and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Ñoquis con Tuco (Argentine Gnocchi with Reggianito)
recipes.description: Pillowy potato gnocchi served with rich tomato tuco sauce and grated Reggianito cheese, a beloved Argentine tradition.

recipes.title: Milanesa Napolitana with Reggianito
recipes.description: Crispy breaded beef cutlet topped with tomato sauce, ham, and melted cheese. A happy accident that became an Argentine classic.

recipes.title: Creamy Risotto with Reggianito
recipes.description: Rich, creamy risotto finished with generous amounts of grated Reggianito, Argentina's beloved Parmesan-style cheese.

recipes.title: Pasta with Grated Sardo Cheese
recipes.description: Simple yet flavorful pasta tossed with butter and generously topped with sharp, salty grated Sardo cheese.

recipes.title: Grandma's Hamburger Pie
recipes.description: A simple, hearty pie with seasoned ground beef in a creamy gravy, topped with melted cheese, all in a pie crust. Perfect for unexpected company.

recipes.title: Crown o' Gold Meatloaf (1959)
recipes.description: A 1950s meatloaf baked in a round casserole and crowned with a savory mustard meringue topping that looks like mashed potatoes but tastes like a tangy, fluffy cloud.

recipes.title: 16th Century Vindaloo
recipes.description: A traditional vindaloo made the way Portuguese explorers brought it to India in the 15th century. Rich with dry-roasted spices and a tangy wine vinegar marinade. No potatoes - that's a British addition.

recipes.title: Classic Tuna Noodle Casserole
recipes.description: The quintessential 1950s weeknight dinner. Egg noodles, tuna, peas, and cream of mushroom soup topped with crushed potato chips or breadcrumbs. Economical, comforting, and nostalgic.

recipes.title: King Ranch Chicken Casserole
recipes.description: A Tex-Mex layered casserole named after the legendary King Ranch. Layers of corn tortillas, chicken, and creamy chile-spiked sauce. A Texas potluck and church supper essential.

recipes.title: Traditional Clabber Cheese (Grandmother's Method)
recipes.description: The oldest method of cheese making - letting raw milk naturally sour and thicken with wild bacteria, then gently heating to form soft curds. This is how your great-grandmother made cottage cheese, long before store-bought cultures existed.
recipes.servings_yield: About 1 quart cheese from 1 gallon milk

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Cup Cheese
recipes.description: A traditional Amish cheese dating back to pre-Revolutionary America. Mild curds are pressed into cups, creating a spreadable cheese perfect on bread or crackers. A Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, heritage recipe.

recipes.title: Queso Blanco (Traditional Latin White Cheese)
recipes.description: The simplest cheese you can make - just milk and acid. Heat milk, add vinegar, and curds form instantly. A fresh, mild cheese used throughout Mexico and Latin America for generations. Ready in 30 minutes.
recipes.servings_yield: About 10-12 oz cheese from 1 gallon milk

recipes.title: Queso Fresco (Mexican Fresh Cheese with Rennet)
recipes.description: The traditional Mexican fresh cheese made with rennet rather than acid. Slightly firmer and less tangy than Queso Blanco, it crumbles beautifully over hot dishes without melting. Essential for authentic Mexican cooking.
recipes.servings_yield: About 1 lb cheese from 1 gallon milk

recipes.title: Amish Buttermilk Cheese
recipes.description: A creamy, spreadable cheese made simply from buttermilk - no rennet needed. The Amish trick of adding baking soda creates an incredibly smooth texture. Ready in under an hour with just two ingredients.
recipes.servings_yield: About 8 oz cheese from 1 quart buttermilk

recipes.title: Traditional English Stilton Blue Cheese
recipes.description: The 'King of English Cheeses' - a creamy, crumbly blue cheese with characteristic blue-green veining. Dating to the 1700s, Stilton requires mold culture and careful aging. An advanced cheese making project.

recipes.title: 18th Century Farmhouse Cheddar
recipes.description: A true farmhouse cheddar using traditional methods from the 1700s. Simpler than modern cheddar, it uses basic cultures and can age for several months. How American farm families made cheese before refrigeration.

recipes.title: Traditional Yorkshire Wensleydale Cheese
recipes.description: A traditional English cheese from the Yorkshire Dales, dating back to 12th century Cistercian monks. Crumbly, moist, and slightly sweet with honey undertones. Often paired with fruitcake or apple pie in Yorkshire.

recipes.title: Traditional French Camembert
recipes.description: The famous soft French cheese with a bloomy white rind and creamy interior. Created in Normandy in 1791, it ripens in just 4-6 weeks. The white Penicillium candidum mold creates the edible rind and transforms the interior to a luscious paste.

recipes.title: Traditional French Brie
recipes.description: The 'King of Cheeses' dating back 1,200+ years to the Île-de-France region. Larger and milder than Camembert, with a luxuriously creamy interior beneath its white bloomy rind. Charlemagne himself reportedly loved this cheese.

recipes.title: Creole Cream Cheese (1901 New Orleans)
recipes.description: The original New Orleans cream cheese from 1901 - made from naturally clabbered milk, drained overnight in muslin bags. A tangy, fresh cheese served with sweet cream poured over. A treasured Creole tradition nearly lost to history.

recipes.title: Traditional French Neufchâtel
recipes.description: One of France's oldest cheeses, documented since 1035 AD. This Normandy cheese has a white bloomy rind and soft, slightly grainy interior. Traditionally molded into heart shapes by young women for their sweethearts.

recipes.title: Traditional Labneh (Middle Eastern Yogurt Cheese)
recipes.description: The simplest cheese - just strained yogurt. Made throughout the Middle East for millennia, labneh is creamy, tangy, and infinitely versatile. Serve drizzled with olive oil and za'atar, or roll into balls and preserve in oil.
recipes.servings_yield: About 2 cups labneh from 4 cups yogurt

recipes.title: Traditional Greek Feta Cheese
recipes.description: The ancient Greek cheese mentioned in Homer's Odyssey. Tangy, crumbly, and brined for preservation. Traditional feta uses sheep's milk (or sheep-goat blend) and ages in brine for at least 2 months. A 3,000+ year-old recipe.

recipes.title: Traditional Spanish Manchego
recipes.description: Spain's most famous cheese, from the land of Don Quixote. Made from Manchega sheep's milk with a distinctive crosshatch rind pattern. Nutty, buttery, and slightly tangy. Traditionally aged 2 months to 2 years.

recipes.title: Traditional Limburger Cheese
recipes.description: The famously pungent washed-rind cheese beloved by German immigrants. The strong smell comes from the same bacteria found on human skin. Despite the aroma, the flavor is surprisingly mild and creamy. An acquired taste and a cultural icon.

recipes.title: Traditional Parmesan-Style Cheese
recipes.description: A hard, granular aged cheese inspired by Italian Parmigiano-Reggiano. Requires patience - at least 10-12 months aging - but the nutty, crystalline result is worth the wait. The 'King of Cheeses' in your own cheese cave.

recipes.title: Traditional Italian Asiago
recipes.description: An Italian cheese with over 1,000 years of history. Fresh Asiago (Pressato) is mild and smooth; aged Asiago (d'Allevo) is sharp and crumbly. This recipe makes the aged version, perfect for grating.

recipes.title: Traditional Pecorino Romano
recipes.description: A 2,000-year-old cheese that fueled the Roman legions. Made from sheep's milk with a sharp, salty, tangy flavor. Essential for authentic Cacio e Pepe, Carbonara, and Amatriciana. Aged 5-12 months.

recipes.title: Traditional Italian Gorgonzola
recipes.description: One of the world's oldest blue cheeses, from the town of Gorgonzola near Milan since 879 AD. Creamy and spreadable with characteristic blue-green veining. Milder than Roquefort, with a sweet, buttery undertone.

recipes.title: Traditional French Roquefort
recipes.description: The 'King of Cheeses' according to the French, made from raw sheep's milk and aged in limestone caves since Roman times. Sharp, tangy, and crumbly with bold blue veining. The original blue cheese.

recipes.title: Traditional Swiss Raclette
recipes.description: The ultimate melting cheese from the Swiss Alps. Medieval shepherds held wheels by the fire and scraped the melted cheese onto bread. Rich, creamy, and nutty with excellent melting properties. Perfect for the traditional raclette meal.

recipes.title: Traditional French Tomme (Farmhouse Wheel)
recipes.description: A rustic French farmhouse cheese traditionally made from the skim milk left after butter making. Semi-firm with a gray-brown natural rind and earthy, nutty flavor. The embodiment of Alpine cheese making tradition.

recipes.title: Traditional Cottage Cheese (1800s American Farmhouse)
recipes.description: Simple fresh cheese made from clabbered milk, a farmhouse staple that requires no special equipment or cultures.

recipes.title: Traditional Italian Ricotta
recipes.description: Classic Italian whey cheese, light and creamy, made by re-cooking whey with a splash of fresh milk for better yield.

recipes.title: Traditional Mascarpone (Lombard Method)
recipes.description: Ultra-rich Italian cream cheese with a buttery, slightly sweet flavor, essential for tiramisu and other Italian desserts.

recipes.title: Traditional Cypriot Halloumi
recipes.description: Distinctive squeaky grilling cheese from Cyprus that holds its shape when cooked, traditionally made from sheep and goat milk.

recipes.title: Traditional Burrata (Puglia Style)
recipes.description: Fresh Italian cheese with a mozzarella shell encasing a creamy stracciatella filling, the crown jewel of fresh cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Taleggio (Lombardy Washed-Rind)
recipes.description: Pungent Italian washed-rind cheese with a thin rosy crust and soft, tangy interior - one of Italy's most ancient cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Fontina (Val d'Aosta)
recipes.description: Buttery semi-soft Alpine cheese from Italy's Aosta Valley, prized for its superior melting qualities and earthy, nutty flavor.

recipes.title: Traditional Munster (Alsatian)
recipes.description: Pungent Alsatian washed-rind cheese with a sticky orange rind and creamy, intensely flavored interior - traditional monastic cheese.

recipes.title: Traditional Provolone (Southern Italian)
recipes.description: Classic Italian stretched-curd cheese, made in the southern tradition with a smooth, golden exterior and tangy, slightly sharp flavor.

recipes.title: Traditional Dutch Gouda
recipes.description: Classic Dutch washed-curd cheese with its characteristic sweet, nutty flavor and smooth, dense paste - the world's most popular cheese style.

recipes.title: Traditional Emmental (Swiss)
recipes.description: The original 'Swiss cheese' with its distinctive large holes, mild nutty flavor, and slightly sweet taste - a masterpiece of Alpine cheesemaking.

recipes.title: Traditional Gruyère (Swiss)
recipes.description: Prestigious Swiss Alpine cheese with complex nutty, slightly sweet flavor and small irregular eyes - the king of fondue cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Danish Havarti
recipes.description: Creamy Danish table cheese with small irregular holes, buttery flavor, and smooth meltability - a modern classic from a pioneering cheesemaker.

recipes.title: Traditional Indian Paneer
recipes.description: Simple fresh Indian cheese that holds its shape when cooked, essential for dishes like palak paneer and matar paneer.

recipes.title: Traditional German Quark
recipes.description: Smooth, creamy fresh cheese similar to yogurt but milder, essential for German cheesecake (Käsekuchen) and many Central European dishes.

recipes.title: Traditional French Fromage Blanc
recipes.description: Simple French fresh cheese with a tangy, creamy flavor - served as dessert with honey and fruit or used in savory applications.

recipes.title: Traditional English Cheddar
recipes.description: The world's most popular cheese style, with its characteristic sharp, tangy flavor developed through the unique 'cheddaring' process.

recipes.title: Traditional Dutch Edam
recipes.description: Mild, slightly nutty Dutch cheese traditionally coated in red or yellow wax, famous for its long shelf life and characteristic ball shape.

recipes.title: Traditional American Colby
recipes.description: Mild, moist American cheese similar to cheddar but softer and more open-textured due to the washed-curd process.

recipes.title: Traditional Monterey Jack
recipes.description: Mild, creamy California cheese with excellent melting properties, descended from Spanish mission cheesemaking traditions.

recipes.title: Traditional Wisconsin Brick Cheese
recipes.description: Unique American original with a pungent aroma, tangy flavor, and superb melting qualities - the secret to Detroit-style pizza.

recipes.title: Traditional Red Leicester (Leicestershire)
recipes.description: Distinctive English cheese with a deep russet color, crumbly texture, and slightly sweet, nutty flavor.

recipes.title: Traditional Sage Derby
recipes.description: Festive English cheese marbled with green sage, traditionally served at Christmas with its distinctive herbal flavor and striking appearance.

recipes.title: Traditional Cheshire Cheese
recipes.description: England's oldest named cheese, crumbly and tangy with a salty minerally finish from the salt marshes of Cheshire.

recipes.title: Traditional Welsh Caerphilly
recipes.description: Fresh, lemony Welsh cheese with a moist, crumbly interior - the traditional miners' lunch cheese.

recipes.title: Traditional Pont-l'Évêque (Normandy)
recipes.description: Classic Norman washed-rind cheese with a golden crust and creamy, pungent interior - one of France's oldest cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Reblochon (Savoie)
recipes.description: Buttery French Alpine cheese with a washed rind and supple texture, essential for Tartiflette - born from 13th-century tax evasion.

recipes.title: Traditional Époisses (Burgundy)
recipes.description: Legendarily pungent Burgundian cheese washed with Marc de Bourgogne, with a sticky orange rind and spoonable, intensely flavored interior.

recipes.title: Traditional Comté (Franche-Comté)
recipes.description: France's favorite cheese - a complex, nutty Alpine wheel with notes of butter, fruit, and hazelnut that develop over long aging.

recipes.title: Traditional Cabrales (Asturian Blue)
recipes.description: Spain's most famous blue cheese, intensely pungent and creamy, traditionally aged in mountain caves with wild molds.

recipes.title: Traditional Lancashire Cheese
recipes.description: Buttery, crumbly English cheese made from mixed-day curds, with a fresh, tangy flavor that's perfect for toasting.

recipes.title: Traditional Double Gloucester
recipes.description: Rich, buttery English cheese with a smooth, dense texture and mellow flavor - the cheese rolled down Cooper's Hill annually.

recipes.title: Traditional Italian Scamorza
recipes.description: Italian stretched-curd cheese, pear-shaped and often smoked, with a mild milky flavor and excellent melting properties.

recipes.title: Traditional Caciocavallo (Southern Italian)
recipes.description: Ancient Italian stretched-curd cheese, hung in pairs to age, developing complex flavors from mild and milky to sharp and tangy.

recipes.title: Traditional Appenzeller (Swiss)
recipes.description: Tangy Swiss cheese with a complex herbal flavor from its secret brine wash - one of Switzerland's most distinctive cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Beaufort (Savoie)
recipes.description: Noble French Alpine cheese with a rich, complex flavor - distinguished by concave sides and centuries of mountain tradition.

recipes.title: Traditional Ossau-Iraty (Basque Sheep Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Basque sheep's milk cheese with a rich, nutty sweetness - made by Pyrenean shepherds for millennia.

recipes.title: Traditional Idiazábal (Basque Smoked Sheep)
recipes.description: Smoky Basque sheep's milk cheese with intense, complex flavors - accidentally created by storage near shepherd's fires.

recipes.title: Traditional Sbrinz (Swiss)
recipes.description: Switzerland's ancient hard cheese, intensely flavored and crystalline - historically traded across the Alps and possibly the ancestor of Parmesan.

recipes.title: Traditional Gjetost/Brunost (Norwegian Brown Cheese)
recipes.description: Unique Norwegian sweet brown cheese made from caramelized whey - not technically cheese but a beloved Scandinavian breakfast staple.

recipes.title: Traditional Jarlsberg (Norwegian Swiss-Style)
recipes.description: Norwegian Swiss-style cheese with large eyes, sweet nutty flavor, and excellent melting properties - Norway's most famous cheese export.

recipes.title: Traditional Danablu (Danish Blue)
recipes.description: Creamy, sharp Danish blue cheese developed as a Roquefort alternative - now beloved worldwide for its bold flavor and smooth texture.

recipes.title: Traditional Cantal (Auvergne)
recipes.description: Ancient French cheese from the volcanic Auvergne, possibly the ancestor of cheddar - with a complex, buttery flavor that deepens with age.

recipes.title: Traditional Morbier (Jura)
recipes.description: French cheese with a distinctive black ash line, originally a frugal farmhouse creation using leftover Comté curds.

recipes.title: Traditional Saint-Nectaire (Auvergne)
recipes.description: Earthy Auvergnat cheese with a complex, mushroomy rind and creamy interior - a favorite of Louis XIV.

recipes.title: Traditional Scottish Crowdie
recipes.description: Ancient Scottish fresh cheese, tangy and crumbly - a Highland crofter's staple now enjoying a renaissance.

recipes.title: Traditional Stracchino/Crescenza (Lombardy)
recipes.description: Soft, spreadable Italian cheese with a mild, milky flavor - named for the 'tired' cows whose rich autumn milk made the best wheels.

recipes.title: Traditional Vacherin Mont d'Or (Swiss/French)
recipes.description: Luxurious seasonal cheese wrapped in spruce bark, so soft it's eaten with a spoon - a winter delicacy from the Jura Mountains.

recipes.title: Traditional Livarot (Normandy)
recipes.description: Pungent Norman cheese nicknamed 'The Colonel' for its distinctive reed bands - one of France's oldest and most flavorful washed-rind cheeses.

recipes.title: Traditional Maroilles (Picardy)
recipes.description: Ancient monastic cheese with an intensely pungent washed rind - created by Benedictine monks over a thousand years ago.

recipes.title: Traditional Bleu d'Auvergne
recipes.description: Creamy French blue cheese from volcanic Auvergne, created by a curious farmer's experiment with rye bread mold.

recipes.title: Traditional Fourme d'Ambert
recipes.description: Ancient Auvergnat blue in a distinctive tall cylinder, milder and creamier than most blues - possibly dating to Roman times.

recipes.title: Traditional Banon (Provençal Leaf-Wrapped)
recipes.description: Provençal cheese wrapped in chestnut leaves, developing complex flavors as it ages in its leafy cocoon.

recipes.title: Traditional Tetilla (Galician)
recipes.description: Distinctive pear-shaped Galician cheese with a mild, creamy flavor - its shape has been traditional for centuries.

recipes.title: Traditional Queso de Murcia al Vino (Wine-Washed)
recipes.description: Spanish goat cheese washed with red wine, developing a striking purple rind and complex, fruity flavors.

recipes.title: Traditional Kashkaval (Balkan)
recipes.description: Traditional Balkan pasta filata cheese, similar to provolone but with regional variations across Bulgaria, Turkey, Greece, and beyond.

recipes.title: Traditional Bulgarian Sirene (White Brine Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional Bulgarian brine cheese, tangy and crumbly - the foundation of Bulgarian cuisine from shopska salad to banitsa.

recipes.title: Traditional Greek Graviera
recipes.description: Greece's beloved hard cheese with nutty, sweet flavors - the island varieties are considered finest.

recipes.title: Traditional Turkish Tulum (Goatskin Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Turkish cheese traditionally aged in goatskin bags, with a distinctive sharp, crumbly character.

recipes.title: Traditional Akkawi (Levantine)
recipes.description: Mild Levantine brine cheese named after the city of Acre, essential for authentic knafeh and Middle Eastern cuisine.

recipes.title: Traditional Nabulsi Cheese (Palestinian)
recipes.description: Traditional Palestinian white cheese from Nablus, boiled with mahaleb spice and essential for kunafa and Middle Eastern pastries.

recipes.title: Traditional Jibneh Arabieh (Arabian White Cheese)
recipes.description: Simple Arabian white cheese, mild and versatile - a staple food throughout the Arabian Peninsula for millennia.

recipes.title: Traditional Chhena (Indian Fresh Cheese)
recipes.description: Soft Indian fresh cheese essential for Bengali sweets - the foundation of rasgulla, sandesh, and rasmalai.

recipes.title: Traditional Piave (Veneto)
recipes.description: Alpine cheese from the Dolomites with a sweet, nutty flavor that intensifies with age - Italy's answer to Parmesan for grating.

recipes.title: Traditional Montasio (Friuli-Venezia Giulia)
recipes.description: Medieval Alpine cheese from the Julian Alps, essential for making frico - the crispy cheese wafers of Friuli.

recipes.title: Traditional Bra (Piedmont)
recipes.description: Piedmontese cheese from the town of Bra, made in two styles - soft Tenero for eating and hard Duro for grating.

recipes.title: Traditional Toma Piemontese
recipes.description: Traditional Piedmontese Alpine cheese, varying by valley but always earthy and semi-soft - the everyday cheese of mountain communities.

recipes.title: Traditional Puzzone di Moena (Spretz Tzaorì)
recipes.description: Pungent Trentino cheese whose name means 'stinky one' - a traditional washed-rind Alpine cheese with intense aroma and flavor.

recipes.title: Traditional Canestrato (Sicilian Basket Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Sicilian cheese marked by its basket mold, made from sheep's milk with a sharp, tangy flavor that intensifies with age.

recipes.title: Traditional Castelmagno (Piedmont)
recipes.description: Ancient Piedmontese cheese that develops natural blue veining - one of Italy's rarest and most prestigious cheeses since the 13th century.

recipes.title: Traditional Robiola (Piedmont)
recipes.description: Ancient soft Italian cheese from the hills of Piedmont and Lombardy, creamy and mild with a thin edible rind.

recipes.title: Traditional Queijo da Serra (Portuguese Mountain Cheese)
recipes.description: Portugal's most prestigious cheese, made with thistle rennet and sheep's milk, with a rich, runny interior when perfectly ripe.

recipes.title: Traditional São Jorge (Azorean)
recipes.description: Sharp, tangy cheese from the Azores, introduced by Flemish settlers and perfected over centuries of island tradition.

recipes.title: Traditional Queso Chihuahua (Mexican Menonita)
recipes.description: Mild, buttery Mexican cheese introduced by Mennonite settlers, now essential for queso fundido and Mexican cuisine.

recipes.title: Traditional Queso Oaxaca (String Cheese)
recipes.description: Mexican string cheese formed into distinctive balls of wound ribbons, essential for quesadillas and melting over Mexican dishes.

recipes.title: Traditional Cotija (Mexican Aged Cheese)
recipes.description: Salty, crumbly Mexican aged cheese named for a Michoacán town - the 'Mexican Parmesan' essential for finishing dishes.

recipes.title: Traditional Queso de Mano (Venezuelan)
recipes.description: Venezuelan stretched-curd cheese kneaded by hand, with a smooth, elastic texture essential for arepas and cachapas.

recipes.title: Traditional Cuajada (Latin American Fresh Curd)
recipes.description: Simple Latin American fresh curd cheese, often eaten as dessert with honey - the most basic form of cheese, enjoyed for millennia.

recipes.title: Traditional Requesón (Latin American Ricotta)
recipes.description: Latin American whey cheese, the Spanish cousin of ricotta - light, fresh, and essential for both sweet and savory dishes.

recipes.title: Traditional Bryndza (Carpathian Sheep Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Carpathian sheep cheese with a sharp, tangy flavor - the national cheese of Slovakia and foundation of bryndzové halušky.

recipes.title: Traditional Oscypek (Polish Smoked Sheep Cheese)
recipes.description: Decorative smoked sheep cheese from the Polish Tatras, hand-carved into traditional spindle shapes by highland shepherds.

recipes.title: Traditional Olomoucké Tvarůžky (Czech Stinky Cheese)
recipes.description: Intensely pungent Moravian cheese made from soured quark - one of the world's smelliest cheeses, fat-free and centuries old.

recipes.title: Traditional Brânză de Burduf (Romanian Pine Bark Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Transylvanian cheese aged in pine bark tubes, with an intense sheep flavor and resinous notes from the bark.

recipes.title: Traditional Telemea (Romanian White Cheese)
recipes.description: Romania's essential white brine cheese, possibly dating to ancient Dacian times - the foundation of Romanian cuisine.

recipes.title: Traditional Urda (Romanian Whey Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Balkan whey cheese, light and fresh - made by shepherds for millennia from the whey of sheep cheese production.

recipes.title: Traditional Liptauer (Hungarian/Austrian Cheese Spread)
recipes.description: Spiced Central European cheese spread from the old Austro-Hungarian Empire, flavored with paprika, caraway, and onions.

recipes.title: Traditional Giuncata (Ancient Roman Rush Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Roman fresh cheese drained in rush baskets, unchanged for over 2000 years - one of the oldest cheese recipes still made.

recipes.title: Traditional Pecorino Sardo (Sardinian)
recipes.description: Ancient Sardinian sheep cheese dating to the Bronze Age, made from milk of indigenous sheep grazing on wild Mediterranean herbs.

recipes.title: Traditional Fiore Sardo (Smoked Sardinian Pecorino)
recipes.description: The original Sardinian cheese, smoked over aromatic wood by mountain shepherds - possibly 3000+ years old.

recipes.title: Traditional Kefalotyri (Greek Hard Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional Greek hard cheese for grating and frying, made since Byzantine times - the original cheese for saganaki.

recipes.title: Traditional Gamalost (Norwegian Viking Cheese)
recipes.description: Sharp, pungent Norwegian cheese from the Viking Age - an important protein source for Norse seafarers over a thousand years ago.

recipes.title: Traditional Handkäse (German Hand Cheese)
recipes.description: Pungent German sour milk cheese shaped by hand, a specialty of the Frankfurt region for centuries.

recipes.title: Traditional Harzer Käse (Harz Mountain Cheese)
recipes.description: Pungent German sour milk cheese from the Harz Mountains, ripened with yellow mold for a sharp, tangy flavor.

recipes.title: Traditional Mizithra (Ancient Greek Whey Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Greek whey cheese possibly described by Homer - made fresh and soft or aged hard for grating.

recipes.title: Traditional Anthotyro (Greek 'Flower Cheese')
recipes.description: Delicate Greek 'flower cheese' from Crete, pure and mild when fresh, sharp and grateable when aged.

recipes.title: Traditional Ayib (Ethiopian Fresh Cheese)
recipes.description: Ancient Ethiopian fresh cheese made from buttermilk, mild and crumbly - essential alongside injera and spicy Ethiopian stews.

recipes.title: Traditional Rubing (Yunnan Goat Cheese)
recipes.description: Rare traditional Chinese cheese from Yunnan, made by the Bai people - firm and mild, typically grilled or fried.

recipes.title: Traditional Chhurpi (Himalayan Yak Cheese)

recipes.title: Traditional Pecorino Romano (Ancient Roman)

recipes.title: Traditional Anari (Cypriot Whey Cheese)

recipes.description: An Asian-Mexican twist on French moules marinière, inspired by Ja'Nel Witt's Season 11 finale dish. Coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice add depth to this quick-cooking mussel dish.

recipes.title: Creamy Asparagus Risotto with Lemon and Mascarpone

recipes.title: Pecan-Crusted Mahi Mahi with Edamame Succotash and Maple Butter

recipes.title: Brick Chicken with Gremolata

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Green-Olive Crust, Marinated Bell Peppers, Caper-and-Raisin Puree
recipes.description: Show-stopping presentation that can be put together in under an hour if you prep all the components a day ahead. Perfect for a weeknight dinner with the "wow" factor.

recipes.description: Smoky chipotle-marinated shrimp served with fresh roasted corn relish and cilantro-lime rice.

recipes.description: Meltingly tender pork belly with crispy skin, served with pan-fried sushi rice cakes and Asian long beans.

recipes.description: If you want to make it onto Hell's Kitchen, you're going to have to learn to make pasta from scratch. Wide pappardelle noodles with earthy wild mushrooms, a runny poached egg, and luxurious shaved truffles.

recipes.title: NY Strip Steak with Truffle Polenta Fries, Sautéed Spinach, and Tomato Jam

recipes.description: Roasted chicken breast in rich, complex Mexican mole sauce with black beans, rice, and fresh corn-avocado salsa.

recipes.description: A carbonara-style pasta with silky egg-enriched sauce, crispy pancetta, sweet peas, and a poached egg on top.

recipes.description: Meltingly tender veal cheeks braised low and slow, served with garlic confit and creamy smashed potatoes with crème fraîche.

recipes.description: Halibut steamed in parchment paper packets with aromatic vegetables, served with purple jasmine rice and tropical island salsa.

recipes.description: Pork tenderloin with a sweet bourbon glaze, served Southern-style with yam and potato gratin and braised collard greens.
