recipes.description: Frenched lamb chops with rosemary and garlic served over Mediterranean vegetables and linguine with tomato broth.

recipes.title: Roasted Chicken Breasts and Kabocha Squash with Maple Jus
recipes.description: Classic roasted chicken with cumin-roasted kabocha squash and a rich maple jus. Kabocha squash beats butternut hands down in sweetness, moistness, and meatiness.

recipes.title: Roulade of Veal on Caramelized Onions
recipes.description: Elegant veal scallopini rolled with prosciutto, mozzarella, and a Parmesan breadcrumb mixture, served on caramelized onions with a rich demi-glace cream sauce.

recipes.title: Lemon Tagliatelle with Toasted Pine Nuts and Arugula
recipes.description: A special vegetarian pasta dish with ribbony tagliatelle, lemon, basil, cheese, buttery pine nuts, and peppery arugula cooked right into the pasta.

recipes.title: Duck Breast with Walnut-Grape Compote
recipes.description: Perfectly cooked duck breast served with a herby walnut-grape compote and creamy polenta. The duck must be cooked to a perfect rare to medium rare to truly shine.

recipes.title: Herb Oil-Poached Halibut with Potato-Fennel Puree, Roasted Tomatoes, and Lemon-Fennel Sauce
recipes.description: Poaching fish in oil ensures the most tender results, with the herbs infusing their flavor as it cooks. Fennel is a classic flavoring for fish, featured here in both a fennel-infused potato puree and a lemon-fennel sauce spiked with Pernod.

recipes.title: John Dory with New Potatoes, Carrot Puree, Artichokes, and Fennel Velouté
recipes.description: John Dory is a firm, flaky, white-fleshed fish prized for its mild, sweet flavor. Paired with new potatoes, a sweet carrot puree, artichokes, and a velvety fennel velouté. Season 7 contestant Holli Ugalde worked her John Dory to perfection in a top-four dinner service competition, ultimately becoming the winner of the show.

recipes.title: Miso-Sake Marinated Chilean Sea Bass with Seaweed Soba Salad
recipes.description: Miso, mirin, and sake make a classic Asian marinade for bass, the medley of flavors blanketing and penetrating the flesh for a roasted fish dish that's sweet, tender, and simple enough that you'll likely find yourself adding this one both to your dinner rotation and special-occasion celebrations.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Chop with Spinach Polenta and Shaved Baby Artichoke Slaw
recipes.description: Brined pork chops grilled to perfection, served with creamy spinach polenta and a fresh shaved baby artichoke slaw dressed with lemon and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Homemade Pappardelle with Wild Mushrooms, Poached Egg, and Shaved Black Truffles
recipes.description: Fresh homemade pappardelle pasta tossed with a rich wild mushroom sauce, topped with a perfectly poached egg and optional shaved black truffles.

recipes.title: Mustard-Rubbed Veal Loin with Butternut Squash Puree, Sautéed Baby Brussels Sprouts, and Grape Sauce
recipes.description: Tender veal loin roast rubbed with a Dijon mustard and sage mixture, served with silky butternut squash puree, sautéed Brussels sprouts, and an elegant grape sauce.

recipes.title: Pepper-Crusted Steak with Mushroom-Brandy Cream Sauce, Roasted Asparagus, and Sautéed Potatoes
recipes.description: Perfectly seared filet mignon with a peppercorn crust, served with a rich mushroom-brandy cream sauce, roasted asparagus, and crispy sautéed potatoes.

recipes.title: Elsie's Turkey Tacos
recipes.description: Season 1 contestant Elsie Ramos's turkey tacos featuring a homemade sazon seasoning mix, perfect for busy weeknight meals.

recipes.title: Eight-Ounce Beef Burger with Caramelized Onion and Bacon Jam, Sharp Cheddar, and Special Sauce on a Brioche Bun with Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: A chef-quality burger featuring freshly ground beef with caramelized onion and bacon jam, sharp aged cheddar, special sauce, and crispy sweet potato fries.

recipes.title: White-Wine-Braised Short Ribs
recipes.description: Restaurant-quality short ribs braised low and slow in white wine until falling-off-the-bone tender, served with a pureed vegetable sauce.

recipes.title: Branzino, Roasted Fennel, Caramelized Lemon, Olives
recipes.description: Pan-seared Mediterranean sea bass with roasted fennel, caramelized lemons, and a pan sauce with capers, tomatoes, and olives.

recipes.title: Honey-Grilled Shrimp with Roasted Corn Relish, Cilantro Rice, and Spicy Creme Fraiche
recipes.description: Shrimp and rice can be a simple dish, or you can pull out the stops, as we do here in typical Hell's Kitchen fashion. The shrimp, at once sweet, spicy, tangy, and garlicky, sits atop flavorful green rice, with sweet roasted corn relish the final flavoring element. A dollop of spicy creme fraiche, at once hot and cooling, completes the picture.

recipes.title: Crispy Pork Belly, Sushi Rice Cake, and Long Beans with Shiso and Kimchi
recipes.description: If you like bacon, you're going to love pork belly. Both cuts come from the fatty underbelly of the pig - bacon is cured, pork belly is not. Pork belly's uncured status allows for a wide range of cooking preparations - it can be cut into chunks, braised, fried, spiced, shredded, and stuffed into buns or tacos. Pig heaven! Pork belly is popular in Asian cuisine, particularly Korean, and it's a natural partner to the pungent, spicy fermented cabbage dish kimchi.

recipes.title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin, Collard Greens with Smoked Bacon with Yam and Potato Gratin
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin is lean, tender, and a delicacy; this cut is also known as pork fillet. Individual tenderloins are small, so they generally are sold two to a package. If you find a silver skin on your tenderloin, trim it off. Though it's a fancy cut, the tenderloin is one of the easiest parts of the pig to cook; it roasts quickly, but take the greatest caution to avoid overcooking it, as it can go from tender to tough and dry in a matter of minutes. The tenderloin is marinated to further ensure a juicy outcome, so you'll need to plan at least eight hours ahead to ready the meat.

recipes.title: Carbonara
recipes.description: Carbonara is a simple Italian pasta dish comprised of spaghetti, pork, cheese, and eggs. A true carbonara contains no cream and relies on eggs for its velvety texture (though many restaurant carbonaras will cheat and add cream). It's a hearty dish and a go-to weeknight meal, as many of the ingredients can already be found in a well-stocked pantry. And if you keep frozen peas and pancetta on hand, you're minutes away from carbonara making at any given moment.

recipes.title: Gordon Ramsay's Kitchen Techniques & Tips
recipes.description: Essential kitchen techniques, knife cuts, and chef tips from Gordon Ramsay.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipes.description: The ultimate cozy, flavor-packed vegan dinner made with creamy tomato-basil garlic butter. The rich roasted garlic melts into the spaghetti, creating a luscious sauce that's perfect for a weeknight meal or a comforting weekend indulgence.

recipes.title: Creamy Asparagus Risotto with Lemon and Mascarpone

recipes.title: Eggplant Involtini with Spicy Red Pepper Emulsion

recipes.title: Seared Ahi Tuna Loin with Haricots Verts, Hard-Boiled Quail Eggs, and Black Olive Dressing
recipes.description: Ahi tuna, also known as yellowfin tuna, is mild in flavor and firm in texture. It's a standard sushi-menu offering, and it is often served lightly cooked as well. Here it's bathed in an herb, soy, and vinegar marinade before it hits the pan to give it a very brief sear. Quail eggs are miniature brown-and-black-spotted eggs; they are a bit richer in taste than chicken eggs and cook more quickly. Haricots verts are a longer, thinner, and more tender version of green beans.

recipes.title: Spinach Pastina

recipes.description: Crunchy on the outside...spicy, saucy, and cheesy inside. So fun for fall nights!

recipes.title: Crockpot Crispy Chicken Tinga Tacos with Jalapeño Avocado Crema
recipes.description: Easy to assemble, crunchy outside, spicy cheesy inside...everyone loves these!

recipes.title: Anticuchos - Peruvian Grilled Beef Heart Skewers
recipes.description: The classic Peruvian street food dish.

recipes.title: Peruvian Anticuchos Recipe - Rumba Meats
recipes.description: Great recipe for Peruvian anticuchos featuring Rumba Meats beef heart, aji panca paste, ground garlic, red vinegar, ground oregano and olive oil.

recipes.title: Aloo Methi (Potato and Fenugreek Curry)
recipes.description: Carb nirvana! Perfectly crispy-outside-fluffy-inside potatoes with gloriously bold spices, aromatics and fenugreek leaves.

recipes.title: Kale Dal (Indian Lentil Stew)
recipes.description: A spicy, comforting, and hearty stew of two kinds of lentils, chopped lacinato kale, and Indian aromatics and spices.

recipes.title: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
recipes.description: Indian soul food! Spicy and hearty rajma masala made in a pressure cooker or on a regular stovetop.

recipes.title: Easy Hearty Chili
recipes.description: A hot steaming bowl of chili is a great meal for a cold day. Takes only a little time and work to make, so you have more time to enjoy!

recipes.title: Hot Scorpion Pepper Bacon
recipes.description: The best ever HOT bacon made with Trinidad Moruga Scorpion peppers - one of the world's hottest chilies at 1.5-2 million SHU.

recipes.title: Sioux Chef Tamales
recipes.description: Often associated with Mexico, tamales are found in every corn-growing region throughout the Americas. We fill them with smoked game and fish, as well as braised bison and assorted beans. They freeze well, so make a few extra to have on hand.

recipes.title: Tatanka Truck Fried Wild Rice Bowl
recipes.description: This is one of our most popular dishes at the food truck. It's a one-bowl meal that's satisfying, healthy, and delicious.

recipes.title: Smoked Whitefish or Trout
recipes.description: In the old days, smoking fish fresh was a group effort. We are using a more modern technique with brining as the first step. Be sure the fish is thoroughly cleaned before you begin.
recipes.servings_yield: Serves 4 to 6 (or more as an appetizer)

recipes.title: Wild Rice-Crusted Walleye
recipes.description: The Red Lake Nation is an Ojibwe community in northern Minnesota, home of our ethnobotanist Tashia, who shares her knowledge with our team. We source all of our fish—the walleye, northerns, and whitefish—from the Red Lake Nation Fishery.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Fish
recipes.description: Chef Brian Yazzie shares this recipe from his family's traditions. The original recipe calls for the bluehead sucker fish, a rare fish specific to the Southwest, but any small or large firm fish works nicely. The fish is traditionally cooked in a pit filled with hot wood coals, covered with sand so that it steam-roasts.

recipes.title: Tatanka Truck Sunflower-Crusted Trout
recipes.description: This crispy trout with a sunflower crust is one of chef Vern DeFoe's recipes and a Tatanka Truck favorite. Vern, a member of the Red Cliff Band of Lake Superior Chippewa, serves the trout with roe on wild rice flatbread, garnished with dried apple slices.

recipes.title: Grouse with Cranberry and Sage
recipes.description: Grouse, such as partridge, feed on wild berries, nuts, and seeds. Near the cranberry regions of southern Wisconsin, the wild berries turn the bird's meat bright pink. In this recipe, the rendered duck fat, cranberries, and sage baste the meat while it roasts to become tender and flavorful. This is great on our Wild Rice Pilaf, page 84.

recipes.title: Maple-Juniper Roast Pheasant
recipes.description: When I was growing up on the Pine Ridge Reservation, we stocked our freezers with pheasant and grouse. We'd see them darting across the dirt roads into the dry brush. They were as common as the red-winged blackbirds perched on the fence posts. Overnight dry brining seasons and helps this especially lean bird to become tender and succulent. The technique also works with grouse and guinea hens.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Roast Goose with Autumn Squash and Cranberries
recipes.description: This slow-roasted goose will emerge from the oven golden brown and tender. The sauce was inspired by an older recipe using 'sour sap,' a vinegar made from the maple syrup's last run blended with the maple syrup. Save the fat that collects at the bottom of the roasting pan for cooking vegetables, frying corn cakes, or sautéing other meats. This recipe works equally well with duck if you adjust the cooking time accordingly.

recipes.title: Sage and Rose-Hip Roasted Duck
recipes.description: The ducks we bagged when I was growing up were wild ducks; some were puddle ducks, others were diving ducks that varied in size. Their flavor depends on where the duck had been feeding. Shallow-water ducks that feed on local grains tend to be succulent, while diving ducks that eat fish can taste, well, fishy. We've found that an overnight soak in brine benefits any duck, wild or domestic. This simple recipe yields a duck with supercrisp skin and juicy meat. The sage and rose-hip sauce is tangy, woodsy, and mildly sweet. Serve over wild rice.

recipes.title: Seared Duck Breast with Cider Glaze
recipes.description: In this recipe, the duck breast is barely cooked, seared under a maple glaze, and served over a griddled corn cake with wild mushrooms and a wild pesto. It's a simple plate that makes a stunning entrée. Unless you hunt or know someone who does, find duck breasts in the freezer section of most grocery stores. The sear on high heats gets the skin nice and crispy. Serve on Corn Cakes, page 51, or Wild Rice Pilaf, page 84.

recipes.title: Crispy Duck Legs
recipes.description: This recipe is an easier, quicker, and less fussy method of making 'confit.' The legs are cured for 24 hours and then cooked for about 4 hours in their own rendered fat. Serve these on a bed of Real Wild Rice, page 81, Maple-Sage Roasted Vegetables, page 46, or Three Sisters Mash, page 43.

recipes.title: Smoked Duck or Pheasant
recipes.description: Pheasant and duck are wonderful smoked. Brining helps make them more juicy and tender, and the smoking process adds the flavor of an open flame. Brining does two things: it seasons meat and, through osmosis, helps infuse moisture to keep it juicy. We leave the skin on the birds to help keep them from drying out. (Many markets now sell pheasant, often frozen.) Shred the smoked pheasant or duck and serve over Corn Cakes, page 51, or Timpsula Cakes, page 86, with a drizzle of Wojape. Plan on a 12-hour brine followed by a 5-hour smoke.

recipes.title: Roast Turkey, Wild Onions, Maple Squash, and Cranberry Sauce
recipes.description: Hands down, this is the best way to roast turkey. We serve it and the vegetables over wild rice. Save the turkey bones for stock, page 170.

recipes.title: Bison Ribs
recipes.description: Finger-licking, rib-sucking, and tasty, these ribs are lean, crispy, and tender.

recipes.title: Cider-Braised Turkey Thighs
recipes.description: With dark, rich meat and a coarse texture, turkey thighs are reminiscent of game birds. This recipe makes a nice weeknight dinner served with smashed sweet potatoes or maple squash, corn cakes, or wild rice.

recipes.title: Maple-Brined Smoked Turkey
recipes.description: The traditional American Thanksgiving meal showcases the bounty of indigenous foods and the influence Native Americans have had on U.S. cuisine. This recipe ensures a terrific, tender, juicy turkey for dinner, and leftover turkey meat is delicious on Corn Cakes, page 51, and added to the Smoked Turkey and Acorn Soup, page 71.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Rabbit Stew
recipes.description: Serve this over golden Corn Mush, page 59, for a comforting winter meal. The long, slow cooking time is especially good for a wild rabbit. If rabbit is not available, substitute turkey thighs.

recipes.title: Rabbit Braised with Apples and Mint
recipes.description: This simple skillet meal is delicious served over wild rice, corn cakes, or cooked hominy. If rabbit is not available, substitute turkey or chicken thighs.

recipes.title: Cedar-Braised Bison
recipes.description: This makes a simple and hearty one-pot meal. The meat becomes fork tender and the stock simmers down to a rich sauce. Leftovers are terrific served over corn cakes.

recipes.title: Indigenous Tacos
recipes.description: When we launched the Tatanka Truck, we took the idea of the fast food—Indian Tacos—and slowed it down with authentic ingredients. This is a delicious and superhealthy alternative to the fry bread and commodity hamburger version. Use leftover Cedar-Braised Bison, page 120, or Cedar-Braised Beans, page 36, or Griddled Maple Squash, page 33, in lieu of the ground bison in this recipe. The recipe is easily expanded to feed a crowd.

recipes.title: Grilled Bison Skewers with Wojape
recipes.description: Everyone loves these kebobs, the recipe of Mikee Willard and his son Darius Willard of the Northern Cheyenne tribe in Montana, and members of the Tatanka Truck team. They skewer chunks of fresh sweet corn (on the cob), turnips, summer squash, or partially roasted winter squash in between the bison. The skewers are then garnished with Wojape, page 173, or a sauce of stewed wild plums.

recipes.title: Lamb Sausage
recipes.description: Brian Yazzie, Sioux Chef chef de cuisine, shared his method for creating a traditional Diné lamb sausage. Churro lamb, introduced to the continent by Spanish explorers in the 1600s, has become a mainstay throughout the Southwest. It's an especially hardy animal, requiring less water and forage than other sheep, with long legs, a narrow body, and fine bones. Navajo-Churro sheep provide lean meat with a distinctive, sweet flavor and beautiful dual-fiber fleece, prized for its array of natural colors and woven into Navajo tapestries and blankets. Because the traditional recipe for Churro lamb sausage is the kind of food best learned at the side of an elder, we've modified it, using more readily available ingredients. (The original recipe for this traditional blood sausage is similar to British black pudding, French boudin, and Estonian Christmas pudding—all truly delicious.)

recipes.title: Venison Chops with Apples and Cranberries
recipes.description: Here the venison chops are cooked quickly over high heat to be especially tender and juicy.

recipes.title: Scallops with Three Sisters Reduction and Four Medicines
recipes.description: Chef Rich Francis of Atikamekw and French Canadian heritage trained at the Stratford Chefs School in Ontario and honed his skills at some of Canada's finest restaurants. He is committed to using indigenous wild ingredients and foraging. This elegant dish features seared scallops with a reduction of the three sisters (corn, beans, squash) and a garnish of the four sacred medicines.

recipes.title: Navajo Tea-Smoked Quail with Manoomin Fritter, Pickled Cholla, and Lichii Sauce
recipes.description: Chef Karlos Baca is Tewa, Diné, and Nuche. He grew up on the Southern Ute reservation, learning traditional foodways from his grandmother. This dish reflects the Southwest with Navajo tea-smoked quail, wild rice fritters, pickled cholla cactus, and a sauce made from lichii (juniper berries).

recipes.title: Coriander-Cured Elk with Dried Chokecherry Sauce
recipes.description: Chef Lois Ellen Frank is a culinary anthropologist, author, and photographer who has dedicated her career to Native American cuisine of the Southwest. This elegant dish features cured elk loin with a rich chokecherry sauce.

recipes.title: Special Occasion Goulash
recipes.servings_yield: Makes enough for 4 people, or half of a full serving for Mitch

recipes.description: A mayonnaise-like garlic sauce made with an immersion blender.

recipes.description: Crispy fried potatoes tossed with a cilantro, garlic, cumin, and lemon dressing.

recipes.title: Fried Cauliflower with Tahini Sauce
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried cauliflower florets served with a creamy tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Carrots
recipes.description: I love roasting carrots to bring out their sweetness. I think thyme really complements the flavor of these air-fryer carrots, but feel free to mix it up and use other herbs, like rosemary or tarragon.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Hard-Boiled Eggs
recipes.description: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs make cooking eggs easier than we ever imagined, and they turn out just the same as stove-cooked eggs. It is a kitchen shortcut for the win!

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Potatoes
recipes.description: Red potatoes tossed with olive oil and herbs will become your new staple side. Crisp and fluffy air-fryer potatoes go with just about anything, from burgers to pork chops or prime rib.

recipes.title: Asparagus, Squash & Red Pepper Saute
recipes.description: The appealing vegetable trio is enlivened by a wine-scented saute.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Hummus
recipes.description: This perfectly delicious pumpkin hummus dip is a beautiful blend of creamy, decadent hummus and warm, autumnal pumpkin.

recipes.title: Green Beans Amandine
recipes.description: It's hard to improve on the taste of fresh green beans, but this recipe for green beans amandine does it. The final dish looks fancy without requiring fancy cooking skills.

recipes.title: Lemon-Parmesan Broiled Asparagus
recipes.description: These special spears are packed with flavor, thanks to the lemon-garlic dressing they're tossed in before roasting. It's a simple, quick side that goes with almost anything.

recipes.title: Maple-Gingerroot Vegetables
recipes.description: My family loves this recipe because it brings out the lovely flavors of the vegetables. Even my children enjoy it

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus
recipes.description: This roasted asparagus recipe is made in a foil packet in the oven, keeping the spears bright and green with a consistently crisp texture.

recipes.title: Pimiento Green Beans
recipes.description: Here's an easy way to turn everyday green beans into a special side dish. Pimientos, Parmesan cheese and chicken broth add savory flavor and a dash of color.

recipes.title: Roasted Fall Vegetables
recipes.description: I love serving this tender veggie side dish as part of a comforting dinner on a chilly night. The cayenne pepper lends zippy flavor that's not overpowering.

recipes.title: Roasted Peppers and Cauliflower
recipes.description: Caramelization really enhances the flavors in this easy side dish. The seasoned, roasted peppers and cauliflower are just right with nearly any main course.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Summer Squash Side Dish
recipes.description: I’m trying to cut my risk for cardiac disease by changing the way I eat. This colorful sauteed zucchini and summer squash side dish is packed with as much nutrition as fresh-picked flavor!

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
recipes.description: Take a break from green leaf salads, and enjoy a bright, lively tabbouleh salad. This parsley-and-bulgur salad tastes great on its own, and it pairs well with foods from Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines.

recipes.title: Veggie Kabobs
recipes.description: Grilling is a delightful way of preparing the season's freshest produce. The zesty Italian marinade adds just the right amount of spice to these veggie kabobs.

recipes.title: Bacon-Corn Stuffed Peppers
recipes.description: Filled with corn, salsa, green onions, mozzarella cheese and bacon, these grilled pepper halves are sure to liven up your next cookout. They have a wonderful taste and give a fun twist to the usual corn on the cob.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Squash
recipes.description: Our oven-fried squash recipe is about as easy as they come. It's a crispy, crunchy way to use a bumper crop of summer squash.

recipes.title: Beans, Bacon & Tomato Bake
recipes.description: Bacon, tomatoes and lima beans combine for a nutrient-packed side dish that makes the perfect accompaniment to turkey.

recipes.title: Mexican-Style Pinto Beans
recipes.description: This Mexican-Style pinto beans recipe delivers rich, savory flavor and incredible versatility

recipes.title: Carrots and Snow Peas
recipes.description: This is without question my favorite side dish, both for flavor and ease of preparation. Sherry adds an amazing spark to the vegetables.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Mash
recipes.description: This quick and easy mashed cauliflower is a wonderful alternative to same-old mashed spuds, and it's healthier, too!

recipes.title: Cilantro Ginger Carrots
recipes.description: Peppery-sweet ginger and cooling cilantro have starring roles in this colorful side of crisp-tender carrots. The veggie goes from pan to plate in a twinkling.

recipes.title: Cilantro Potatoes
recipes.description: Fresh cilantro gives an exotic Syrian-style flavor to these easy, delicious skillet potatoes. They’re a creative complement to Mom’s tangy kabobs.

recipes.title: Colcannon
recipes.description: Putting together your St. Patrick's Day feast? Make sure there's room for colcannon, one of Ireland's most famous potato dishes, on the table.

recipes.title: Confetti Quinoa
recipes.description: If you have never tried quinoa, start with my easy side, brimming with colorful veggies. I serve it with orange-glazed chicken.

recipes.title: Corn Okra Creole
recipes.description: This dish is representative of my area of the country, and particularly the Texas-Louisiana border. The okra, corn and Creole seasonings are all popular here.

recipes.title: Cranberry Wild Rice Pilaf
recipes.description: This tender side dish is perfect for the holidays or any time you want to add a special touch. Dried cranberries, currants and almonds serve up color and texture. My co-workers all make this rice pilaf for their families.

recipes.title: Dutch Beets
recipes.description: Even people who typically shy away from beets will polish these off. This healthy canned vegetable recipe is quick to make, too, since you start with canned beets.

recipes.title: Quinoa Tabbouleh
recipes.description: We put a gluten-free twist on a classic Middle Eastern salad by using quinoa instead of bulgur. Our quinoa tabbouleh recipe features a protein-packed superfood, crisp veggies, fresh herbs and an easy lemon vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Eggplant Fries
recipes.description: My kids love this snack

recipes.title: Fiesta Corn and Beans
recipes.description: Bursting with southwestern flavors, the zesty veggie medley here can be served as a side dish or a meatless meal-in-one. The dollop of yogurt is a cool, creamy finishing touch.

recipes.title: Sauteed Cabbage
recipes.description: When I was young, my family grew our own cabbages. It was fun to put the cabbage to use in the kitchen, just as I did with this comforting side. With potatoes, deviled eggs and cornbread, fried cabbage tastes like home.

recipes.title: Garden-Fresh Rainbow Chard
recipes.description: Chard, a member of the beet family, is prized for its green leaves and colorful stalks. Stir up these good-for-you greens with garlic and red onion.

recipes.title: Garlic Asiago Cauliflower Rice
recipes.description: The garlic seasoning and Asiago really pack a punch, making this five-ingredient low-carb side dish a real weeknight winner.

recipes.title: German Red Cabbage
recipes.description: This inexpensive red cabbage recipe makes a tender, tasty vegetable side dish. It's traditionally German, but it pairs well with all kinds of foods, in every season.

recipes.title: Gouda Mixed Potato Mash
recipes.description: Everything's better with cheese, right? This cheesy two-potato mash is no exception. If you cube the cheese, you’ll discover delicious pockets of melted cheese throughout the dish.

recipes.title: Green Beans in Red Pepper Sauce
recipes.description: For easy veggies, I make a simple sauce of sweet red peppers, almonds and parsley. We also like this sauce with zucchini or roasted cauliflower.

recipes.title: Grilled Pattypans
recipes.description: Just a few minutes and a handful of ingredients are all you’ll need for this scrumptious side dish. Hoisin sauce and rice wine vinegar give grilled pattypans Asian flair.

recipes.title: Grilled Street Corn
recipes.description: Mexican food is my grandmother’s favorite. I wanted a perfect side for her legendary tacos, and this chile-lime grilled corn turned out to be just right.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Green Beans
recipes.description: Green beans are a reliable standby, but they can seem ordinary on their own. Just a couple of extra ingredients give them a sweet and salty attitude. This is definitely my family's favorite way to enjoy them.

recipes.title: Honey-Thyme Butternut Squash
recipes.description: This golden, honey-sweetened squash is just as hearty and comforting as your favorite potato dish. With its bright color, it makes an attractive side for special autumn meals.

recipes.title: Couscous and Broccoli
recipes.description: This stovetop couscous and broccoli recipe delivers bright, citrusy flavor without dirtying a single extra pot.

recipes.title: Lemon Parmesan Orzo
recipes.description: A splash of lemon and a shower of chopped parsley make this orzo one of my family's most requested springtime sides. It's fantastic with chicken, pork and fish, or you can eat it on its own as a light lunch.

recipes.title: Mashed Peppery Turnips
recipes.description: I created this recipe in an attempt to use up a great turnip harvest from our garden, and to lighten up one of our favorite dishes. By using turnips in place of potatoes, I made a low-carb side. Now we rarely serve plain mashed potatoes!

recipes.title: Mediterranean Cauliflower
recipes.description: I adapted a recipe I received from a friend to make this delicious

recipes.title: Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes with Pancetta
recipes.description: Classic American mashed potatoes take a trip to Italy with the flavors of olive oil, garlic, and pancetta.

recipes.title: Parmesan-Roasted Broccoli
recipes.description: Broccoli and cheese are the simple but shining stars in this Parmesan-roasted broccoli recipe that really couldn't be easier

recipes.title: Quinoa and Peas
recipes.description: In this speedy and nutritious quinoa and peas bowl, protein-rich quinoa is paired with sweet green peas, drizzled with olive oil, and seasoned with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Red Potatoes with Beans
recipes.description: You can serve this homey blend of fresh green beans, potato wedges and chopped red onion hot or cold. Either way, this easy side dish makes a pleasing accompaniment to Mom's meat loaf or almost any other meat.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus and Leeks
recipes.description: No vegetable says spring quite like asparagus. In this recipe, we combine pretty green spears with leeks. Crushed red pepper adds a bit of zest.

recipes.title: Roasted Fennel and Peppers
recipes.description: Fennel makes for a tasty change of pace in this versatile side that goes nicely with grilled meats. Best of all, it's full of flavor and easy to do

recipes.title: Roasted Pumpkin and Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: While traveling to Taiwan, I had the pleasure of trying a unique vegetable dish that included fresh pumpkin. It inspired me to roast pumpkin with Brussels sprouts.

recipes.title: Roasted Rosemary Cauliflower
recipes.description: Roasting the cauliflower really brings out its flavor in this side dish. Even folks who aren't cauliflower lovers like it this way.

recipes.title: Shredded Gingered Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: Even people who normally don't care for Brussels sprouts will ask for a second helping of these.

recipes.title: Smoky Cauliflower
recipes.description: The smoked Spanish paprika gives a simple side of roasted cauliflower extra depth. This is definitely a favorite.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Squash with Tomatoes and Olives
recipes.description: This squash is outstanding as a side dish, but you can also top it with canned tuna to create a simple, healthy main dish. It's easy and so tasty!  I like to use my own canned tomatoes for the best flavor.

recipes.title: Spiced Carrots & Butternut Squash
recipes.description: When I've got a lot going on, my slow cooker is my go-to tool for cooking veggies. The sweetness of the squash and carrots really complements the spicy seasonings.

recipes.title: Spicy Grilled Eggplant
recipes.description: This side dish goes well with any meat you might also be grilling. Thanks to the Cajun seasoning, the zesty eggplant gets more attention than an ordinary veggie. —Greg Fontenot, The Woodlands, Texas

recipes.title: Spring Asparagus
recipes.description: This fresh and colorful side dish is delicious served warm or cold. I get lots of compliments on the homemade dressing.

recipes.title: Stewed Zucchini and Tomatoes
recipes.description: A fresh take on traditional vegetable sides, this make-ahead dish stars zucchini, tomatoes and green pepper. Bubbly cheddar cheese adds a down-home feel.

recipes.title: Sauteed Zucchini
recipes.description: Sauteed zucchini is a near-perfect side dish. It’s light and fresh-tasting, goes with almost anything and best of all, it comes together in just minutes.

recipes.title: Crockpot Stuffing
recipes.description: This vegetarian Crockpot stuffing is a keeper. It has all the classic flavor, but it's cooked in a slow cooker for a moist, fluffy stuffing that leaves your oven free for other dishes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Carrot Crisp
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes take a different twist in this whipped side dish that pairs them with carrots. Subtly sweet, it has just a hint of garlic, while the nut and crumb topping adds a fun crunch to any holiday meal.

recipes.title: Vegetable Barley Saute
recipes.description: This wonderful side dish can easily be turned into a hearty entree by adding cooked chicken.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Buttermilk mashed potatoes are just as creamy and fluffy as traditional mashed potatoes and require little (or no!) butter. Our recipe includes a little garlic to add a sweet, rich character to the tangy mash.

recipes.title: Grilled Broccoli
recipes.description: Coating broccoli in a lemon juice marinade and a layer of Parmesan, then hitting it with a smoky char, makes for a showstopper of a grilled broccoli side dish.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrots and Onions
recipes.description: Season roasted carrots and onions with thyme, pepper and a splash of vinegar for a lovely, balanced vegetable side dish.

recipes.title: Seasoned Green Beans
recipes.description: A delicious meal is more than just an impressive main. Our seasoned green beans prove just how effective a knockout side dish can be, without taking more than 10 minutes to make.

recipes.title: Grilled Stuffed Zucchini
recipes.description: Grilled stuffed zucchini is filled with a light and savory blend of sauteed vegetables, breadcrumbs, melty cheese and fresh mint.

recipes.title: Succotash
recipes.description: This succotash recipe has everything that makes Southern cooking irresistible: ham hocks, beans, vegetables and herbs. It's easily customizable too, so you can add pretty much anything from your vegetable garden.

recipes.description: Spain's most famous cheese, traditionally made from Manchega sheep's milk. A firm, buttery cheese with a distinctive basket-weave pattern on the rind.

recipes.title: Brick Cheese
recipes.description: An American original developed in Wisconsin in the late 1800s by Swiss-born cheese maker John Jossi. Named for both its shape and the traditional use of bricks to press it.

recipes.title: Limburger Cheese
recipes.description: A soft, creamy washed-rind cheese known for its strong aroma. Developed by Belgian Trappist monks in the 19th century, later brought to Wisconsin by German and Swiss immigrants.

recipes.title: Taleggio Cheese
recipes.description: A semi-soft Italian washed-rind cheese from Val Taleggio in Lombardy. Aromatic yet mild with tangy, meaty flavors and a fruity finish.

recipes.title: Reblochon Cheese
recipes.description: A celebrated soft, creamy cheese from Haute-Savoie, France, known for its rich, nutty flavor. One of France's top-selling cheeses. The name means 'to pinch the udder again.'

recipes.title: Bleu d'Auvergne
recipes.description: A creamy, milder blue cheese from the Auvergne region of France. Made from cow's milk with less salt than most blue cheeses.

recipes.title: Roquefort Style Cheese
recipes.description: One of the most famous blue cheeses internationally. This recipe applies traditional Roquefort techniques to cow's milk, as authentic Roquefort uses sheep's milk.

recipes.title: Gorgonzola Picante
recipes.description: A traditional Italian blue cheese from Piedmont using the historic two-curd 'del Nonno' (Grandfather's) method. Drier and more crumbly than modern Gorgonzola Dolce.

recipes.title: Burrata Cheese
recipes.description: A fresh Italian cheese developed in early 20th century Apulia. A mozzarella shell filled with stracciatella - shredded mozzarella curds soaked in cream.

recipes.title: Edam Cheese
recipes.description: A traditional Dutch cheese made with partially skimmed milk. Known for its spherical shape and subtle, delicate flavor when young.

recipes.title: Labneh Cheese
recipes.description: A tangy, creamy Middle Eastern strained yogurt cheese. Simple to make and versatile - serve as a dip, spread, or rolled into balls preserved in olive oil.

recipes.title: Queso Oaxaca
recipes.description: A Mexican string cheese similar to mozzarella, traditionally wound into a ball shape. Named after the Oaxaca region of Mexico. Melts beautifully.

recipes.title: Triple Crème Cheese
recipes.description: A decadent soft-ripened cheese with extra cream added. Like Brie or Camembert taken to the next level with a minimum of 75% butterfat.

recipes.title: Lactic Cheese
recipes.description: One of the oldest and simplest cheeses, relying on slow acid development rather than rennet. Can be made with cow, goat, or sheep milk.

recipes.title: Schiz Cheese
recipes.description: A little-known fresh cheese from the Dolomites of northern Italy. Unique in that it can be heated without melting, developing a caramelized exterior.

recipes.title: Mysost (Scandinavian Whey Cheese)
recipes.description: A traditional Scandinavian cheese made by slowly reducing whey until it caramelizes. Also called Primost. Goat's milk version is called Gjetost.

recipes.title: Shropshire Blue Cheese
recipes.description: A strikingly beautiful cheese with bright orange color and distinctive blue veins throughout. Complex flavor balancing tang and creaminess.

recipes.title: Farmstead Cheese
recipes.description: A simple aged cheese that grandmothers made on the back of the stove to preserve extra milk. One of the first hard cheeses a beginner should make.

recipes.title: Beer Infused Cheese
recipes.description: A semi-hard cheese washed with beer during aging, developing complex flavors that complement craft brews.

recipes.title: CamBlu Cheese
recipes.description: A hybrid cheese combining Camembert's mushroomy white rind with the flavor of mild blue cheese inside. The best of both worlds.

recipes.title: Fourme d'Ambert
recipes.description: A mild blue cheese from the Auvergne Mountains of France. Notable for its tall, narrow cylindrical shape and gentle, approachable flavor.

recipes.title: Spanish Blue Cheese (Picón Style)
recipes.description: A robust blue cheese based on traditional varieties from the mountains of northern Spain, related to Cabrales and Valdeón.

recipes.title: Giacomo's Blue Cheese
recipes.description: A hybrid of Spanish and French heirloom blue cheeses. Softer and milder with a creamy, open texture and beautiful lacing of blue veins.

recipes.title: Blue By You Cheese
recipes.description: A versatile blue cheese recipe for intermediate makers who have made hard cheeses. Style can range from mild Scandinavian to aggressive Spanish.

recipes.title: Hispánico Cheese
recipes.description: An authentic Spanish-style cheese with smooth texture and mild, buttery flavor. Perfect for snacking and pairing with wine.

recipes.title: Muenster Cheese
recipes.description: A typical washed rind cheese with less surface ripening but maintaining strong flavor. Creamy interior with orange-tinted rind.

recipes.title: Maasdam Cheese
recipes.description: A Dutch-style cheese similar to Swiss but developed in the Netherlands. Features characteristic large eyes and nutty, sweet flavor.

recipes.title: Alpine Tomme
recipes.description: A rustic mountain cheese from the French Alps. Tomme refers to small wheels of cheese made by farmers from leftover milk.

recipes.title: Beaufort Cheese
recipes.description: A prestigious French Alpine cheese from the Savoie region. Known as the 'Prince of Gruyères' with a smooth, dense texture and complex, fruity flavor.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese
recipes.description: A simple acid-set cheese made with lemon juice. Fresh, mild flavor perfect for spreading or cooking. Similar to paneer but with citrus notes.

recipes.title: Queso de Mahón
recipes.description: A traditional cheese from the island of Menorca in Spain's Balearic Islands. Named after the port of Mahón, it has a distinctive square shape with rounded edges.

recipes.title: Tetilla Cheese
recipes.description: A soft, creamy cheese from Galicia in northwestern Spain. Named for its distinctive pear or breast shape. Mild, slightly tangy with a buttery finish.

recipes.title: Italico Cheese
recipes.description: A soft Italian table cheese with a washed rind. Creamy interior with mild, buttery flavor that becomes more pungent with age.

recipes.title: Formaggio ValCampella
recipes.description: A beginner-friendly Italian-style cheese. Mild, creamy, and versatile - an excellent first cheese for new cheese makers.

recipes.title: Cultured Mozzarella
recipes.description: Traditional mozzarella made with thermophilic culture, unlike the quick 30-minute version. Develops more complex flavor through proper acidification.

recipes.title: Tomme Style Cheese
recipes.description: A classic Alpine-style cheese made when milk is abundant or when cream has been skimmed for butter. Versatile and forgiving for home cheesemakers.

recipes.title: Tomme de Savoie
recipes.description: A mild, semi-soft cow's milk cheese with clean flavors of citrus, mushroom, and cellar. Its suede-like gray/tan rind is mottled with natural molds.

recipes.title: Goat Milk Tomme
recipes.description: An aged goat cheese with lightly cooked curds and gentle pressing. Matures in 60-90 days, developing rich, nuanced flavors from the goat milk.

recipes.title: Mountain Style Tomme
recipes.description: A rich buttery tomme with supple texture, made using age-old techniques that follow the changing seasons and migrations of herds.

recipes.title: Toma Ossolano
recipes.description: From the Piedmont region of northern Italy, also known as Ossolano d'Alpe or Grasso d'Alpe (the fat one from the Alps). Made quickly with higher moisture for shorter aging.

recipes.title: Raclette Cheese
recipes.description: A semi-firm Alpine cheese famous for melting. The name means 'to scrape' - traditionally the melted face is scraped onto vegetables, meat, or bread.

recipes.title: Appenzeller Cheese
recipes.description: A fantastic Swiss cheese made for over 700 years. While aging, the rind is rubbed with a secret blend of yeast, alcohol, and 25 different herbs, roots, leaves, petals, seeds, and bark.

recipes.title: Caerphilly Cheese
recipes.description: A Welsh cheese with a delightfully salty flavor, bright white color, and crumbly texture. Traditionally an early-ripening cheese, though it can be aged longer.

recipes.title: Lancashire Cheese
recipes.description: One of Britain's oldest and quickest pressed cheeses. Can range from creamy to crumbly with complex flavor depending on dryness and aging time.

recipes.title: Wensleydale Cheese (Yorkshire)
recipes.description: A creamy yet crumbly cheese with a fresh, slightly acidic flavor from Yorkshire's limestone pastures. First made by French monks from the Roquefort region in the 12th century.

recipes.title: Cheshire Cheese
recipes.description: One of Britain's oldest and finest cheeses, mentioned in the Domesday Book of 1086. Known for its crumbly texture and mild, slightly salty flavor.

recipes.title: Red Leicester Cheese
recipes.description: A traditional English cheese with deep russet-red color and flaky yet silky texture. Savory with subtle nuttiness, finishing smooth and rich.

recipes.title: Crescenza (Stracchino)
recipes.description: A soft, fresh Italian cheese from northern Italy, celebrated for its delicate flavor and creamy texture. The name 'Stracchino' means 'tired,' from milk of cows returning from Alpine migrations.

recipes.title: Robiola Cheese
recipes.description: The perfect cheese for home cheesemakers, from the Langhe Hills south of Turin. The name derives from Latin 'rubere' referring to the reddish color the crust develops with age.

recipes.title: Robiolini Cheese
recipes.description: A wonderful offspring of Camembert and Robiola, combining the best of both cheeses using Flora Danica culture for a soft, delicate texture.

recipes.title: Gorgonzola Dolce
recipes.description: The milder, creamier version of Gorgonzola with a softer, spreadable texture. 'Dolce' means sweet, referring to its gentler flavor profile.

recipes.title: Morbier Cheese
recipes.description: A unique French cheese with a distinctive ash layer in the center. The surface is washed to develop an aromatic red rind. At 3-4 months, it ripens to a supple, soft texture.

recipes.title: Livarot Cheese
recipes.description: One of the oldest Normandy cheeses, nicknamed 'The Colonel' for its five reed bands resembling military stripes. Full-bodied with nutty, salty, slightly spicy flavors.

recipes.title: Pont l'Évêque Cheese
recipes.description: A beautiful cheese that's a mix of bloomy rind and washed rind, falling between Camembert and Livarot. From Normandy, France.

recipes.title: Saint-Nectaire Cheese
recipes.description: One of the great cheeses from the Auvergne region of South Central France. Part of the family of uncooked pressed cheeses, made for centuries on small family farms.

recipes.title: Saint-Marcellin Cheese
recipes.description: A small French cheese with a rich interior that develops pronounced aromas with a supple, melting texture. Traditionally made with goat milk, now primarily cow milk.
recipes.servings_yield: About 6-8 small rounds from 1 gallon milk

recipes.title: Cantal Cheese
recipes.description: A hard, long-aging cheese from the Auvergne with similarities to English Cheddar. More effort is made to remove moisture and ripen the curd before molding.

recipes.title: Port Salut (Saint Paulin) Cheese
recipes.description: A semi-soft cheese with rich creamy flavor and smooth texture, developed by Trappist Monks. Port du Salut means 'the Gates of Salvation.'

recipes.title: Butterkäse Cheese
recipes.description: A wonderful German cheese that's easy to make with a buttery texture, hence the name. Ready to enjoy within two months.

recipes.title: Dunlop Cheese
recipes.description: A Scottish cheese traditionally made with higher moisture and aged 5-7 months. Mild nutty flavor when young, develops subtle, creamy flavors as it ages.

recipes.title: Danbo Cheese
recipes.description: A Danish cheese similar to Swiss and Emmental. Mild, slightly sweet flavor with small irregular holes.

recipes.title: Belper Knolle Cheese
recipes.description: A Swiss lactic-fermented cheese seasoned with salt and garlic, then rolled in crushed black pepper. Minimal rennet creates unique flavor and texture.
recipes.servings_yield: About 8-10 small balls from 1 gallon milk

recipes.title: Primo Sale Cheese
recipes.description: A fresh Italian cheese wonderfully versatile - often layered with herbs or chiles, topped with pesto, or seasoned with spices.

recipes.title: Creole Cream Cheese
recipes.description: A rediscovered gem of southern dairy tradition from Louisiana's Creole Country. Once nearly lost, this recipe celebrates unique regional cheese history.

recipes.title: Wine Infused Cheese
recipes.description: A semi-hard cheese washed with wine during aging, developing rich, complex flavors that complement fine wines.

recipes.title: Cotswold Cheese
recipes.description: A Double Gloucester-style cheese flavored with chives and onions. Golden colored with savory herb flavor throughout.

recipes.title: Homemade Sour Cream
recipes.description: Quick and easy homemade sour cream that's far superior to store-bought. Rich, tangy, and perfect for baking or topping.

recipes.title: Cultured Butter
recipes.description: Real butter with a rich, full, slightly nutty flavor from natural fermentation. A European-style butter that's easy to make at home.

recipes.title: Pouligny-Saint-Pierre Cheese
recipes.description: A French goat cheese with a distinctive pyramid shape. From the Loire Valley, known for its delicate flavor and beautiful natural or ash-covered rind.
recipes.servings_yield: About 1 lb from 1 gallon goat milk

recipes.title: Saint-Maure de Touraine Cheese
recipes.description: The classic French goat cheese log from the Loire Valley, made in much the same way for over one thousand years. Features a straw through the center.
recipes.servings_yield: About 2-3 logs from 1 gallon goat milk

recipes.title: Jarlsberg-Style Cheese
recipes.description: A Norwegian-style cheese similar to Swiss Emmentaler but with sweeter, nuttier flavor. Uses mesophilic cultures at lower temps with washed curd for the characteristic taste.

recipes.title: Canestrato (Italian Basket Cheese)
recipes.description: A traditional Italian cheese made in woven reed baskets that leave a distinctive pattern on the rind. Similar to Pecorino but with unique texture.

recipes.title: Alpine Washed Rind Cheese
recipes.description: A mountain-style cheese combining Alpine cheesemaking traditions with washed rind techniques. Develops complex, earthy flavors through aging.

recipes.title: Juustoa (Finnish Squeaky Cheese)
recipes.description: A traditional Finnish squeaky cheese, also known as Leipäjuusto or 'bread cheese.' Traditionally eaten with morning coffee or enjoyed as cut pieces.

recipes.title: Cup Cheese (Pennsylvania Dutch)
recipes.description: A Pennsylvania Dutch cheese made by the Amish and Mennonites since before the American Revolution. A soft, spreadable cheese traditionally served in cups.

recipes.title: Tomme au Marc
recipes.description: A French tomme-style cheese aged with grape pomace (marc) from wine production. The grape skins and seeds impart fruity, wine-like flavors to the rind.

recipes.title: Provola Cheese
recipes.description: A southern Italian pasta filata cheese similar to provolone but aged for a shorter time. Often smoked for added flavor.

recipes.title: Farmer's Cheese
recipes.description: A simple farmer's cheese that's easy to make at home without specialized equipment. Start to finish in about 30 minutes. Often called 'lazy man's ricotta' due to similar flavor.

recipes.title: Homemade Cheddar Cheese
recipes.description: Homemade cheddar is rich and flavorful. Natural bandaging allows the cheese to achieve complex flavors during aging. Can be made as waxed cheddar or clothbound cheddar.
recipes.servings_yield: One cheese wheel from 4 gallons milk

recipes.title: 18th Century Farmhouse Cheddar
recipes.description: An old 18th century recipe for farmhouse cheddar that captures traditional cheesemaking techniques using simple ingredients and time-honored methods. Becomes dry and slightly salty, suitable for grating like parmesan.

recipes.title: Fromage Blanc
recipes.description: An easy to make French soft cheese that's ready in less than 24 hours. Strained for just a few hours it achieves a cream cheese-like texture; strained for 10-12 hours it's most similar to ricotta.

recipes.title: Yogurt Cheese (Labneh-Style)
recipes.description: A simple recipe creating a creamy, tangy spread or dip from yogurt using just one ingredient. Has the texture of very thick yogurt or cream cheese, depending on how much whey is removed.

recipes.title: Colby Cheese
recipes.description: A mild cheese with an open texture. Colby has more moisture than most cheddars, and that extra moisture is maintained with cheese wax during the aging process.

recipes.title: Homemade Paneer
recipes.description: A simple homemade cheese that comes together quickly with just a few ingredients. This Indian cheese can be prepared in under two hours from start to finish.

recipes.title: Traditional Cultured Mozzarella
recipes.description: This cheese-making method employs natural starter cultures and slow fermentation rather than quick acid-set techniques, yielding superior flavor and texture complexity.

recipes.title: Cultured Butter
recipes.description: Cultured butter has so much more flavor than regular butter, and it's incredibly easy to make yourself. The cream is fermented before churning, creating a tangy, complex flavor.
recipes.servings_yield: About 1.25 cups butter and 3/4 cup buttermilk

recipes.title: Crème Fraîche
recipes.description: A thick, tangy cream that has been cultured with beneficial bacteria, similar to sour cream but with a milder flavor and smoother texture. Less prone to curdling when heated, making it perfect for sauces and soups.

recipes.title: Grandma's Potato Cheese Casserole
recipes.description: A creamy, cheesy potato casserole with layers of sliced potatoes, cheese, and cream of chicken soup. Simple enough for weeknights, special enough for holidays.

recipes.title: Funeral Potatoes (Church Lady Casserole)
recipes.description: A creamy, cheesy potato casserole topped with crunchy corn flakes. Named for its frequent appearance at funeral receptions, though it's welcome at any potluck.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad with Cottage Cheese
recipes.description: A creamy, fluffy lime gelatin salad studded with crushed pineapple and cottage cheese. The quintessential retro side dish that graced every 1960s-70s holiday table.

recipes.title: Gruyère Cheese
recipes.description: The classic 'mountain cheese' of France and Switzerland. Made from full fat milk with a high temperature scald for proper aging. Sweet, slightly salty, becoming earthier and more complex with age.

recipes.title: Emmental (Swiss) Cheese
recipes.description: The famous hole-filled Swiss cheese from the Emmental region of Bern. Propionic bacteria consume lactic acid and release CO2, forming the characteristic 'eyes.' Nutty, slightly sweet flavor.

recipes.title: Gouda Cheese
recipes.description: A remarkable Dutch cheese that transforms with age. Young Gouda is mild and creamy; aged Gouda develops deep golden color, caramel sweetness, and crunchy protein crystals. The 'washing' step creates its natural sweetness.

recipes.title: Havarti Cheese
recipes.description: A smooth, buttery Danish cheese with small irregular holes. Created in the 1850s by Hanne Nielsen after traveling Europe to learn cheesemaking. Perfect for melting, grilling, or eating fresh.

recipes.title: Provolone Cheese
recipes.description: An Italian stretched-curd cheese with less moisture than Mozzarella, giving it longer shelf life and richer flavor. Can be mild and sweet (Dolce) or sharp and pungent (Piccante) depending on aging.

recipes.title: Classic Green Bean Casserole
recipes.description: The iconic Thanksgiving side dish created in 1955. Green beans in creamy mushroom sauce topped with crispy fried onions. So beloved the original recipe is in the Smithsonian.

recipes.title: Queso Pategras (Argentine Dutch-Style)
recipes.description: Argentina's most popular table cheese, a semi-hard Dutch-style cheese with mild, slightly nutty flavor. Excellent for sandwiches and melting.

recipes.title: Queso Mar del Plata
recipes.description: Soft, mild Argentine cheese from the coastal city of Mar del Plata. Creamy texture with a washed rind and buttery flavor, perfect for spreading.

recipes.title: Queso Holanda Argentino (Argentine Holland Cheese)
recipes.description: Argentina's ball-shaped Dutch-style cheese, milder and younger than Magnasco Edam. Covered in distinctive red wax, popular for everyday eating.

recipes.title: Queso Cuartirolo Argentino
recipes.description: Soft, fresh Argentine cheese with slight tang and creamy texture. Made from cow's milk, it's perfect for salads, sandwiches, and cooking.

recipes.title: Queso Barra Argentino (Bar Cheese)
recipes.description: Mild, semi-soft Argentine cheese shaped into rectangular bars. Excellent melting cheese, commonly used for sandwiches and pizza in Argentina.

recipes.title: Queso Gruyerón Argentino
recipes.description: Argentina's Swiss-style hard cheese with nutty, slightly sweet flavor. Features small eyes and firm texture, excellent for fondue and gratins.

recipes.title: Queso de Campo Argentino (Farmhouse Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional farmhouse cheese from Argentine estancias. Semi-soft with natural rind, made using simple countryside methods passed down through generations.

recipes.title: Espresso Rubbed Cheddar
recipes.description: Sharp cheddar coated with finely ground espresso, creating an earthy, complex flavor profile. The coffee enhances the cheddar's sharpness with subtle bitter notes.

recipes.title: Bourbon Washed Cheddar
recipes.description: Sharp cheddar aged with bourbon washes, developing complex caramel, vanilla, and oak notes from the whiskey. A true American original.

recipes.title: Whiskey Washed Gouda
recipes.description: Creamy Gouda with smoky, caramel notes from whiskey washes. The spirit's complexity complements Gouda's natural sweetness.

recipes.title: Habanero Cheddar
recipes.description: Sharp cheddar studded with diced habanero peppers, delivering intense fruity heat. For serious heat lovers who want flavor with their fire.

recipes.title: Ghost Pepper Jack
recipes.description: Creamy Monterey Jack with ghost pepper pieces for those who seek extreme heat. One of the hottest cheese varieties possible - handle with care.

recipes.title: Carolina Reaper Jack
recipes.description: For the ultimate heat seekers: Monterey Jack with Carolina Reaper, the world's hottest pepper. Fruity sweetness precedes volcanic heat.

recipes.title: Scotch Bonnet Cheddar
recipes.description: Sharp cheddar with scotch bonnet peppers bringing Caribbean heat and distinctive fruity, slightly sweet flavor. Pairs wonderfully with tropical dishes.

recipes.title: Ancho Chile Gouda
recipes.description: Creamy Gouda infused with dried ancho chiles, providing mild heat with rich, fruity, slightly sweet and smoky notes. Mexican-Dutch fusion at its best.

recipes.title: Poblano Pepper Jack
recipes.description: Creamy Monterey Jack studded with roasted poblano peppers. Mild heat with rich, earthy pepper flavor - perfect for those who prefer flavor over fire.

recipes.title: Serrano Pepper Monterey Jack
recipes.description: Monterey Jack with fresh serrano peppers providing bright, clean heat with crisp pepper flavor. More heat than jalapeño, less than habanero.

recipes.title: Maple Smoked Cheddar
recipes.description: Sharp Vermont-style cheddar cold-smoked with maple wood chips. The maple smoke adds subtle sweetness and depth, perfect with apples and cured meats.

recipes.title: Chocolate Goat Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy fresh goat cheese blended with dark chocolate for a unique dessert cheese. The tang of chèvre balances the chocolate's sweetness beautifully.

recipes.title: Za'atar Labneh
recipes.description: Thick, creamy labneh rolled in za'atar - the classic Middle Eastern combination. Tangy cheese meets earthy thyme, sesame, and sumac.

recipes.title: Harissa Goat Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy fresh goat cheese swirled with spicy, smoky harissa paste. The tangy cheese tempers the harissa's heat while showcasing its complex spices.

recipes.title: Berbere Spiced Gouda
recipes.description: Creamy Gouda infused with Ethiopian berbere spice blend - warm, complex, and mildly spicy with notes of cardamom, fenugreek, and chiles.

recipes.title: Gochujang Cheddar
recipes.description: Sharp cheddar infused with gochujang, Korean fermented chile paste. Sweet, spicy, and deeply savory - umami meets Wisconsin tradition.

recipes.title: Wasabi Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Rich cream cheese with wasabi's distinctive nasal heat. Unique pungency that clears the sinuses - perfect on bagels with smoked salmon.

recipes.title: Miso Aged Gouda
recipes.description: Aged Gouda enhanced with white miso paste, creating unprecedented umami depth. The fermented soybean paste amplifies Gouda's natural caramel notes.

recipes.title: Thai Chile Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Rich cream cheese with fiery Thai bird's eye chiles and lime zest. Bright, intense heat balanced by creamy richness - Southeast Asian inspiration.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Light, aromatic cream cheese infused with fresh lemongrass. Citrusy and floral without being overpowering - a unique Southeast Asian twist.

recipes.title: Ayib (Ethiopian Fresh Cheese)
recipes.description: Ethiopian fresh cheese similar to dry cottage cheese. Mild and crumbly, it provides cooling contrast to spicy Ethiopian dishes. Essential accompaniment to injera.

recipes.title: Wara (Nigerian Fresh Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional Nigerian soft cheese made by Fulani herders. Coagulated with calotropis plant juice, it has a unique slightly bitter edge and soft, tofu-like texture.

recipes.title: Klila (Moroccan Dried Cheese)
recipes.description: Moroccan dried cheese made by Berber communities. Fresh cheese is salted, shaped into balls, and sun-dried for long preservation. Reconstituted in stews or eaten as snack.

recipes.title: Akkawi (Levantine Brine Cheese)
recipes.description: Mild, white brined cheese from the Levant. Soft texture with moderate saltiness, traditionally desalted before use in sweets like knafeh or eaten fresh.

recipes.title: Nabulsi (Palestinian Boiled Cheese)
recipes.description: Palestinian brined cheese from Nablus, distinctively flavored with mahlab (cherry pit spice) and mastic. Boiled preparation gives unique texture and flavor profile.

recipes.title: Rushan (Chinese Fan Cheese)
recipes.description: Unique Chinese cheese from Yunnan's Bai people. Fresh cheese is stretched into thin sheets, dried on bamboo frames into fan shapes. Grilled or fried as street food.

recipes.title: Rubing (Yunnan Goat Cheese)
recipes.description: Firm, mild goat cheese from Yunnan Province. Dense texture holds up to grilling or frying. Often served with chili flakes as a snack or appetizer.

recipes.title: Chhurpi (Himalayan Hard Cheese)
recipes.description: Extremely hard Himalayan cheese, traditionally from yak milk. So hard it must be chewed for hours or softened in tea. Traditional protein source for mountain peoples.

recipes.title: Kurut (Kazakh Dried Cheese Balls)
recipes.description: Central Asian dried cheese balls made from strained yogurt. Extremely salty and sour, these long-lasting provisions sustained nomadic herders. Dissolved in water for a tangy drink.

recipes.title: Irimshik (Kazakh Sweet Dried Cheese)
recipes.description: Unique Kazakh cheese made by slowly cooking milk until it caramelizes and dries. Sweet, crumbly texture with butterscotch notes - more confection than traditional cheese.

recipes.title: Urda (Romanian Whey Cheese)
recipes.description: Romanian fresh cheese made from heated whey, similar to Italian ricotta. Light, fluffy texture with mild, slightly sweet flavor. Essential in Romanian cuisine.

recipes.title: Brânză de Burduf (Romanian Bark Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional Transylvanian sheep cheese, aged in pine bark cylinders or sheep stomach. Strong, pungent flavor with slight resinous notes from the bark. A mountain shepherd specialty.

recipes.title: Tvarog (Slavic Curd Cheese)
recipes.description: Essential Eastern European fresh cheese, known as tvorog (Russia), twaróg (Poland), or tvaroh (Czech). Tangy, crumbly fresh cheese used in both sweet and savory dishes.

recipes.title: Sulguni (Georgian Stretched Cheese)
recipes.description: Iconic Georgian cheese with distinctive layered, stringy texture from stretching. Brined in salt water, it's mild with slight sourness. Often smoked for deeper flavor.

recipes.title: Rum Washed Gouda
recipes.description: Creamy Dutch Gouda enhanced with Caribbean rum washes during aging. Caramel, vanilla, and molasses notes from the rum complement Gouda's natural sweetness.

recipes.title: Tequila Washed Queso
recipes.description: Mexican semi-firm cheese enhanced with reposado tequila washes. Agave and oak notes from the tequila create a distinctly Mexican cheese with complex character.

recipes.title: Szechuan Peppercorn Jack
recipes.description: Creamy Monterey Jack with Szechuan peppercorns' distinctive numbing, citrusy sensation. Unique 'ma la' effect creates tingles unlike any other cheese.

recipes.title: Dukkah Coated Chèvre
recipes.description: Creamy fresh goat cheese rolled in Egyptian dukkah - a blend of hazelnuts, coriander, cumin, and sesame. Crunchy coating with Middle Eastern aromatics.

recipes.title: Everything Bagel Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Homemade cream cheese loaded with everything bagel seasoning - poppy seeds, sesame seeds, dried garlic, dried onion, and coarse salt. A deli classic made at home.

recipes.title: Piri Piri Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Cream cheese infused with piri piri - the African bird's eye chili used in Portuguese-African cuisine. Bright, sharp heat with citrus notes.

recipes.title: Saffron Paneer (Kesar Paneer)
recipes.description: Fresh Indian paneer infused with saffron, creating golden color and subtle floral, honey notes. Luxurious version of the everyday cheese, perfect for special occasions.

recipes.title: Black Garlic Brie
recipes.description: Creamy Brie-style cheese with sweet, caramelized black garlic folded throughout. Deep umami notes without raw garlic's pungency - sophisticated and complex.

recipes.title: Matcha Green Tea Cream Cheese
recipes.description: Silky cream cheese with ceremonial grade matcha, creating earthy, vegetal notes with subtle sweetness. Vibrant green color and sophisticated umami character.

recipes.title: Sauvignon Blanc Honey Vinaigrette
recipes.description: A bright, elegant vinaigrette with wine, lemon, and honey.

recipes.title: Pine Nut Gremolata
recipes.description: A crunchy Italian herb condiment with toasted pine nuts.

recipes.title: Pickled Red Pearl Onions
recipes.description: Tangy, spiced pickled onions for garnishing salads and plates.

recipes.title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
recipes.description: Classic balsamic dressing with shallots.

recipes.title: Soy Ginger Vinaigrette

recipes.title: Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce (Stovetop)

recipes.title: Onion-Soup-Based Swedish Meatball Sauce
recipes.description: A creamy Swedish meatball sauce using mushroom gravy and onion soup mixes. Handwritten notes suggest adjustments for larger batches.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce
recipes.description: A slow-cooker method for making ghost pepper hot sauce with brown sugar, molasses, and vegetables for a complex, fiery condiment.

recipes.title: Roasted Ghost Pepper and Garlic Hot Sauce
recipes.description: Super spicy roasted ghost pepper and garlic hot sauce. Versatile and goes well with various dishes and cuisines.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomatillo Salsa (Salsa Verde)
recipes.description: Super fast and easy roasted tomatillo salsa with charred tomatillos, fresh lime juice, cilantro, and diced onions.

recipes.title: Blistered Shishito Peppers
recipes.description: Slightly sweet, rarely very spicy peppers blistered until charred, tossed in an Asian-inspired sauce. About one in ten packs unexpected heat!

recipes.title: Charred Habanero Oil
recipes.description: A smoky, spicy chili oil made by charring habaneros under the broiler and blending with oil. Drizzle on everything.

recipes.title: Aycaramba Cranberry Habanero Hot Sauce
recipes.description: A festive habanero spice paste with cranberries - can be frozen for cooking, added to ketchup, or eaten with chips.

recipes.title: Habanero Pepper Jelly
recipes.description: Sweet and spicy habanero pepper jelly perfect for serving with soft cheese like chevre or brie, or as an addition to grilled cheese sandwiches.

recipes.title: Hot Carolina Reaper or Ghost Pepper Salt
recipes.description: Spicy salt made with super hot peppers like Carolina Reapers or ghost peppers. An easy, addictive way to use extremely hot peppers.

recipes.title: Hot Carolina Reaper or Ghost Pepper Salt
recipes.description: Homemade spicy salt blend combining super-hot peppers with aromatic varieties. Customizable proportions work well with fresh or frozen peppers.

recipes.title: Smoked Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce
recipes.description: Intensely spicy hot sauce made from dried, smoked ghost peppers with roasted garlic and vinegar. The smokiness makes this the most flavorful hot sauce.

recipes.title: Strawberry Carolina Reaper Hot Sauce
recipes.description: A fruit-based hot sauce using fresh strawberries and lime with the world's hottest pepper, the Carolina Reaper. Outrageously hot!

recipes.title: Easy and Spicy Thai Chili Oil
recipes.description: Homemade Thai-style chili oil with bold flavors - really spicy and super easy to make with just 6 ingredients.

recipes.title: Homemade Three Chili Hot Sauce
recipes.description: A homemade hot sauce using jalapeño, habanero, and serrano peppers for complex heat and flavor.

recipes.title: Maple Dressing
recipes.description: This sweet-and-sour dressing was inspired by the traditional 'sour sap,' or fermented maple sap, traditionally used to season roasting meat.

recipes.title: Tamarack Honey Drizzle
recipes.description: The tender spring shoots of the tamarack tree are nutritious, slightly sweet, and a little piney. We keep this drizzle on hand for brushing over game and vegetables and for sweetening tea.

recipes.title: Wild Greens Pesto
recipes.description: To make a bold, flavorful pesto, balance a range of flavors: fragrant mint, potent mustard, citrusy sorrel or purslane, bitter dandelion, neutral lamb's quarters. Making pesto the old-fashioned way by pounding together the greens, nuts, and oil yields a thick, rough sauce.

recipes.title: Cedar-Braised Beans
recipes.description: Just a small branch of cedar adds flavor to these beans and helps to stimulate digestion and strengthen the immune system. We make up a big batch of these beans each week, then work them into a variety of dishes—appetizers, soups, and entrées.

recipes.title: Duck Egg Aioli
recipes.description: This homemade sauce has a velvety texture and rich flavor. It's a great foundation for the variety of sauces we use to dress grilled or roasted vegetables, daub on meats, and slather on savory cakes.

recipes.title: Roasted Corn with Wild Greens Pesto
recipes.description: Corn, when it's just picked, is full of natural sugars that caramelize to perfection on the grill or in a hot oven. Nothing could be easier or more satisfying than freshly roasted sweet corn.

recipes.title: Wojape Mint Sauce
recipes.description: This is terrific with bitter greens such as watercress, dandelion, or sorrel. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator for 3 to 5 days.

recipes.title: Sautéed Corn Mushrooms with Fresh Corn and Fried Sage
recipes.description: This dish reminds me of the year I spent in Mexico, where corn is celebrated in all of its forms. Corn smut or maize mushrooms are considered a delicacy and it's no wonder. They impart a sweet, earthy corn flavor to soups, stews, and sautés and are especially delicious cooked with corn. This is delicious served over Corn Cakes, page 51, or Crispy Bean Cakes, page 38.

recipes.title: Braised Sunflowers (or Sunchokes)
recipes.description: We're familiar with toasted sunflower seeds and their valuable oil, but their gorgeous heads were also once an important source of food. The flavor is close to that of an artichoke. Once braised, they may be stuffed with wild rice, nuts, or beans, and they are also delicious served with a splash of Wojape or sprinkled with smoked salt.

recipes.title: Griddled Maple Squash
recipes.description: This simple technique for cooking squash is quick and easy. Serve the slices on salads, float them on top of soup, or stack them on corn, bean, and wild rice cakes.

recipes.title: Crispy Bean Cakes
recipes.description: Serve these as a first course on wild greens, or make them into tiny patties for finger food. They make wonderful appetizers and snacks.

recipes.title: Three Sisters Mash
recipes.description: This easy side dish makes good use of leftovers; serve it with roast meat or fish; top it with a poached or fried egg for brunch.

recipes.title: Maple-Sage Roasted Vegetables
recipes.description: Roasting vegetables draws out and evaporates their moisture, condensing and intensifying flavors and making the textures firmer and heartier. Use whatever is in season. Autumn squash is perfect for this, as are turnips or timpsila (prairie turnip) and sweet potatoes. These make a nice starter when garnished with toasted nuts and dried cranberries, or served over wild rice, on Corn Cakes, page 51, or on a bed of dark greens, drizzled with a little Wojape.

recipes.title: Wojape (Traditional Berry Sauce)
recipes.description: The scent of this traditional sauce simmering on the stove takes me back to my freewheeling six-year-old self. Our family relied on the local chokecherries I gathered as a kid. We'd spread a blanket under the trees and gather buckets full. There's no need to pit them because the pits drop to the bottom of the pot as the sauce becomes thick and lush. We'd sweeten it for dessert or serve it as a tangy sauce for meat and game and vegetables, and as a dressing.

recipes.title: Puffed Wild Rice
recipes.description: Like popcorn or puffed amaranth, puffed wild rice makes a terrific garnish for salads or soups and a great addition to griddled cakes and cookies. Light and crunchy, nutty tasting, it's a wonderful snack, too.

recipes.title: Smoked Salt
recipes.description: Smoked salts are available in the spice aisles of supermarkets, in specialty shops, and online. Making your own is relatively easy.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Cakes
recipes.description: These hearty cakes may be seared, baked, or griddled. Delicious on their own with a drizzle of Wojape, they make an excellent base for smoked fish or game.

recipes.title: Sorrel Sauce
recipes.description: This bright, tangy sauce is wonderful drizzled over fish or stirred into soups.

recipes.title: Real Wild Rice
recipes.description: True wild rice is not cultivated but harvested from canoes using traditional methods. It cooks up fluffy with a distinctive nutty flavor. Properly stored, it will keep for years.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Pilaf with Wild Mushrooms, Roasted Chestnuts, and Dried Cranberries
recipes.description: This festive pilaf is perfect for holiday gatherings. The combination of wild rice, mushrooms, chestnuts, and cranberries is both earthy and celebratory.

recipes.title: Timpsula Cakes with Cedar-Braised Beans
recipes.description: Timpsula, or prairie turnip, was a staple food for the Plains tribes. These cakes are earthy and satisfying, perfect topped with beans and greens.

recipes.title: Rendered Duck or Goose Fat
recipes.description: Rendering the fat from duck or goose is easy and the rendered fat is the best cooking medium for just about any fried food. It's incredibly tasty with a silky mouth-feel and yields a bonus—little fritters or cracklings. Be warned, though, the freshly crisped morsels are addictive! They're terrific sprinkled on salads, over corn cakes, and on top of wild rice.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
recipes.description: Use this to drizzle over roasted squash or turkey, on Wild Rice Cakes, page 63, or for a dessert sauce.

recipes.title: Raspberry-Rose-Hip Sauce
recipes.description: Rose hips are rich in vitamin C and add a citrusy touch to this sauce. Drizzle it over cakes, ice cream, and sorbet.

recipes.title: Blueberry-Raspberry-Bergamot Spoon Sweet
recipes.description: Spoon sweets are a traditional way of preserving fruit. They're wonderful spooned over yogurt, ice cream, or pancakes.

recipes.title: Wild Apple Sauce (Savory or Sweet)
recipes.description: This sauce is versatile—make it savory with herbs and serve with roasted meats, or sweeten it for dessert. Wild crabapples or any tart apples work beautifully.

recipes.title: Toasted Seeds
recipes.description: Toasted seeds are versatile—use them to garnish salads, soups, and desserts, or enjoy them as a snack.

recipes.title: Sunny Butter (Sunflower Seed Butter)
recipes.description: This nut-free alternative to peanut butter is rich and delicious. It's great on bread, in smoothies, or as a dip for fruit.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Flour
recipes.description: Wild rice flour adds a nutty, earthy flavor to baked goods. It's naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vegetable Flour
recipes.description: Dried vegetables can be ground into a flour that adds flavor and nutrition to breads, soups, and sauces.

recipes.title: Acorn Meal/Flour
recipes.description: Acorns were an important food source for many indigenous peoples. The nuts must be leached of their tannins before use.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Flour
recipes.description: Hazelnut flour adds a rich, nutty flavor to baked goods. It's naturally gluten-free and high in protein.

recipes.title: Chestnut Flour
recipes.description: Chestnut flour has a slightly sweet, nutty flavor. It's naturally gluten-free and wonderful in baked goods.

recipes.title: Fish, Game, and Meat Stock
recipes.description: A rich stock made from game bones, fish frames, or meat scraps. Use to flavor soups, stews, and sauces.

recipes.title: Sprouts
recipes.description: Sprouts are easy to grow at home and add fresh crunch and nutrition to salads and dishes.

recipes.title: Culinary Ash
recipes.description: Culinary ash is made from burned juniper branches or corncobs and is used to add mineral nutrients and a distinctive flavor to blue corn dishes.

recipes.title: Felicia Cocotzin Ruiz's Two-Fruit Jam Scattered with Seeds
recipes.description: Chef Felicia is an inspiration. Her Facebook and Instagram posts showcase her thoughtful, authentic plant-based recipes, all rooted in the history and culture of the Southwest. They reflect the bold flavors of this deeply spiritual place. This jam is great on mesquite crackers, on blue corn pancakes, or in amaranth porridge.

recipes.title: Mitch's Mashed Potatoes
recipes.servings_yield: Makes 6 regular servings or 8 servings for chicken and noodles

recipes.title: Tomato-Red Pepper Sauce with Hot Italian Sausage
Simple Louisiana Style Fermented Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce
recipes.description: A simple Louisiana-style fermented hot sauce using ghost peppers - just peppers, salt, and vinegar for incredible depth of flavor.

recipes.title: Ghost Pepper Salsa with Ancho, Morita, and Guajillo
recipes.description: A complex, smoky salsa combining ghost pepper heat with the rich flavors of dried ancho, morita, and guajillo chilies.
